rows.original: As you make your way through the open grasslands, you hear a sudden thunder of hoofbeats. You brace yourself for a fight, but the noise stops just over a nearby hill. You can hear hints of an argument, but can't catch any of the words from where you're standing. You could check this out, but given what you've [flags.CENTAUR_MARAUDERS_ENCOUNTERED|seen of|heard about] the local centaur population, it could get rough.
rows.translation: 当你穿过开阔的草原时，突然听到了马蹄声。你做好了战斗的准备，但那声音在附近的一座小山后面戛然而止。你能听到一些争吵的声音，但从你现在的位置却听不清他们在说些什么。你本可以去看看发生了什么，但考虑到你之前所经历的一切…… [flags.CENTAUR_MARAUDERS_ENCOUNTERED|被看到|听说过] 对于当地的半人马族群来说，情况可能会变得很棘手。

rows.original:
[flags.AHMRI_ENCOUNTERED
            |You crest the hill, finding the same pair of pursuers harrowing an even more exhausted centaur girl. You draw your weapon, feeling better prepared than the last time you fought the pair.

            "You again? Don't you know when to give up? She clearly doesn't, but you seem like you've got some sense," the calmer one quips. Twitchy snickers, grinning wickedly as he prepares to fight again.
            |You [party.hasCompanions|signal for quiet|crouch low], creeping up to the top of the hill you think the noise is coming from. From the sound of things, neither party notices you, too busy talking to be vigilant. It would appear you've stumbled onto something important, or they've stumbled into you.

            Three centaurs stand apart on the field beneath you. Two male centaurs, naked but for large clubs they each wield, stand on one side. They share wicked smiles as they talk, and even at a distance you can see the muscle flexing in both of their halves. They look to hardly have broken a sweat, despite their earlier chase. More than any of that, the both of them just seem wrong. Their speech, their mannerisms, their body language, none of it reminds you of what you know or have heard about centaurs in the Marches.
            
            "Come on Ahmri, come back home. Your daddy has feasts prepared every day now, with delicacies from all over the Marches," one of them says, hoisting his club over one shoulder and holding out his other arm in invitation.
            
            "Yeah! The food is so good. What do ya say, we'll take it easy on the way back, have some fun along the way," his friend mimics his invitation, and you can't help but notice how over-ready they seem to be for the kind of fun they want. Each has a turgid shaft that almost puts their clubs to shame.
            
            "N-no. Whatever that weird red woman did to Father is clearly affecting you guys as well. I'll find someone to fix you, I promise. Just leave me alone," their target huffs in reply, and you get a good look at her for the first time.
            
            Ahmri is at least two heads shorter than her pursuers, but stands defiantly in their faces. Or... she tries to. She looks in far rougher shape than the two goons. Her legs shake like she could fall at any moment, and the fact that her hindquarters are loaded down with enough gear to survive a trip across the whole of the Marches and back doesn't help matters. Her white coat is smeared with dirt and mud, and her bright blonde tail is tangled with similar muck.
            
            Her human half isn't faring much better. Her hands shake, holding a bow that might be a good fit for a child. She tries to nock an arrow, but holds the entire fletching and the string in her fist. Numerous strands fray from hair that was once done up in some kind of crown braid. Her impressive bust and belly stick out from under a leather chestplate that is obviously a few sizes too small. The one thing that doesn't look out of place is the determined glare in her eyes. She seems totally sure of the promise she just made.
            
            Between the casual attitude of the attackers and the haggard state of their victim, you guess that the hunters are woefully incompetent. Or, more likely, they're toying with her. You sigh, readying your [pc.weapon] and starting down the hill. It looks like this woman [flags.ALRAUNE_DEFEATED|hasn't been corrupted by Kasyrra's influence yet|is yet unaffected by whatever is causing the centaurs' madness]. If you let them take her [pc.dcb|it'd just add another corrupt centaur to deal with. Plus they made it sound like she was important, so maybe she can help.|it'd be tough to live it down. They certainly don't seem the type to just lead her back without trying to pull something. Plus they made it sound like she was important, so maybe she can help you solve the centaurs' problem.|you would be denied the chance to talk to an absolute cutie. Like hell those creepy centaur hunks are going to drag this perfect pound cake around, that can be your job. Oh and maybe she knows what's going on with the centaurs or something.] Neither party notices you coming until you're practically standing between them. The centauress remains wary, but her pursuers drop their jovial banter, trading wicked grins for vicious glares.
            
            "Hey there stranger, how about you put that away and we'll just take our little princess home," the more controlled of the two says. He makes a pained effort to stay calm as he speaks, but you see his knuckles whiten around his club. His partner makes no such effort, either too dumb or too horny to care.
            
            "Yeah, and then we can fuck her tight virgin cunt every night along the way. We only stopped chasing her 'cause we couldn't hold it in any longer." He twitches and stamps his feet, riling himself up even more than before. Mr. Collected rolls his eyes, looking at Twitchy with a measure of contempt. He swings his club out front, gripping it in a combat stance.
            
            "Dumbass! Don't tell [party.hasCompanions|them that, they probably just want her all to themselves.|[pc.himHer] that, [pc.heShe] probably just wants her all to [pc.himHer]self.] Not that we're going to let that happen." His casual attitude hardens over the course of a second, becoming a rage-filled snarl.
            
            "Ah, fuck yeah! Beating the shit out of you will be the perfect warm up," his friend agrees, dropping into a similar combat stance.
            
            It doesn't look like there's any way out of this besides a fight.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.AHMRI_ENCOUNTERED
            |你爬上山顶，发现那对追捕者仍在折磨着那个已经筋疲力尽的半人马女孩。你拔出了武器，感觉这次自己比上次准备得更充分了。

“又是你们？难道你们就不懂得什么时候放弃吗？她显然没有放弃的意思，不过你们似乎还挺有理智的……”那个语气较为冷静的追捕者讥讽道。另一个则发出紧张的笑声，恶毒地笑着，准备再次发起攻击。
            |你 [party.hasCompanions|示意大家安静下来|蹲下身子]当你慢慢爬上小山的顶端时，你以为噪音就是从那里传来的。从声音判断，双方似乎都没有注意到你的存在——他们都太专注于交谈，根本没有保持警惕。看来，你要么偶然发现了一些重要的东西，要么就是他们偶然注意到了你。

            在你足部下的场地上，有三匹半人马格外引人注目。其中两匹是雄性半人马，他们赤裸上身，只手部持着粗大的棍棒站在一侧。他们交谈时露出邪恶的笑容，即使从远处也能看到他们身上肌肉的轮廓在不停地蠕动。 尽管刚才进行了追逐，但他们看起来几乎没流一滴汗。更重要的是，他们的言行举止完全不符合你对马奇地区半人马的了解和印象。他们的说话方式、动作习惯，甚至是肢体语言，都没有任何一点能让你联想到关于半人马的常识或传说。
            
            来吧，阿赫米，回家吧。你爸爸现在每天都会准备丰盛的饭菜，还有来自边境各地的美味佳肴呢，”其中一个人说道，他把棍子搭在肩上，另一只手部伸出来邀请他。
            
            对啊！这食物太好吃了。怎么样，我们回程的时候放松一下，顺便享受一下旅途的乐趣吧，”他的朋友模仿着他的邀请语说，你不禁会注意到，他们似乎已经为这种乐趣做好了充分的准备。 它们的茎部都十分粗壮，甚至让那些球杆都相形见绌了。
            
            不……不管那个奇怪的红衣女人对父亲做了什么，显然也影响到了你们所有人。我一定会找人来治疗你们的，我保证。请让我一个人待着吧。”他们的目标如此回答，而这时你才第一次清楚地看到了她的样子。
            
            阿赫米的身高至少比她的追捕者矮两个头，但她依然坚定地站在他们面前。至少她是这么尝试的。她的状况显然比那两个恶棍要糟糕得多——她的双腿一直在颤抖，仿佛随时都会倒下；而她背上背着的那些装备，足以让她穿越整个边境地区再回来，这也进一步加重了她的负担。 她的白色外套上沾满了污垢和泥巴，那条亮黄色的尾巴也缠满了类似的脏东西。
            
            她的人类那一半状况也好不到哪里去。她的双手部一直在颤抖，握着的弓似乎只适合小孩子使用。她试图将箭搭在弓上，但却把整个箭羽和弓弦都紧紧地握在拳头里。那些曾经被编成皇冠般的发辫，现在也有许多头发丝散落了出来。 她那引人注目的胸部和腹部在一件明显小了几号的皮制胸甲下显得格外突出。唯一没有显得不协调的地方，就是她眼中那坚定的目光——她似乎对自己刚刚做出的承诺充满信心。
            
            从攻击者的漫不经心，以及受害者的憔悴状态来看，你可能会认为这些“猎人”实在笨手部笨足部，毫无能力。或者，更有可能的是，他们只是在戏弄她。你叹了口气，开始准备行动…… [pc.weapon] 然后就开始走下坡路了。这个女人看起来…… [flags.ALRAUNE_DEFEATED|尚未受到卡希拉的影响而变质。|尚未受到导致半人马们陷入疯狂的那些因素的影响]. 如果你让他们带走她…… [pc.dcb|这只会让我们多一个需要处理的腐败半人马。更何况，他们把这个人物描述得好像很重要似的，所以也许她能提供帮助。|这件事很难被掩盖过去。他们看起来绝对不是那种会不图私利就直接把她带回去的人。更何况，他们还把她说得好像很重要似的，所以也许她能帮你解决那些半人马带来的麻烦。|你将会错过与这样一个超级可爱的人交谈的机会。那些令人毛骨悚然的半人马家伙绝对不会让这个完美的女孩成为他们的负担，这个机会完全可以属于你。哦，也许她还知道那些半人马到底在搞什么名堂呢。] 直到你几乎站在他们中间时，双方才注意到你的存在。那个半人马女子依然保持着警惕，但她的追捕者们却停止了嬉闹，将欢快的玩笑声换成了凶狠的目光。

“嘿，陌生人，你把那东西收起来吧，我们还是把我们的小公主带回家吧。”其中那个表现得较为冷静的人说道。 他努力保持冷静地说话，但你可以看到他的指关节因为紧握球杆而变得发白。他的搭档则完全没有这样的努力，要么太蠢，要么太急切，根本不在乎这些。

“没错，这样我们一路上每晚都可以和她那紧致的处女之穴亲密接触了。 我们之所以停止追她，只是因为我们已经再也控制不住自己了。”他不停地抽搐着，足部也不停地跺来跺去，让自己的情绪变得更加激动。科尔先生翻了个白眼，带着一丝轻蔑的目光看着这个坐立不安的人。 他将球杆举到身前，以战斗姿势握住它。

“笨蛋！别说了…… [party.hasCompanions|那些人，他们大概只是想把她完全据为己有吧。|[pc.himHer] 那就是。 [pc.heShe] 大概只是想把她完全据为己有罢了。 [pc.himHer]自我。] 我们当然不会让那种事情发生。”他原本随意的态度在瞬间变得严厉起来，变成了充满愤怒的低吼。

“啊，太好了！把你打得落花流水简直再合适不过了，”他的朋友也附和道，同样摆出了战斗姿态。

看来，除了打架之外，根本没有别的办法摆脱这个局面了。
        ]

rows.original: Check out the commotion. Better to get the jump on a violent centaur than be caught unaware.
rows.translation: 看看那边的骚动吧。最好趁那些凶猛的半人马还没注意到我们时迅速行动，否则就会被抓住。
rows.raw: "Check out the commotion. Better to get the jump on a violent centaur than be caught unaware."

rows.original: Better get out of here before the centaurs hear or see you.
rows.translation: 最好在半人马们听到或看到你之前赶紧离开这里。
rows.raw: "Better get out of here before the centaurs hear or see you."

rows.original:
The centaurs fall back, and you brace yourself between them and the girl. The calm hunter leans on his greatclub, huffing out breaths and offering you a calculated glare. He opens his mouth to speak, but is distracted by his companion. The less controlled centaur is practically seizing, but it's more than that. You can see his skin bulging from inside, as if some internal force slithers through the cracks. He looses a mindless roar as slippery tentacles sprout from his body. Shudders that have nothing to do with pain wrack his entire form as the wriggling appendages settle into their full length. Even his equine phallus grows, coiling up to poise in the air like another tail, its flared tip dripping with precum.

    "Shit," the other centaur curses under his breath, turning heel and rushing off in the opposite direction before you get the chance to move. The new monster begins a steady advance in Ahmri's direction, leaving you little choice. 
    
    "No more wait," it says, its voice somehow sounding every bit as oily as the slippery tentacles covering its body look. The exhausted mare stands in abject fear, this new power or corruption seemingly the limit of her defiance. The nightmare's slow pace gives you enough time to reach her first, tugging a short blade from a sheath on her barding and sinking it directly into the monster's chest, where you think a heart would be. He bats you away with one arm, preparing to smash you with the huge club he now holds effortlessly in one hand. Fortunately, that's all the distraction you needed. 
    
    His focus on the chief's daughter allows [party.oneComp brint atugia berwyn cait|Brint ample time to bring his massive axe in a two handed arc that nearly cleaves the monstrous hunter in half.|Atugia to nearly bisect him at the middle with a rune empowered uppercut from her halberd.|Berwyn to impale the monstrous hunter with a chunk of magically compacted stone.|Cait to blast away a section of the monstrous hunter's flank with whitefire.|you to finish the job, slicing deep into his equine half with the blade.] He chokes on a surprised noise before finally dropping dead at your feet. The myriad of tentacular appendages sprouting from his skin continue twitching as you clean off the knife and move to return it to its owner. You turn straight into the razor point of the arrow Ahmri was trying to nock earlier.
rows.translation:
半人马们纷纷后退，你站在他们与那个女孩之间，做好了防御的准备。那位冷静的猎人倚着他的大棍，喘着粗气，用一种充满算计的目光注视着你。他张开嘴想要说话，但被他的同伴吸引了注意力。 那头控制力逐渐丧失的半人马几乎已经失去了理智，但实际情况远不止如此。你可以看到它的皮肤从内部开始膨胀，仿佛有什么无形的力量正在通过那些裂口渗出体外。它发出一声毫无意识的咆哮，随后一些滑腻的触手从它的身体上生长出来。 那些与疼痛无关的颤抖席卷了他的整个身体，那些扭动着的附肢也伸展到了它们的最大长度。就连他那类似马匹生殖器的器官也变长了，它盘绕着悬在半空中，就像另一条尾巴一样，其末端还分泌着黏液。

    该死，”另一个半人马低声咒骂着，转身朝相反的方向冲了出去，连你都没有机会做出反应。那只新的怪物开始朝着阿赫米的方向稳步前进，让你别无选择。 
    
    不要再等待了，”它说道，那声音听起来油滑得简直与它身上那些滑腻的触手一模一样。这只精疲力竭的母马站在那里，充满了恐惧——这种新的力量，或者说这种堕落，似乎已经成为了它反抗的极限。 这场噩梦的进展极为缓慢，因此你有足够的时间先赶到她身边。你从她身上的护甲中抽出一把短刀，直接刺入了那只怪物应该有心脏的位置。它用一只手臂将你击开，同时准备用另一只手轻松握住的巨棒将你砸扁。 幸运的是，这些干扰正好满足了你的需求。 
    
    他之所以专注于酋长的女儿，是因为…… [party.oneComp brint atugia berwyn cait|布林特有足够的时间将他那巨大的斧头挥出一条双臂合成的弧线，这一击几乎将那个可怕的猎人劈成两半。|阿图吉娅用她那柄长柄斧挥出了一记带有符文力量的上勾拳，这一击几乎将他从中间劈成两半。|贝尔温将用一块经过魔法压缩的石头刺穿那个可怕的猎人。|凯特用白火炸掉了那个怪物猎人侧身的一部分。|你完成了这项任务，用刀刃深深地切入了他的马身部位。] 他发出一声惊恐的叫声，随后便倒在了你的足部下死去。从他皮肤上长出的那些触手仍在不断抽搐，而你则擦干净刀子，准备将其归还给主人。就在这时，你突然被阿赫米之前试图射出的那支箭的箭尖刺中了。

Even his equine phallus grows, coiling up to poise in the air like another tail, its flared tip dripping with precum.

    "Shit," the other centaur curses under his breath, turning heel and rushing off in the opposite direction before you get the chance to move. The new monster begins a steady advance in Ahmri's direction, leaving you little choice. 
    
    "No more wait," it says, its voice somehow sounding every bit as oily as the slippery tentacles covering its body look. The exhausted mare stands in abject fear, this new power or corruption seemingly the limit of her defiance. The nightmare's slow pace gives you enough time to reach her first, tugging a short blade from a sheath on her barding and sinking it directly into the monster's chest, where you think a heart would be. He bats you away with one arm, preparing to smash you with the huge club he now holds effortlessly in one hand. Fortunately, that's all the distraction you needed. 
    
    His focus on the chief's daughter allows [party.oneComp brint atugia berwyn cait|Brint ample time to bring his massive axe in a two handed arc that nearly cleaves the monstrous hunter in half.|Atugia to nearly bisect him at the middle with a rune empowered uppercut from her halberd.|Berwyn to impale the monstrous hunter with a chunk of magically compacted stone.|Cait to blast away a section of the monstrous hunter's flank with whitefire.|you to finish the job, slicing deep into his equine half with the blade.] He chokes on a surprised noise before finally dropping dead at your feet. The myriad of tentacular appendages sprouting from his skin continue twitching as you clean off the knife and move to return it to its owner. You turn straight into the razor point of the arrow Ahmri was trying to nock earlier."

rows.original:
"How do I know you aren't just another one of that red b-bitch's pawns?" she huffs. Red bitch? Does she mean Kasyrra, or is there a new demon to worry about? She still looks terrified, but it seems at least some of her determination has returned. You sigh, wondering how you're gonna convince her in this state.
    
        "[pc.dcb|You don't, but I'm not. I do know that when someone worse than those hunters comes along you'll just end up captured or killed if you keep running around like this,|I can't prove it to you, but I'm not. I'm just someone who doesn't want you to get captured or killed when something scarier or smarter than that monster comes along,|I'd never let that dumb demon skank order me around. And, like, I wouldn't want some scary rape monster to kidnap a cutie like you,]" you reply. The mixture of fear and defiance in the chunky centaur deflates in an instant. She sinks to the ground, suddenly looking like she hasn't slept in days. For all you know, she hasn't.
        
        "I don't think I could've run for much longer anyway. I brought enough food to last a while, I think, but I need some rest. I've never had to leave the village so I didn't run much," she says with confidence, indicating some of the fully packed bags on her barding. You inch around, undoing the tie on one of the packs she'd pointed out, and then another, and another... each is filled to the brim with cakes and other sweetmeats. None of this will last more than a week before spoiling.
        
        "W-what? But this is all the stuff that tastes the best. I just picked all the things I usually eat. It never got spoiled when I was at home," she explains, her confidence quickly evaporating. It probably never had the chance to spoil when it could all be eaten fresh, but few desserts that aren't designed for travel will last on the run. By the time you've helped her set aside which of her food items will last, you have enough for maybe two good meals. Dried fruit and a few handfuls of jerky. You feel a little bad as you explain this to the poor woman, who obviously knew nothing about food preparation beyond the end results.
        
        "Hey, You'll be fine. I can probably get you some shelter back in Hawkethorne village till I find some way to fix whatever's going on here. I know your name from before, but we never got formally introduced. I'm [pc.name],[party.som|| and this is [companion1.name],| and these are my friends, [party.compNames],]" you say, patting the distressed centaur mare on the shoulder. The friendly gesture is enough to perk her up a little, and she looks at you with the same spark you saw in her eyes when she faced down the hunters.
        
        "No. I won't leave the valley. If you heard my name, then you probably also heard that I'm the chief's daughter. Chief Taldahs's only daughter, to be precise. I'm not going to run away until I find a way to fix my tribe," she states. You meet her gaze, testing her resolve with a hard stare, but she refuses to take your way out.
        
        "Ok. Give me a bit to find somewhere you can stay. I'll teach you something for if your food runs out before then," you say, looking around for a moment before you find what you were looking for. A nearby bush contains a large nest with a cluster of large speckled eggs. You pluck three of them from the bunch and walk back to the resting blonde.
        
        "These are March chicken eggs. The things are everywhere up here, so many they're practically pests. They lay upwards of 8 huge eggs a week, and usually just leave them in warm places where they hatch after another week. Luckily for you the eggs are also packed with nutrition. Just check bushes around the hills here and you'll probably find a nest within the first couple. Do you know how to start a fire?" She nods, pulling out an immaculate flint firestarter and tinderbox. The tools don't look like they've seen a second of use. She holds them proudly in front of her chest, frowning when she seems to realize she has no idea how to work them.
        
        "That's ok, at least you have that much. I can show you how it works," you say, taking the ensemble from her outstretched hands. You briefly step over to the same bush you picked the eggs out of, gathering dry brush and sticks from the ground around it. Despite how tired she looks, Ahmri watches intently as you explain how to start a fire, even insisting you let her be the one to actually get it started. By sheer luck, one of the packs she loaded herself up with contains a pan, and you demonstrate a couple ways to cook eggs. With the tools you have you really only have sunny side up and scrambled for options, but that doesn't seem to disappoint your eager student.
        
        "This would be so good on fresh-baked bread!" she says after the first bite of scrambled egg. She wolfs down the rest before you can respond, smiling the widest you've seen since you met. The look certainly seems to fit her much better than her worried frowns. She wobbles to her feet, cantering over to the bush and returning with three more eggs. It's a little bit of a struggle, but she manages to only burn one of them with your guidance. You take the singed sunny side up, leaving her with the rest. She pats her stomach when she finishes, looking thoroughly satisfied.
        
        "It might take me some time to find a place to stay, but in the meantime you're free to stay in any of the camps [party.hasCompanions|we|I] set up on the plains. Do you have any place you can go if there's trouble in the camp?" you ask, looking around at the open plains and rolling hills. She stares at you for a second before beginning to tear up.
        
        "Really? Gods, when am I gonna wake up and find out I collapsed getting chased by those monsters? This is just like the kinda stories they tell little foals, except in those stories you're a big stoic centaur. I don't mind though, cause you look like a hero to me!" she half-sobs, wiping her face and grinning wide.
        
        "I do have a place to hide if things go wrong, but it's not really all that homey. I'd much rather try out camping, even if it's temporary." Just talking about it seems to reinvigorate her.
rows.translation:
我怎么知道你不是那个红发贱人的又一个棋子呢？”她气呼呼地说。红发贱人？她指的是卡希拉，还是又出现了什么新的威胁？她看起来仍然很害怕，但至少她的决心似乎有所恢复。你叹了口气，思索着在这种情况下该如何说服她。[pc.dcb|你不会，但我也不会。我确实知道，如果出现比那些猎人更危险的人，你如果继续这样四处逃窜，最终只会被抓住或者杀死。|我无法向你证明这一点，但我确实不是那样的人。我只是一个不希望你在遇到比那个怪物更可怕、更聪明的东西时被抓走或杀死的人而已。|我绝对不会让那个愚蠢的恶魔对我指手画脚。而且，我可不想让什么可怕的强奸犯把像你这么可爱的女孩绑架走。]你回答吧。那个魁梧半人马的脸上，恐惧与反抗交织的情绪瞬间消失了。她瘫倒在地，看上去仿佛已经好几天没睡觉了——事实上，谁又知道呢？

“反正，我想我也跑不下去太久了。 我想我带的食品应该够吃一段时间了，不过我确实需要休息一下。我以前从来没离开过村子，所以也没跑过太远的距离，”她自信地说道，同时指了指自己背包上那些装得满满当当的袋子。你小心翼翼地挪动足部步，解开了她指出的那个背包的绑带，然后又解开了另一个，再一个……每一个容器都装满了蛋糕和其他甜点。这些食物在一周内就会变质。
        
        什、什么？但这些都是最好吃的食材啊。我只不过挑选了我平时常吃的那些东西而已。在家里的时候，这些食物从来都不会变质啊，”她解释道，但她的自信很快就消失了。其实，这些食材本来就可以一直保持新鲜，根本不可能变质，但那些并非为旅行而设计的甜点，在外出旅行时确实很难保持新鲜。 当你帮她挑选出哪些食物可以保存较长时间时，你发现这些食物大概够做两顿美餐。还有些干果和几把肉干。当你向这位可怜的女士解释这些情况时，你感到有些内疚——显然，她对食物储存方法一无所知，只知道最终的食物成果而已。
        
        嘿，你不会有事的。在我想办法解决这里发生的问题之前，我应该可以帮你找到一个暂时的避难所，就在鹰棘镇村吧。我之前就认识你的名字，但我们从未正式介绍过彼此。我叫…… [pc.name],[party.som|| 而这就是…… [companion1.name],| 这些都是我的朋友们。 [party.compNames],]你说得对，”你轻拍着那匹陷入困境的半人马母马的肩膀。这个友好的举动足以让她稍微振作起来，她看着你的眼神中，依然闪烁着当初她面对猎人时那种坚定的光芒。
        
        不，我不会离开这个山谷。如果你听说过我的名字，那么你肯定也知道我是族长的女儿——更确切地说，是塔尔达斯族长唯一的女儿。在找到解决我们部落问题的办法之前，我是不会逃跑的。”她说道。 你与她的目光相对，用坚定的眼神考验她的决心，但她拒绝让你的计划得逞。
        
        好的，给我一点时间，让我找个地方让你住下。如果在那之前你的食物用完了，我会教你一些办法的。”你一边说着，一边环顾四周，最终找到了你想要的东西。附近的一丛灌木丛中有一个很大的鸟巢，里面有一窝颜色斑斑点点的鸟蛋。你从中摘了三颗，然后走回到那个正在休息的金发女孩身边。
        
        这些都是三月的鸡下的蛋。这种鸡在这里到处都是，数量多得简直像害虫一样。它们每周能产下8个以上的蛋，而且通常会把蛋放在温暖的地方，一周后蛋就会孵化。幸运的是，这些蛋营养价值也非常高。 你只需要检查这些山丘周围的灌木丛，很可能在前几处就能找到一个鸟巢。你知道怎么生火吗？”她点了点头，掏出了一个完好无损的打火石和引火物。这些工具看起来似乎从来都没有被使用过。 她骄傲地将它们捧在胸前，但当她意识到自己根本不知道如何使用它们时，她的眉头立刻皱了起来。
        
        没关系，至少你还有那些。我可以告诉你怎么使用它，”你一边说，一边从她伸出的手部中接过那套工具。你走到刚才捡到鸡蛋的那丛灌木旁，从周围的地面上捡起一些干树枝和枯草。 尽管她看起来非常疲惫，但阿赫米还是聚精会神地听着你讲解如何生火，甚至坚持要由她亲自来尝试生火。幸运的是，她带在身上的那些物品中正好有一口锅，于是你便示范了几种煮鸡蛋的方法。 凭借你手部头的这些工具，其实你只能选择“煎蛋正面朝上”或者“炒蛋”这两种做法，但这对你那位热切求知的学生来说，似乎并不会让人感到失望。
        
        放在新鲜出炉的面包上吃肯定非常美味！”她尝了第一口炒蛋后说道。还没等你回应，她就狼吞虎咽地吃完了剩下的部分，脸上绽放出你见到她以来最灿烂的笑容。这种表情显然比她那忧心忡忡的表情要适合她得多。 她摇摇晃晃地站了起来，快步跑到灌木丛那里，回来时手部里拿着另外三个鸡蛋。虽然有点费劲，但在你的指导下，她最终只烧坏了一个鸡蛋。你拿走了那个被烧焦的、煎至金黄色的鸡蛋，把剩下的留给了她。 吃完饭后，她拍了拍肚子，看起来非常满足。
        
        我可能需要一些时间来寻找住处，但在那之前，你们可以随意选择任何营地暂住。 [party.hasCompanions|我们|我] 我们在平原上安家。如果营地里出了麻烦，你有没有什么地方可以去？”你环顾着这片开阔的平原和连绵的丘陵问道。她盯着你看了一会儿，然后突然开始流泪。

“真的吗？ 天啊，我什么时候才能醒来，然后发现自己是在被那些怪物追赶的过程中累倒的呢？这简直就像那些人们给小马驹们讲的故事一样，只不过在那些故事里，你是那个坚强勇敢的半人马啊。不过我并不介意，因为在我看来，你简直就像一个英雄！她半抽泣着，一边擦着脸，一边咧开嘴笑了起来。

“如果事情出了岔子，我确实有一个地方可以躲起来，不过那里其实并不算特别温馨。我宁愿尝试露营，哪怕只是暂时的。”仅仅提到这个想法，似乎就让她重新充满了活力。

rows.original:
You drop to your knees, struggling to remain standing. One of the two centaur hunters strides over to you, and you can see pearly precum dripping from the tip of his cock. Abruptly, he stops, stepping over and passing behind you in a rush.

    "You fucking imbecile! Where did she go?" the formerly collected centaur barks to his companion. Twitchy looks up for the first time, looking nervous.
    
    "Where did who go? [party.solo|[pc.HesShes]|they're] right here. I've been keeping my eye on them," he replies, looking back to [party.combatNames].
    
    "Ahmri, dimwit. She ran away while we were distracted. Come on, she's the important thing here. Anyone who gets beaten this easily isn't worth a fuck anyway," he says with a look of disgust, galloping off in search of the escaped woman.
    
    "Aww, damnit," his companion rushes off after him, spitting the occasional curse till he leaves your hearing range. At least you gave the girl time to slip away.
rows.translation:
你跪倒在地，拼命想要站起身来。两个半人马猎人中的一个走了过来，你可以看到他阴茎的顶端正滴着珍珠般的精液。突然，他停下了脚步，快步从你身边走过去。

“你这个该死的白痴！她去哪里了？”那个原本镇定自若的半人马对着他的同伴吼道。你紧张地抬起头，第一次看到了他的样子。

“谁去哪里了？ [party.solo|[pc.HesShes]|他们是] 就在这里。我一直都在关注它们，”他回答道，同时回头看了看。 [party.combatNames]啊姆里，笨蛋。我们分心的时候她就逃走了。拜托，她才是这里最重要的东西。那种这么容易就被打败的人，根本不值得浪费时间，”他厌恶地说道，然后飞快地跑去追那个逃跑的女人了。

“哎呀，该死，”他的同伴也急忙跟了上去，一边跑一边不时咒骂几句，直到声音消失在耳边。至少你让那个女孩有时间逃走了。

'
    You drop to your knees, struggling to remain standing. One of the two centaur hunters strides over to you, and you can see pearly precum dripping from the tip of his cock. Abruptly, he stops, stepping over and passing behind you in a rush.

    "You fucking imbecile! Where did she go?" the formerly collected centaur barks to his companion. Twitchy looks up for the first time, looking nervous.
    
    "Where did who go? [party.solo|[pc.HesShes]|they're] right here. I've been keeping my eye on them," he replies, looking back to [party.combatNames].
    
    "Ahmri, dimwit. She ran away while we were distracted. Come on, she's the important thing here. Anyone who gets beaten this easily isn't worth a fuck anyway," he says with a look of disgust, galloping off in search of the escaped woman.

As you move to check on Ahmri, you find her already headed in your direction with a determined look on her face. She stops just in front of you, smiling and fiddling a little with her fingers.

        "I wanted to thank you again for saving me, and I don't want to just keep using words to say it. I don't have much experience with sex stuff, but I'm pretty confident in my boobs. Also people like to say I'm really good at eating! I know they're mostly jokes about my weight, but I don't see why it can't be true here too," she runs on, using her hands for emphasis as she speaks. It takes you a second to register what she's saying, and when you do it's still a bit surprising. There's not a hint of embarrassment in her offer, but when she sees your questioning glance a slight blush creeps its way into her cheeks.
        
        "Uhh, is that not normal? In centaur culture those kinds of favors are a common way to thank a rescuer. Usually it's handjobs, cause using your boobs is kind of tough for centaurs, but I've read about boobjobs in books and I always wanted to try it! [pc.hasVaginaOnly|Err, jilling off someone who can cuddle up to me while I'm doing it is also pretty exciting!|I didn't get many chances to be rescued back home though. Not much danger in the village.] I-if this is a little too weird that's ok too. Some of my younger cousins tell me I make a great pillow, so if you ever just want a good cuddle I'd be totally ok with that." She turns a deeper shade of red the longer she goes on, but still does her best to maintain the confidence in her smile.

rows.original:
As politely as you can, you tell the eager centauress that it might be better to wait a bit first, and see her deflate a little. 

            "Oh... Boy, now I feel a bit awkward. I was getting too caught up in my expectations from stories and stuff. It's ok." Seeing her wilt prompts a little more of an explanation. You don't want to push her away, or have her leave, but it might be better to wait until you aren't being harried by maddened centaur raiders.
            
            "O-oh! Yeah, that does make sense. I can tell you all about the village if you want. I even know a special way in!" Ahmri is right back to her excited self, looking just as into helping with your quest as she was about the sex. At least she's easy to distract...

rows.original:
The centaur chieftain's daughter smiles brightly, and has barely stopped since she started hanging out in your camps. Her icy-blonde hair is done up in a crown braid, perfectly accentuating the sun kissed tan of her skin. Bright blue eyes view the plains with abject curiosity, approaching every new experience with eager delight. The exhaustion of her flight seems to be running in reverse.

        Now that she's no longer on the run, Ahmri has traded her undersized chestplate for a better-fitting summer dress that looks equally out of place in the brisk valley air. Better is a bit of a misnomer, because she still spills out of the top with naive ignorance. If the cold bothers her at all it doesn't show in the slightest, with even her puffy nipples resisting the breeze's best efforts. The busty centaur could easily fill a DDD cup bra, if she were to wear one. Surprisingly, her bust doesn't strain too hard against the dress. Instead, it opts to flood out the open sides.
        
        The dress ends just above the bottom of her chubby belly, not quite making it to the transition point of her tauric lower half. She opts to leave her barding off while she sits around your camp, showing off her fluffy white hair. You occasionally see her run her fingers over her forelegs, using the softness to relax when she gets too overexcited.
rows.translation:
半人马族首领的女儿笑容灿烂，自从开始常来你们的营地之后，她就几乎没停过笑容。她那冰蓝色的长发被编成皇冠般的发髻，完美地衬托出了她皮肤上那被阳光晒出的古铜色光泽。 那双明亮湛蓝的眼睛以充满好奇的目光注视着这片平原，每当遇到新的体验，她都会满怀兴奋地去迎接它。似乎，长途飞行带来的疲惫感正在逐渐消失。

如今，她不再需要逃跑了，于是阿赫米将那件不合身的小胸甲换成了了一件更合身的夏季连衣裙——不过，在这清新的山谷空气中，这件裙子依然显得有些格格不入。 说她“有所进步”其实有点言过其实，因为她依然充满了天真的无知。即使寒冷让她感到不适，她也丝毫没有表现出来——就连她那胀大的乳头也丝毫没有因为微风而有所反应。 那个胸部丰满的半人马如果穿上DDD罩杯的胸罩，肯定能将其撑满。令人惊讶的是，她的胸部并不会让连衣裙感到过于紧绷，反而会从连衣裙的开口处溢出来。

这条连衣裙的长度刚好到她圆滚滚的小腹上方，并没有延伸到她半人马形态的下半身的过渡部位。 她选择坐在你的营地旁，任由身上的毛发自然垂下，展示着自己那蓬松的白发。偶尔你会看到她用手指轻轻抚摸自己的前腿，依靠那种柔软的感觉来缓解过于兴奋的情绪。

rows.original: You see Ahmri yawn as you start your way over to her corner of camp, but by the time you make it around the tent she was wandering past she's already asleep! She breathes gently, as if she's been asleep for hours already. As gently as you can, you sit down and lean against the stomach of her equine half. Almost automatically, your hand reaches out to run your fingers through the curly white hair that adorns her tauric side. She's soft. More so than you could tell by looking at her. You strip quietly out of your armor, leaning back and letting your head and upper body rest against her. It feels like your lying on a comfortable feather bed. Each breath she takes rocks you slightly, but rather than distracting you the rhythmic motion lulls you into deeper relaxation. Time drifts slowly by, and you yourself begin drifting off to sleep before you have a chance to think about it any more. [rand |The whole night, you dream of nothing but fluffy clouds and what it would be like to sleep on them. They're extra comfy, and even when you toss in your sleep and fall, another cloud is there to catch you. You don't even wake from the impact, simply grinning in your sleep and rubbing your face against the plush surface. More and more clouds join your night-time weather front, creating a storm of blissful softness that carries you safely through the dark nothingness. |Your rest is full of plush, faceless sheep that jump over high fences and drop into your lap. Once they've landed, the sheep waddle around you and settle into a supportive cushion of softness. Their wool is so silky you can't distinguish between them when they bunch up together! You stop trying to count them after the first minute of searching, letting new sheep pile on top of you till you're covered in blissful pillowy darkness. |You dream of nothingness, just an empty void that surrounds and encases you. What should be terrifying to see isn't frightening at all. You can feel the softness all around you. Warmth and gentleness rather than cold and loneliness. Adrift in comfort, you don't so much as toss, let alone turn, for the entire night. There are no stars to count, no sights to see, but you need none of that. Just the intimate, instinctive knowledge that you're safe. ]

rows.original: You and Ahmri wake around the same time. Ahmri rolls up gently, looking groggily down at your prone form and then half smiling when she realizes you slept there. You nuzzle into her equine fluff, not wanting to give up the comforting softness just yet. Unfortunately, the sun steals away the relaxation the night brought, and it's just not the same. You push yourself up with a sigh as the sleepy centaur suppresses a laugh. Before you get up, she scoots over and squeezes you into a tight embrace. You hug back, just holding her for a second while you work up the courage to face the day. Staying there and hugging her for the entire day is awfully tempting, but at the same time it fills you with much needed warmth and a sense of determination. Whatever the day has to throw at you can't take this away from you. You stand and stretch, helping Ahmri to her feet and joining her in dressing for the day. She pulls a new summer dress over her human half, and begins working on her hair with the help of a small hand mirror. Watching her braid would be lovely, but you do have other things to do. With a forlorn sigh you shake yourself fully awake and return to your adventures.
rows.translation: 你和阿赫米差不多同时醒来。阿赫米缓缓地滚过来，迷迷糊糊地低头看着你躺着的模样，当她意识到你是在她身边睡觉时，脸上露出了淡淡的微笑。你依偎在她那柔软如马的毛发中，实在不想放弃这种舒适的感觉。 可惜，太阳夺走了夜晚带来的宁静，一切都变得不一样了。你叹着气坐起来，而那个困倦的半人马则强忍住笑意。 在你起身之前，她挪过身来，紧紧地将你拥入怀中。 你也回抱了她，只是紧紧抱住她一秒钟，以此来鼓起勇气面对新的一天。如果一整天都待在那里继续拥抱她，那确实非常诱人，但同时，这样的拥抱也能给你带来所需的温暖与坚定的决心。 无论这一天会带来什么挑战，都无法夺走这些属于你的东西。 你站起身来，活动了一下身体，然后帮助阿赫米站起来，一起开始为一天的活动做准备。她给自己的人类身体穿上了新买的夏季连衣裙，然后借助一个小手镜开始整理自己的头发。 看着她编辫子，肯定很有趣，不过你…… 做 还有其他事情要做。你无奈地叹了口气，彻底清醒过来，然后继续继续你的冒险之旅。
rows.raw: " You and Ahmri wake around the same time. Ahmri rolls up gently, looking groggily down at your prone form and then half smiling when she realizes you slept there. You nuzzle into her equine fluff, not wanting to give up the comforting softness just yet. Unfortunately, the sun steals away the relaxation the night brought, and it's just not the same. You push yourself up with a sigh as the sleepy centaur suppresses a laugh. Before you get up, she scoots over and squeezes you into a tight embrace. You hug back, just holding her for a second while you work up the courage to face the day. Staying there and hugging her for the entire day is awfully tempting, but at the same time it fills you with much needed warmth and a sense of determination. Whatever the day has to throw at you can't take this away from you. You stand and stretch, helping Ahmri to her feet and joining her in dressing for the day. She pulls a new summer dress over her human half, and begins working on her hair with the help of a small hand mirror. Watching her braid would be lovely, but you do have other things to do. With a forlorn sigh you shake yourself fully awake and return to your adventures."

rows.original: Find Ahmri for some restful cuddles.
rows.translation: 去找阿赫米，一起享受一些温馨的拥抱吧。

rows.original: It's not dark yet, the day is still young!
rows.translation: 天还没黑，一天才刚开始呢！
rows.raw: "It's not dark yet, the day is still young!"

rows.original: Maybe Ahmri would be up for some lewd fun.
rows.translation: 也许阿赫米会愿意参与一些调情的活动呢。
rows.raw: "Maybe Ahmri would be up for some lewd fun."

rows.original:
"So what do you know of the area? You seemed to be avoiding the hunters pretty well," you ask, taking a seat next to Ahmri on a nearby mat.

        "Umm... I know Hawkethorne village is to the north. That's where all the traders come from! And my village is back to the west of here. I don't really know much else, b-but I've heard things, and I think I saw a farm while I was running before the hunters steered me away from it. Oh, this sucks. You saw how they were herding me around. I haven't seen anything more than a field's distance outside the village," she harrumphs, throwing her hands up.
        
        "[pc.isBimbo|Awww, it's ok! You're too adorable to know all that hard stuff. What about that stuff you heard about? Anything interesting?|Hey, it's fine. You said you've heard some things. What about?]" you ask, leaning in for a hug. Ahmri still looks slightly ruffled when you pull away, although filled with more determination.
        
        "Right, well. Down south there's the Marefolk Village. I don't know that any centaur has actually been there for a long time, but everybody knows where it is. Before all this mess started, the hunters knew exactly where to go to avoid getting too far into marefolk territory. Even if they stay out of their territory, the hunters still had to deal with the crazy males." She appears to mull something over as she talks.
        
        "Daddy always said to watch out for the marefolk, but I don't know why. They have the same bits as us, and I hear foragers jokingly inquiring about whether they helped any mares on their virgin quests, so they can't be all bad. Only good people call them quests, bad guys use words like 'scheme' or 'grand design.' Sure the guys go rape crazy, but if that's the case, shouldn't we just work together? Our males don't do that, or at least they didn't before that monster came to the valley," she finishes. You see her fists clench at her waist, consternation plain on her face.
        
        "Relax, we'll think of something to fix this," you promise, clasping a hand over hers and earning a smile as her stress bleeds out a bit.
        
        "Thanks. Uhh, I don't know much more than that as far as the valley goes. I didn't really spend a lot of time learning about it. I probably should've paid more attention when Daddy was talking about history, but I was too busy daydreaming about dragons in far off lands, or what it would feel like to have two legs. Especially toes! They look so interesting!" She bounces excitedly, blushing when she sees you struggling not to laugh.
        
        "Err, sorry. We were talking about the valley. The big river is called the Tarahugan! It's pronounced 'hoog-in,' but actually it was named after Ugan the Ironheart and his wife Tarah. There used to be no river there, and the two tribes of centaurs who lived here hated each other. There's a bunch of boring history about the war, but the important part is that chief Ugan loved Tarah, the sister of chief Golas in the north." Ahmri brushes an errant strand of hair from her eyes, looking infinitely more into the discussion now that what you can only assume is a legend of some kind is involved.
        
        "They had to keep their love a secret, 'cause of course everyone would get mad if they knew they were in love. Ugan could've been deposed! Tarah could've been shamed or exiled! It was thrilling times! They would always meet during the harvest when both tribes took their wares out of the valley to sell. It was common for leaders from both tribes to mingle with locals when the trade caravans were on the march, so it was easy for them to meet without arousing suspicions. Can you imagine only meeting for a couple weeks out of every year? They must've fucked like kobolds!" the chunky centauress continues, aglow with excitement.
        
        "As you can maybe guess, it worked out just fine until Tarah got pregnant. I'm sure they probably just forgot to use contraceptive herbs one year, but I think it's more romantic if they wanted to try and connect the tribes. It didn't work, and they ended up getting chased to the foot of a big mountain. There they found the goddess Lumia lying in a small spring, herself pregnant and almost fit to burst.
        
        'Please, Bright One, save us from the folly of our tribes,' begs Ugan, and Lumia gives them both a smile. Oh, and she's like thirty feet tall in the story, taller than even some giants. But she's lying down like two legs do when they have babies, and Tarah and Ugan can see her face just fine. They can see she's straining with labor, but she still replies.
        
        'Little ones, keep me company for a while. Your kin will not destroy your glorious creation,' and she beckons them closer. They were probably super brave about it, but I would've been scared shitless. Can you imagine a forty foot tall glowing goddess asking you to keep her company? I'm sure Lumia is super hot but that's scary stuff. Anyway of course they were curious about her pregnancy, and they weren't afraid to ask about it.
        
        'Bright One, your labor appears to be causing you stress. Is there anything we can do to help?' Tarah asks.
        
        'Seeing the fruit of your creation swelling within you is comfort enough, little one. My own labor will be over soon,' the goddess replies, grimacing with sudden effort. The couple shield their eyes and ears as a thunderous noise pervades the cavern, like a hurricane without the wind. When they finally recover enough to see, the goddess is gone, replaced by the source of a powerful underground stream. The two of them make their way out of the cave, expecting to be captured by their tribes, but when they get out they find themselves transformed by the goddess!" Ahmri continues, sighing and staring dreamily into your eyes. Her tale seems to be winding down.
        
        "It wasn't like they solved all the tribes troubles then and there, but the important thing is they lived happily ever after. Some people think they might still be alive in service of Lumia today." She stares for another moment before suddenly seeming to realize where she is.
        
        "Ah, I didn't mean to ramble. It's just one of my favorite stories since it involves centaurs. I'm sure I missed some parts too, ugh." She buries her face in her hands, flushing all the way to her ears. You put a hand on her shoulder, assuring her that she's not the worst storyteller you've had to listen to. Maybe there's something else you can ask her about?
rows.translation:
那么，你对这个地区了解多少呢？你似乎很好地避开了那些猎人，”你边说边在附近的垫子上坐在了阿赫米旁边。

“嗯……我知道鹰棘镇村庄在北方，所有商人都从那里来！ 我的村庄就在这里的西边。其实我不太了解其他情况，但是我听到过一些传闻，而且我觉得在猎人把我引开之前，我确实看到过一个农场。哦，真是太糟糕了……你看到他们是如何把我到处驱赶的吧。 我可从来没见过村子外面有什么，除了一片旷野而已，”她哼了一声，双手部一摊。[pc.isBimbo|哎呀，没关系啦！你太可爱了，根本不需要了解那些复杂的东西。那你听说过的那些事情呢？有没有什么有趣的吗？|嘿，没关系的。你说你听到了一些事情，是关于什么的呢？]你这么问，我还凑过去想拥抱你呢。当你拉开距离时，阿赫米看起来还是有些不高兴，不过他的眼神中已经充满了更多的决心。

“对了，就在南方，有马人村落。虽然我很不确定有没有半人马真正去过那里，但大家都知道它的位置。 在这一切混乱开始之前，猎人们很清楚该去哪里，这样才能避免进入马人领地太深。即使他们没有进入那些区域，也仍然不得不应对那些疯狂的雄性马人。她边说边似乎在思考着什么。
        
        爸爸总是提醒我们要小心那些马人，但我不明白为什么。他们和我们有相同的身体构造，而且我也听到过采集者们开玩笑地问，他们在完成那些‘初次任务’时是否帮助过哪些母马，所以他们也不可能全是坏人吧。 只有善良的人才会把它们称为“任务”，而坏人则会用“阴谋”或“宏伟计划”这样的词来形容。当然，那些家伙有时会做出疯狂的行为，但如果是这样的话，我们难道不应该携手部合作吗？我们的男性可不会这样做，至少在那个怪物来到这个山谷之前，他们是没有这样的行为的。”她说道。 你可以看到她的双拳紧握在腰间，脸上明显写满了惊慌。
        
        别担心，我们会想出办法来解决这个问题的，”你一边说，一边握住她的手部，看到她的紧张情绪有所缓解，你也露出了微笑。

“谢谢。呃，关于这个山谷，我其实也不太了解太多情况。 我其实并没有花太多时间去研究这个话题。当初爸爸讲历史的时候，我本应该多留心一些的，但我当时一直在幻想那些遥远国度里的巨龙，或者想象自己如果长了两条腿会是什么感觉。 尤其是足部趾！它们看起来太有趣了！”她兴奋地跳来跳去，看到你努力忍住不笑时，她的脸立刻红了。
        
        呃，抱歉。我们刚才在讨论那个山谷。那条大河的名字叫做塔拉胡甘河！它的发音是‘胡甘’，但实际上这条河是以铁心乌甘和他的妻子塔拉的名字命名的。以前那里根本没有这条河，而居住在这里的两支半人马部落彼此之间关系非常恶劣。 关于这场战争，有很多枯燥的历史记载，但关键在于：乌甘首领爱上了塔拉——那位位于北方的戈拉斯首领的妹妹。“阿赫米把一根乱窜的头发从眼前拨开，此刻，当涉及到这个显然属于某种传说的故事时，她显得格外专注起来。
        
        他们不得不将这份爱情隐藏起来，因为如果别人知道了他们相爱的事实，肯定会有人发怒的。乌甘可能会被废黜！塔拉可能会受到羞辱或者被流放！那些日子真是充满刺激啊！他们总是在收获的季节见面，因为那时两个部落都会把各自的产品带到山谷外去售卖。 在商队行进的过程中，两个部落的领袖们与当地人交往是很常见的现象，因此他们很容易见面，而不会引起任何怀疑。你能想象吗？如果每年只有一两周的时间能够见面，那该有多困难啊？ 他们肯定像狗头人一样疯狂做爱了吧！”那个身材魁梧的半人马女子兴奋地继续说道。
        
        如你可能已经猜到的那样，一切本来都进行得很顺利，直到塔拉怀孕了。我猜他们可能只是有一年忘记了使用避孕草药，但我觉得，如果他们真的想努力促进两个部落之间的联系，这样的安排反而更加浪漫。然而，他们的尝试并没有成功，最终他们被追到了那座大山的足部下。在那里，他们发现了躺在小溪边的露米娅女神——她当时也怀孕了，肚子已经大得快要裂开了。
        
        求您了，光明之神，请拯救我们，让我们摆脱部落里的这些愚蠢行为吧，”乌甘恳求道。卢米娅对他们俩笑了笑。在故事中，她有三十英尺高，甚至比一些巨人还要高。但她此刻正像人类女性生产时那样躺着，塔拉和乌甘能够清楚地看到她的脸。他们看到她正在忍受分娩的痛苦，但她仍然在回答他们的请求。
        
        孩子们，陪我待一会儿吧。你们的亲人不会毁掉你们这些精彩的创作。”她说着，邀请他们靠近一些。他们或许非常勇敢，但我肯定会吓得屁滚尿流——你能想象一个四十英尺高、会发光的女神邀请你陪她吗？我敢肯定Lumia一定非常迷人，但这种场景还是挺吓人的。总之，他们当然对她的怀孕情况感到好奇，也毫不畏惧地提出了这个问题。
        
        光明之神，您的劳作似乎让您感到压力很大。我们能做些什么来帮助您吗？”塔拉问道。

“看到自己创造的生命在体内逐渐成长，这就已经让我感到十分满足了，小家伙。我的劳作也即将结束了。”女神一边回答，一边因为突然使出的力气而露出了痛苦的表情。 那对夫妇捂住眼睛和耳朵，因为一阵震耳欲聋的巨响在洞穴中回荡，这种声响就像一场没有风却依然猛烈的飓风。当他们终于恢复视力时，那位女神已经不见了，取而代之的，是一条强大的地下溪流的源头。 他们俩走出洞穴，本以为会被自己的部落抓住，然而当他们来到外面时，却发现自己已经被女神改变了！阿赫米继续说道，一边叹息着，一边梦幻般地注视着你的眼睛。 她的故事似乎快要结束了。
        
        他们并没有立刻解决所有部落之间的矛盾，但重要的是，他们最终过上了幸福的生活。有些人认为，他们现在可能还在为Lumia效力呢。”她凝视了一会儿，突然似乎意识到了自己此刻所处的环境。
        
        啊，我并不是想长篇大论地讲这些。只是因为这个故事里有半人马的角色，所以它是我最喜欢的故事之一。不过我肯定也遗漏了一些细节，唉……”她把脸埋在双手部之间，脸颊顿时红到了耳根。你轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀，安慰她说，她绝对不是你听过的最糟糕的故事讲述者。或许你可以再问她一些其他的问题吧？

rows.original: Ahmri's lived here her entire life; she's got to know some interesting things about the valley.
rows.translation: 阿赫米在这里生活了一辈子，她肯定知道一些关于这个山谷的有趣的事情。
rows.raw: "Ahmri's lived here her entire life; she's got to know some interesting things about the valley."

rows.original:
"What about your village? Knowing the layout even a little could help," you ask. Ahmri brightens, giving you a determined look.

        "Yes! Definitely! I can help with that at least. The village isn't really in the valley proper, at least not exactly. It's tucked into a ravine back off that way," she says, vaguely indicating to the west. She takes a moment to think before continuing, patting at her forelegs with both hands.
        
        "It's a long, flat path from the entrance to the ravine to the village gates, and there aren't really any places to hide. Oh! But there's a couple pathways through the mountains. They aren't really meant to be used to get into the village 'cause it's kind of dangerous for us on the rocks like that, but you wouldn't have any trouble getting in that way! It's safe for one or two centaurs too, but they aren't gonna have guards or anything. Fighting on that kind of footing is a death trap," she says, shuddering at the thought and rubbing at one of her ankles.
        
        "Before that red witch turned my people into pillaging sex fiends, the gatherers used to get mountain herbs from the paths for use in healing poultices and tasty teas. Sometimes they'd even find these flowers that made the sweetest cakes I ever tasted! I don't think there's anyone left sane enough for anything like that, though. Unless they've moved things around since I ran, the mountain paths come in just behind the gatherers' huts. It'll leave you on the north end of the village, behind the main entrance." Ahmri makes gestures with her hands as she talks, trying to explain the layout of the village without actually being able to show you. It seems simple enough for you to not lose track, so far at least.
        
        "The village is laid out in a big circle, with the common housing right in the middle. Our, the chieftain's that is, housing is in the far back, nestled right up against the mountains.         "Oh it's easy. My daddy just trades, would trade for, whatever books the traders from Hawkethorne had. When I was little, it was just hearing stories. I had to learn to read and write letters like my daddy did just in case messages came from my mom up in the Far North. He learned how just to communicate with her. She doesn't send letters often, maybe once every couple years, but it's always really exciting when they come." Ahmri visibly brightens at the memory, toying with the fabric of her dress.
        
        "The last one was about her and her hunting troop rescuing a male minotaur who got stuck in a blizzard. Poor guy almost froze to death, but they warmed him right up with some sea narfle stew. I don't know what a sea narfle is, but apparently they make soup that keeps you real warm," she laughs. 
        
        "Once I knew most of the words, I started asking for books, and more books. I read whatever legends from whatever countries the traders had been to. The times when they came without books felt like the longest stretches of boredom ever. Right at the start I was still learning, so I had to ask daddy about the big words.         "I gravitated towards lewder stories when I got older: raunchy romances and the like. “哦，其实挺容易的。 我爸爸只是负责交易，他会收购鹰棘镇那些商人手中的各种书籍。在我小时候，我只能听他讲这些故事。后来我必须学会读书写字，就像我爸爸那样，这样万一我妈妈从遥远的北方寄来消息，我就能及时回复了。 他学会了如何与她沟通。她并不经常写信，也许每几年才会寄一次，但每当收到她的来信时，他总是会感到非常兴奋。想到这些，阿赫米的眼中明显闪烁着喜悦的光芒，她一边说着，一边摆弄着自己裙子的布料。
        
        最后一个故事是关于她和她的狩猎小队救出了一只被困在暴风雪中的雄性弥诺陶洛斯的。那可怜的家伙差点冻死，但他们用海纳夫尔炖汤把他暖和了起来。我不知道海纳夫尔是什么，但显然用它熬的汤能让人暖和起来。”她笑着说。 
        
        一旦我认识了大部分单词，我就开始要求得到更多的书。我阅读了商人们从各个国家带回的传说故事。每当他们没有带书来的时候，那些日子对我来说简直就是无休止的无聊。刚开始的时候，我还在学习，所以总是要向爸爸请教那些难懂的单词。不过最近，我不得不依靠上下文来自己理解这些词的意思。我想，对于解释猫族尾巴在卧室里能有什么用途，他可能就没那么有耐心了。”她害羞地笑了笑。
        
        年纪大了之后，我越来越喜欢看一些内容更露骨的故事了：那些色情浪漫小说之类的。那些商人真是帮了大忙，他们把那些书伪装成内容较为普通的书籍，这样我就可以把它们和其他藏书一起藏起来，不会被人发现。哦，希望在我们拯救村庄之前，他们不会把那些书烧掉或者搞丢什么的。里面还有一些内容，我打算试着用它们来帮助半人马们。”她脸红了，用炽热的眼神看着你。看来，这确实是一个应该尽快解决半人马们问题的理由啊。
        
        除此之外，我总体上就是很喜欢浪漫故事。即使书中没有提到任何具体的情节，我也能在那些没有详细描述的细节中想象出那些场景。有时候，这样的想象甚至比那些情节直白的爱情小说还要精彩。 他们似乎总是更关注这些故事中的角色，所以这样的翻译工作也就很容易完成。当我还是个孩子的时候，我就会特别喜欢那些关于骑士与邪恶巨龙战斗以拯救公主的故事，或者关于公主与邪恶骑士战斗以拯救巨龙的故事！啊姆里显然非常兴奋，她谈论那些普通的传奇故事时，和谈论色情内容时一样开心。从她谈论这两者的方式来看，她似乎从两者中都获得了灵感。 
        
        如果没有我的那些资料，我也没什么更多可以说的了。不过等我们回到家，一切都安全了，我一定会让你们看的。那么，在这之前，还有什么你们想了解的吗？”她说道。

rows.original:
Fuck the wait! Ahmri's been reading about these kinds of things her whole life, why should she wait when she has the opportunity to experience them now? It's not like this will stop your progress on finding a way to deal with her village. And besides, the both of you could use the stress relief. You saunter closer as you speak, running a teasing hand through the fluffy white fuzz on the unsure centaur's flanks. She shudders at your touch, looking back at you with a mix of stoic confidence and wanton lust.

            "Well... I guess it's ok. I do get bored just reading about things," she says, her eyes never leaving your fingers as they dance across her equine ass. All it takes is one final gentle squeeze to push her over the edge. She relents swiftly, pushing against you with fervent need before plopping down at your feet. She pats her forequarters nervously and gives you a questioning look.

You ask the sun-kissed centaur how she'd like it if you went for a 'ride' on her back. She perks up instantly, trotting close and swallowing you in a tight embrace.

    "Anytime, for you," she promises, rubbing your nose with her own. She breaks her hug and drops down at your feet, patting her backside and eyeing you needfully.

你问那位被阳光亲吻的半人马，如果你想要骑在她的背上“兜风”，她会不会乐意。她立刻变得兴奋起来，快步走到你身边，然后用一个紧紧的拥抱将你拥入怀中。

“随时都可以，只要你愿意，”她承诺道，同时用自己的鼻子轻轻蹭你的鼻子。她松开拥抱，蹲在你的足部边，拍拍自己的屁股，然后用充满依赖的眼神看着你。

A wedge sits on the lip of the bowl, overhanging the three rings and shedding a single thread of shadow across them, almost like a pointer. Perhaps if you moved the rings a certain way...]

rows.original:
You're staring down in the moonlit bowl and its three concentric stone rings. The top represents the rising and falling of the sun, the middle the ebb and flow of stars, and the bottom, the waxing and waning of the moon. A single wedge atop the bowl marks the center position, you suspect, beneath which are the following symbols:

    Sun: 	[var0 Rising High Setting Hidden]
    Stars: 	[var1 Glimmering Shrouded Glimmering Shining]
    Moon: 	[var2 Gibbous Crescent New Full]
    
    Which ring do you move, and in which direction?
rows.translation:
你凝视着那个被月光照亮的碗状物，以及它上面那三个同心圆的石环。最上面的圆环象征着太阳的升起与落下，中间的圆环代表星星的盈亏变化，而最下面的圆环则象征着月亮的阴晴圆缺。碗状物的顶部有一个楔形标记，你猜测，这个标记指示着中心位置——而在那里，应该藏着以下这些符号：

太阳： 	[var0 Rising High Setting Hidden]
    星星： 	[var1 Glimmering Shrouded Glimmering Shining]
    月亮： 	[var2 Gibbous Crescent New Full]
    
    你应该移动哪一枚戒指，以及朝哪个方向移动呢？

rows.original: Something clicks beneath the stone rings, followed by a hiss of air. The full moon symbol slides off the ring it's attached to, clattering off into the middle of the bowl and revealing a small chamber beneath. You reach your fingers inside and withdraw the contents. All that's inside is a small but well-painted wooden figure in the shape of an ancient Belharan hoplite, clad in golden-bronze muscled armor and carrying a spear and round shield. She's wearing a helmet with a purple plume, with holes cut in the side to make room for long elven ears. Her shield carries a quartered moon crest painted in what must be lapis lazuli. Strange that such a simple toy would be so richly decorated, and command such elaborate protection. You suppose you'll take it. There doesn't seem to be a way to seal it back in, even if you wanted to. As you pocket the painted figure, you feel a cool breeze blow across the boneyard, blowing away the accumulated leaves. You glance skyward, to the crescent sliver of the pale white moon high above you. For a brief second, you can't shake the feeling that it's bearing down on you, close enough to reach out and touch; that the touch of the night wind on your [pc.skinFurScales] is a gentle caress. You've learned the Summon Hoplite power.
rows.translation: 石环下方传来“咔嗒”一声，紧接着是一阵空气流动的声音。那个象征满月的符号从它所连接的环上脱落，掉进了碗的中央，从而暴露出了下方的一个小房间。 你将手指伸进去，取出了里面的东西。 里面只有一个小小的、绘制精美的木制雕像，它呈古代贝尔哈兰重装步兵的形状，身着金色青铜制成的肌肉纹饰盔甲，手持长矛和圆形盾牌。雕像头戴一顶带有紫色羽饰的头盔，头盔两侧还开了孔，以便长耳精灵的耳朵能够穿过。 她的盾牌上绘有四分之月的图案，那些颜色想必是用青金石染成的。奇怪的是，这样一个简单的玩具竟然会被装饰得如此华丽，而且还配备了如此精巧的防护装置。 你该会想要拿走它吧？看来即使你想把它重新装回去，也找不到办法做到这一点。 当你将那个涂了颜色的小雕像收进口袋时，一阵凉风掠过这片骨灰堆，吹走了堆积在上面的落叶。你抬头望向天空，那轮淡白色的新月高悬在头顶。有那么一瞬间，你无法摆脱这样的感觉：那轮新月仿佛离你非常近，近到仿佛伸手就能触碰到它；而夜风拂过你的脸庞，也仿佛带着某种特殊的意味…… [pc.skinFurScales] 就像是一次轻柔的抚触。 你已经掌握了“召唤重装步兵”这一技能。.

rows.original:
As you wander the valley, you come upon the remains of a small wooden fence, tall enough to mark a boundary, but too small to prevent entry or exit from whatever it once encircled. You step over the stout barrier, unimpeded by the tiny wood stakes. As soon as your [pc.feet] are over the threshold you become aware of a grove of trees that simply wasn't there before. Each tree is covered in large gold skinned apples, hanging heavy on every visible branch. 
    
    The scent is unbelievable, filling your mind with thoughts of a full belly. You find yourself closer to the trees with every blink, reaching out with one hand to pluck the closest apple from its perch. Just before your fingertips reach the fruit, an axe buries itself in the tree next to you. You flinch, pulling your hand back and turning to see a well muscled centaur woman, her dusky skin slick with sweat. She regards you with an odd mix of curiosity and distaste.
    
    "Do you make a habit of eating everything you see?" she asks, cocking an eyebrow. 
    
    The fruity blanket is temporarily lifted from your mind, leaving you to shake your head in half-thinking embarrassment. The centaur braces herself with a hoof, wrenching the axe from the tree and taking another swing at the weakened section. The impact knocks a few apples loose, and they tumble to the ground. A stretch of ground you now note to be scattered with bones.
    
    There are a couple full-on skeletons, but most of them are just odd animal ribs or limb bones, covered in moss so thick they blend right in with the natural flora of the area. The more humanoid bones are all piled near the fence, and none show signs of a violent death. In fact every single one lies peacefully on their stomach or backs, some with heads resting on the bottom most fence post.
    
    You also notice that [party.som
        |that fence is several paces behind you.
        |[companion1.name] is nowhere to be seen.
        |your companions are nowhere to be seen.
    ] Whatever that bit of magic was, it had you ensorcelled to the point where you couldn't think of anything else. This centauress interrupted it before it could truly get its hooks in you, but there's no real way of telling whether she's a friend or elaborate bait. For now, though, it doesn't seem like she exudes the same magical draw.
    
    "Hey, you doing alright? I know this can be kinda weird the first time, but I got you before the apples did, so don't look so glum," the chocolate-skinned half-horse says, lightheartedly slapping your cheek to bring you further out of your stupor. 
    
    "Come on, I'll cook you a steak or something back at my lodge, whatever it is people eat these days. Follow close, I don't want to see you eyeing up a single one of these trees," she says, tugging you along before she turns to head deeper into the orchard, leaving the axe embedded in the trunk. 
    
    Her warning sounded stern, but you don't need much convincing once you've fallen in behind her. There aren't any more skeletons deeper in, but now that the enchantment's been shaken it's not coming back for now. The sashaying of tauric hips might be a different kind of enchanting, but there's no magical compulsion on that front. Her equine rear isn't covered at all, and it's possible to sneak glimpses of a plump and dark slit nestled at its center if you so desire.
rows.translation:
当你漫步在山谷中时，你会看到一排矮小的木栅栏的残骸。这些栅栏的高度足以标示出某个边界，但显然太矮小了，根本无法阻止任何人进出它曾经围住的区域。你轻松地跨过了这些粗短的木桩，没有任何阻碍。 [pc.feet] 当你越过那个临界点时，你会突然注意到一片原本并不存在的树林。每一棵树上都挂满了金黄色的苹果，那些苹果重型地悬挂在每一个可见的枝条上。

那种香气简直令人难以置信，它会让你的脑海中充满对美食的向往。 每一次眨眼，你都会发现自己离那些树木更近了一些，你伸出一只手，想要摘下离自己最近的那个苹果。就在你的指尖即将触到果实的瞬间，一把斧头猛地刺入了你旁边的树干。你吓得立刻缩回了手，转过头去，看到了一位肌肉结实的半人马女性，她那黝黑的皮肤上布满了汗水。 她以一种既好奇又反感的态度看待你。
    
    你是不是有什么习惯，看到什么就吃什么？”她挑着眉毛问道。

这时，你脑海中那些关于水果的念头暂时被抛到了一边，你只能尴尬地摇摇头。半人马用蹄子稳住身体，从树上拔下斧头，再次朝那根已经腐烂的树枝砍去。这一击使得几颗苹果脱落，它们滚落到地上——而你现在注意到，那片地上散落着许多骨头。
    
    那里有几具完整的骷髅，但大多数都只是一些形状怪异的动物肋骨或四肢骨骼，上面覆盖着厚厚的苔藓，因此与周围的自然植被融为一体。那些更接近人类骨骼的遗骸都被堆放在靠近围栏的地方，而且没有任何迹象表明这些生物是死于暴力。事实上，每一具骨骼都安详地躺在那里，有的是腹部着地，有的是背部朝上，有些甚至头部还抵在围栏的最低处。
    
    你也注意到了这一点。 [party.som
        |那道栅栏就在你身后几步远的地方。
        |[companion1.name] 根本看不到它。
        |你的同伴却不见踪影。
    ] 无论那种魔力是什么，它都让你完全着了迷，以至于你再想不了其他任何事情。这位半人马女在那种魔力真正对你产生影响之前，及时打破了这种状态，但实在很难判断她到底是你的朋友，还是精心设计的诱饵。 不过，目前看来，她似乎不再具备那种令人着迷的魅力了。

“嘿，你没事吧？我知道第一次遇到这种事情可能会让人觉得有点奇怪，但我可比那些苹果先找到了你，所以别这么闷闷不乐啦。”那个皮肤呈巧克力色的半马人轻声说道，还轻轻拍了拍你的脸颊，想让你从那种恍惚状态中清醒过来。 
    
    来吧，我会在我的小屋里为你做一份牛排，或者现在人们常吃的别的什么食物。跟紧点，我可不想看到你盯着这些树看个不停。”她说着，拉着你继续往果园深处走去，把那把斧头留在了树干上。 
    
    她的警告听起来很严厉，但一旦你跟在她身后，就不再需要什么说服了。再没有其他隐藏的秘密了，不过既然那个魔法效果已经被打破了，暂时也不会再恢复了。那些摇摆的臀部或许会带来另一种魅力，但在这方面并没有任何魔法上的强制力。 她的臀部完全没有遮盖，如果你愿意的话，甚至可以隐约看到其中心那处饱满而黝黑的缝隙。

    "Do you make a habit of eating everything you see?" she asks, cocking an eyebrow. 
    
    The fruity blanket is temporarily lifted from your mind, leaving you to shake your head in half-thinking embarrassment. The centaur braces herself with a hoof, wrenching the axe from the tree and taking another swing at the weakened section. The impact knocks a few apples loose, and they tumble to the ground. A stretch of ground you now note to be scattered with bones.
    
    There are a couple full-on skeletons, but most of them are just odd animal ribs or limb bones, covered in moss so thick they blend right in with the natural flora of the area. The more humanoid bones are all piled near the fence, and none show signs of a violent death. In fact every single one lies peacefully on their stomach or backs, some with heads resting on the bottom most fence post.
    
    You also notice that [party.som
        |that fence is several paces behind you.
        |[companion1.name] is nowhere to be seen.
        |your companions are nowhere to be seen.
    ] Whatever that bit of magic was, it had you ensorcelled to the point where you couldn't think of anything else. This centauress interrupted it before it could truly get its hooks in you, but there's no real way of telling whether she's a friend or elaborate bait. For now, though, it doesn't seem like she exudes the same magical draw.
    
    "Hey, you doing alright? I know this can be kinda weird the first time, but I got you before the apples did, so don't look so glum," the chocolate-skinned half-horse says, lightheartedly slapping your cheek to bring you further out of your stupor. 
    
    "Come on, I'll cook you a steak or something back at my lodge, whatever it is people eat these days. Follow close, I don't want to see you eyeing up a single one of these trees," she says, tugging you along before she turns to head deeper into the orchard, leaving the axe embedded in the trunk. 
    
    Her warning sounded stern, but you don't need much convincing once you've fallen in behind her. There aren't any more skeletons deeper in, but now that the enchantment's been shaken it's not coming back for now. The sashaying of tauric hips might be a different kind of enchanting, but there's no magical compulsion on that front. Her equine rear isn't covered at all, and it's possible to sneak glimpses of a plump and dark slit nestled at its center if you so desire.
    "

rows.original: The two of you walk for a minute or two, quickly reaching a sizable lodge tucked snugly between a group of larger trees. It looks positively ancient, like it's been there for just as long as the trees themselves. Despite its apparent age, however, it looks wonderfully maintained. You follow her through the front door, and right into a spacious living area. A chair large enough to be considered a couch by a non-centaur is situated nearby a cozy-looking fireplace and an overfull bookshelf. There's also a simple kitchen in one corner with a wood stove and a countertop full of assorted cooking utensils. "I, uh, hope you like ox. They're the only beasts that reliably wander in these days," she apologizes in advance, pulling a large slab of meat from a barrel of ice. She takes a huge, sharp knife from under the counter, precisely slicing a few handfuls of thin strips from the hunk of flank. Replacing the knife, she next pulls up an iron wok, trotting over to the stove and setting the logs inside aflame. The midnight-dark mare works like a professional cook, whisking the meat around in the wok before it sits anywhere for too long. She tosses a few dried vegetables and spices in with oil to season and flavor the meat. This sudden display of expertise keeps you just as hypnotized as you were by the enchanted apples, without the need for magical coercion. Not five minutes later she canters back, placing a small plate of steaming meat in front of you. Hints of paprika and peppers drift to your nose, masking the ever present saccharine haze in the air with an equally enticing smell. The meat tastes as good as it smells, filling your mouth with a flood of juices. Every bite of steak fills you with renewed energy. Maybe you should be a little suspicious, what with her description of the apples, but nothing about the meat shares the same feel from before. You're perfectly capable of looking around and even feeling like you could leave. The dusky centaur watches you eat with her chin in her palms, leaning heavy on the counter. "Aren't you going to have any?" you ask when she continues to stare. She looks confused for a moment, and then a flash of recognition lights up her features. "O-oh yeah. That's normal, isn't it. I don't need to eat in this place, so I kind of forget sometimes. It's been awhile since I had a guest. An intelligent one anyway," she explains, idly glancing down at your plate of steak. When you return her prior confusion she continues. "The orchard I mean," she continues, gesturing to a window and outside. "It's got a curse on it, and I kinda fell right into it and wound up stuck here. It's complicated, but I don't need to eat or drink as long as I stay here. I don't need to sleep either but I kept doing that anyway to keep my sanity. It's just been a... couple years since I talked to anybody. My name is Caliope, by the way," "That's ok, I'm pretty used to running into situations where talking isn't the first thing people go for. It's a refreshing change," you say, giving her your best disarming smile. She giggles, visibly loosening up. "Yeah... I'm just glad I got to you before you got to the apples. One or two aren't too bad, but they've got this nasty compulsion tied to them the more you eat. If you eat too many and then try to leave they'll suck the life right out of your body. You also don't get immortality, Or at least nobody else has. I don't know why I was any different, but I guess I was the first person to come in?" "Wait. You're immortal? Just how long have you been here? What do you consider a 'couple years' as far as conversation partners?" you ask, raising an eyebrow. "Oh, it can't be that long, um..." she says, breaking eye contact. "I... have no idea. The last guy had heard of the apples though. He wanted them to live forever and conquer some far off country. It didn't work out how he wanted. Surely they're still talked about, even if they're really old stories?" [pc.bg scholar |You think long and hard, but you can't recall any tales about golden apples of immortality. You do, however, recall a story about a would-be conqueror of the Ayangatai steppe who gathered a sizeable force through brutal cunning, only to vanish without a trace before he could bring his plans to fruition. The historical accounts figured he had been murdered by competing tribe leaders, but none had ever come forth to claim credit, and no body was ever found. That was ages past, however, a story nearly faded into myth... |You can't recall any such stories exactly. There are plenty of myths and tales about sources of immortality, but you can't recall any that involve magical orchards or golden apples. Maybe there was a fairy tale or two with golden apples, but nothing like this. ] "O-oh... How did you find me, then? Ancient library? Top of a mountain? One visitor swam through a hole at the bottom of the ocean after her ship capsized. She chose not to go back on purpose." "I'm afraid it's nothing quite so grandiose," you explain. "I just found a little section of fence and hopped over it. I figured it was from an old farm." "Nice," she says with a happy sigh. "At least the trip isn't tough." "Right, the trip. Speaking of..." "Oh! Right! I probably should've started with that. You can just come and go if the place you got in from is safe. Uhhhh only you can come in, or at least no one in the past has been able to bring people in. Assuming you don't eat too many apples, anyway." "Do people usually stay?" "Look. I'm not gonna be able to hold back some bias. Some people stay a while, some people leave right away, others go back and forth. I'm very much in camp 'please come back often enough that I don't just assume I've finally gone mad and that you were some kind of apple-based illusion'. At the very least if you aren't the type to stick around, would you mind spreading the story a bit? Maybe that'll get me some more consistent company. I think it used to be more regular. A long time ago."
rows.translation: 你们俩走了一两分钟，很快就来到了一座规模不小的小屋前。这座小屋紧挨着几棵较大的树木，看起来确实非常古老，仿佛与这些树木一同存在了很久。然而，尽管它显得如此陈旧，却保养得非常好。 你跟着她穿过前门，立刻进入了一个宽敞的客厅。在一张看起来很舒适的壁炉旁，摆放着一把足以被非半人马视为沙发的椅子，还有一个摆满书籍的书架。房间的一个角落里还设有一个简单的厨房，里面有一台木炉，以及一个摆满各种烹饪工具的操作台。 呃，希望你们会喜欢牛肉。在如今这个年代，牛才是唯一会定期在这附近游荡的动物呢。”她事先就道了歉，然后从一桶冰块中取出一大块肉。她从柜台下拿出一把锋利的刀，熟练地将那块肉切成几小块薄条。放回刀后，她又拿了一个铁锅，快步走到炉子旁，点起了里面的木柴。 这只通体漆黑的母马行事起来就像一位专业厨师一样：她迅速将肉在炒锅中翻炒，确保肉不会在锅中停留太久。她还加入了一些干蔬菜和香料，再淋上油，这样既能给肉增添风味，也能让肉更加入味。这种娴熟的烹饪技巧立刻让你着迷，就像那些被施了魔法的苹果一样，完全不需要任何魔法的力量。不到五分钟，她就端着一小盘热气腾腾的肉回到了你面前。 空气中弥漫着辣椒和红椒的香气，这种诱人的味道有效地掩盖了空气中那股始终存在的甜腻气息。肉的味道与它的香气一样诱人，每一口都会让口中充满鲜美的汁液，每一口牛排都能为你带来新的活力。 也许你应该多疑一些，毕竟她对苹果的描述和之前没什么不同，但肉类的情况却完全不一样了。你完全有能力环顾四周，甚至觉得可以随时离开这里。 那个皮肤黝黑的人马托着下巴，倚在柜台上，静静地看着你进食。 你不会也要吃点什么吧？”当你看到她继续发呆时，你问道。她愣了一下，随后脸上突然露出了恍然大悟的表情。 “哦，对哦。这是很正常的吧？我在这里不需要吃饭，所以有时候就会忘掉这件事。已经有一段时间没有招待过客人了……至少是没有招待过像你这样聪明的客人。”她边说，边随意地瞥了瞥你盘子里的牛排。当你再次提到她之前的困惑时，她继续说道。 我指的是那个果园，”她继续说道，同时指向窗外，“那个果园被下了诅咒，而我不知不觉就陷入了其中，就这样被困在了这里。情况有点复杂，但只要待在这里，我就不需要吃饭或喝水。也不需要睡觉，不过为了保持理智，我还是会继续睡觉。其实，我已经有好几年没有和任何人说过话了。顺便说一下，我的名字叫卡利俄佩。 没关系，我已经习惯了遇到那种人们不会首先选择通过谈话来解决问题的情况。这种变化倒还挺让人耳目一新的。”你说道，同时向她露出了最真诚、最能消除敌意的微笑。 她轻声笑了起来，明显放松了许多。 “是啊……我只是很高兴能在你吃到那些苹果之前找到你。吃一两个苹果倒没什么，但一旦你吃多了，就会产生一种难以抗拒的欲望——越吃越多。如果你吃得太多了，然后试图离开，那些苹果就会把你身上的力气全部吸干。”她接着说道。 不要 获得永生，或者至少成为唯一拥有永生的人。我不知道自己为什么与众不同，但我想我应该是第一个来到这里的人吧？” “等等。你真的永生了？那你在这里已经待了多久了？对于你来说，‘几年的时间’意味着什么？这些时间里，你遇到了多少个可以交谈的对象呢？你这么问，让我不禁挑起了眉毛。” “哦，应该不会那么久吧，嗯……”她说道，同时移开了目光。“我真的不知道。不过上一个听说这件事的人，他希望那些苹果能永远存活下去，然后去征服一些遥远的国度。 事情并没有按照他预想的方式发展。那些事情现在应该还在被人们谈论吧，即使它们已经是很久以前发生的事了。 [pc.bg scholar |你绞尽脑汁，却想不起任何关于长生不老的金苹果的故事。 做然而，我记得有一个关于一位试图征服阿扬加泰草原的征服者的故事。他通过极其狡猾的手段聚集了一支庞大的军队，但在即将实现自己的计划之前，却神秘地消失了，踪迹全无。历史记载推测他是被其他部落的首领们杀害的，但始终没有人站出来承认这一事实，也没有任何尸体被找到。那已经是很久以前的事了，那个故事几乎已经变成了传说…… |你实在想不起有任何这样的故事。关于长生不老的来源，确实有很多神话和传说，但你想不起来有任何故事中提到了魔法果园或金苹果。也许有一两个童话故事里提到了金苹果，但绝对没有像这样的事情。 ] 哦……那你是怎么找到我的呢？是古老的图书馆？还是山顶的某个地方？还是说有位游客在船只失事后来到海洋深处的一个洞穴里，然后她故意选择不再离开那里？” “其实，原因并没有那么复杂，”你解释道。 我刚刚发现了一小段围栏，就翻了过去。我觉得那应该是一个旧农场的围栏。” “不错，”她开心地叹了口气说，“至少这段路走起来并不费劲。” “是啊，就是这段路。说起来……哦！对了！我或许应该先从这一点开始讲。只要你进入的那个地方是安全的，你就可以自由进出。嗯……只有你才能进入那里，至少过去从来没有人能够把别人带进去。 假设你不会吃太多苹果的话，当然没问题。” “人们通常会留下来吗？” “听着，我难免会有一些偏见。有些人会留下来一段时间，有些人会立刻离开，还有些人则会来回往返。 我完全站在“请经常回来吧，这样我就不会以为自己终于疯掉了，或者认为你只是某种由苹果引发的幻觉”这一边。至少，如果你不是那种会长期留在某个地方的人，能不能请你帮忙把这件事传播开呢？ 也许这样我就能遇到一些更稳定的合作伙伴了。我觉得以前这种情况要常见一些，是很久以前的事了。

rows.original:
The mystical orchard looks like a maze, but you're always able to find your way here to the lodge. If Callie's ever not around when you arrive, you at least know where to wait for her. As is, however, she wanders around doing chores while you enjoy the lodge's comforts. She's always around if you need her, checking up on you every so often.

    What did you come to visit for today?
rows.translation:
这个神秘的果园看起来就像一个迷宫，但你总能找到通往小屋的路。如果你到达的时候Callie不在，至少你也知道该在哪里等她。不过，实际上她总是忙于各种家务，而你则可以享受小屋带来的舒适。只要你需要她，她总会出现在你身边，时不时地来看看你。

那么，你今天是来这里做什么的呢？

rows.translation: 问问卡莉是否有空一起玩玩吧。

rows.translation: 你们之间的关系还不够亲密，还不适合做这件事。

rows.translation: 帮助卡莉排出一些乳汁吧。

rows.translation: 卡利俄佩最近被“榨取”得太多了。

rows.translation: 送一些来自外界的东西给卡莉吧。
rows.raw: "Gift Callie some things from the outside world."

Caliope is a well-muscled centauress, standing an imposing ten feet tall. She's tall enough to pick the lower apples straight from the orchards trees, and packing a strong enough kick to knock the stragglers from their perches. The skin of her human half is a dusky brown, and her equine coat is black as midnight. Equally dark hair is tied in a dreadlocked pony-tail that bounces around with the motion of her head. Bright hazel eyes mark a steep contrast to the rest of her features, joined in brightness only by the golden lipstick that paints her smile.

    With all of her clothing being make-shift cloth, Callie's E-cup tits are barely contained. They stretch the fabric when she flexes, and you can clearly see the impression of stud piercings through her nipples. They definitely look like the softest part of her, wrapped as snugly as they are. They accentuate her powerful stomach quite swimmingly, and it's a bit tough trying not to stare once you've started.
    
    Still, you manage to keep your perusal going on to her equine end. The midnight expanse of her hindquarters is marred only by the occasional fallen leaf that sticks to the sweat of exertion. They get swished away by her tail soon enough, but it's still quite charming. There's as much muscle in her powerful thighs as there is in her arms. You might have wondered at first if she ever felt threatened by angry or nasty visitors, but one kick from her could probably cave in the armor of most warriors.
    
    She opts to leave her equine end completely uncovered, and if you so desire you can steal glimpses of her dusky horse-pussy and donut asshole as she goes about her business. A row of stud piercings travels up her outer walls as well, ending before they reach either extreme. Additionally, she has a pair of swollen udders between her thighs. Occasionally if her thighs squeeze around them, you can see a droplet of cloudy amber bead upon them.
    
    The tauric woman gives you a smile when she sees you looking, and then continues about her chores.
