Nothing [party.solo |you’ve |anybody’s ] taken is serious; you’ve made it through the altercation without much problem. You check on the lupine fighter next. It’s clear to you that she’s able to take care of herself, and you doubt this is the first time she’s had to deal with some ornery centaurs, especially given where she is, but still, she took that nasty clip to the shoulder before the fight started, [party.has cait |and you may have to ask Cait to give her a hand[silly |. A cat healing a dog – what a world! ] |and you may need to lend her a hand yourself ]. [var0 |And you want to ask her about that one strike she made – she isn’t a particularly large or musclebound woman, and to put such force behind a single strike... it piqued your interest, to put it one way. ] She’s standing off to the side of the freshly-trampled clearing, tending to her injured shoulder. Now that the fighting is over, you have the opportunity to get a better look at her: She stands roughly a little less than six feet tall, but it’s hard to gauge from her hunched-over position. Her fur is long and straight all throughout, but a bit coarse and dirty, and you aren’t sure how much of that is from the fighting. Her fur has darker, bolder colors to them: browns and tans along her head, neck, and shoulders, faded into a dark black in the back and into a stark white along her front, from her neck down. She has long, triangular ears pointed straight up on her head, framing a head of dusky-black, back-length hair that, interestingly, has been braided into four, long strands, each of them capped with a bulbous knot of hair. Her eyes are a dark, deep, emerald-green. She wears a long, white, flowing two-piece [pc.isDK |costume |clothing ], loosely clinging to her form, especially around her arms and wrists, held in place by a slightly-darker belt around her waist, and, most distractingly of all, she’s wearing a silver mask that covers most of her face above her mouth. But that’s all fairly cursory: she’s injured, and you’re more interested in her gash than what she looks like. Her hand is covering the wound, but even still, you can see how bad it is from here: rivulets of blood cascade down her shoulder and along the side of her breast, leaking from between her fingers. The blood stains her fur and her clothes a dark red, and you can hear its drips fall to the grove’s floor beneath her. Her eyes are closed in concentration, probably trying to keep her focus to keep from blacking out. And, from the corner of your eye, you see her hair swish behind her – it’s probably the wind, if it’s anything at all. [pc.cl whitemage |It’s a fairly deep wound, and it’s going to leave quite the scar, but you’ve seen, and you’ve healed, worse. You |[pc.dcb |It’s hardly the worst injury you’ve ever seen or heard of. A warrior of her caliber is going to be fine with a bit of healing. You |Gods, that looks like it stings. You had better get to helping her dressing the wound; you |That’s... not a scrape that a kiss can make better. You don’t know a lot about medicine or healing or anything, but you know enough to survive. You ] ] tell her to keep pressure on it while you go [pc.cl whitemage | prepare your magics |[party.has cait |get Cait |get some medical supplies ] ] – but, just as you turn, her hand drops. [pc.dcb |She must be deaf. Or dumb. |You assume the worst, and that she’s already losing her strength from blood loss. |You nearly say it again, but louder. ] Before you get another word out, she tugs at her top, pulling it down over her shoulder, to inspect the wound. It’s gone. She runs her fingers through her fur; there isn’t so much as a scab, let alone a scar. It was as if it had never happened. She rotates her shoulder a few times, testing how limber it is and if there are any lingering aches or pains. She doesn’t even wince. She pulls her top back up over her shoulder, and there’s a puncture in the fabric over where the hole in her body should be, so you know you’re not going crazy. It was all real. You vividly remember seeing her blood arc through the air after she was stabbed – you can still see the blood on her body and on her clothes. When she finally looks up at you, seeing you stare dumbly at her, she smiles. And she says nothing. Clearly, it’s up to you to break the ice. "

rows.original:
[pc.dcb
        |"What the hell?" you finally ask once your brain finally manages to put some words together.
        |"Are... are you alright?" you finally ask; the answer’s probably a forgone conclusion, but....
        |"Wow, that’s a handy trick!" you say, pointing to her shoulder, your finger nearly close enough to poke her. "How’d you do that?"
    ]
    
    Her well-meaning smile doesn’t waver, but she also doesn’t answer with anything beyond a shrug. In fact, she doesn’t say anything at all. The seconds tick by uncomfortably without a response, until, eventually, you figure out that you’re not going to get one.

rows.original: [pc.dcb |You extend your hand and say your name, then ask if she has one. |You clear your throat and shuffle your feet before you extend your hand to her. You introduce yourself and ask her what her name is. |You tell her that she’s cute, and ask her what her name is. Oh – you introduce yourself first, then you ask her. ] The lupine woman accepts your handshake, pumping twice with a firm grip, but, once again, does not answer – at least, not with words. As soon as the handshake is done, she brings her hands together, her left hand facing out and her right facing in. She presses the tips of her thumbs together diagonally, and then extends both of her index fingers straight out, pointing left and right, curling all the others into loose fists. She nods to her hands, pushing them towards you, and she looks into your eyes. You aren’t sure what this is, or what she’s trying to signal to you – all you did was ask her for her name– You squint at her hands and the very specific way her fingers are lined up. Your eyes trace the outline of the pattern, and you recognize it as the letter Z. Is she... trying to answer your question? "Z?" you ask. Her smile spreads wider, into a full-blown, toothy grin, and she nods vigorously enough for her ears to bob from the motion. Delighted that you understood her efforts and the meaning she’s trying to get across, she eagerly makes the next letter: both of her hands face outward, and she presses the tips of her thumbs and index fingers together, curving them slightly. It’s just a big circle. "O?" you ask, and she nods again, her eyes turning into crescents underneath her huge smile. Then, she puts down both her hands. She doesn’t attempt to spell out any more of her name. You wait another, uncomfortably-long moment in total silence with her. "Is there... not any more?" you tentatively ask. She shakes her head. "Your name is Zo?" you ask, and she nods, reaching for both of your hands and grasping them gently. You get the feeling that she doesn’t often get the chance to communicate with anyone, and being with someone that can call her by her name must be refreshing. [pc.dcb |You ask her if all that was really necessary. |You openly assume that she must have a reason for keeping quiet. |You ask her what the matter is – catfolk got her tongue or something? ] In response, she turns her face upward, her face pointed straight up towards the sky, but her eyes stay on yours. Across her neck is a long, deep, old scar, going across from side to side. Her throat’s been sliced open. She literally cannot speak. [pc.isDK |You ask her why she didn’t heal that one. Her smile from earlier fades into an un-amused frown, and she turns one index finger over the other several times, mimicking the motion of a wheel. It’s a long story, apparently, and you shouldn’t expect to be told it anytime soon. ]Well, that explains the silence. You tell her that you didn’t mean to impose, but she smiles, winks, and motions to the ground a few times. It’s probably not the first time she’s had to explain her muteness, and even then, she just looks happy to be communicating with someone.
rows.translation: [pc.dcb |你伸出手，报出自己的名字，然后询问她是否有名字。 |你清了清嗓子，挪了挪脚步，然后伸出手向她介绍自己，并询问她的名字。 |你告诉她她很可爱，然后问她叫什么名字。哦——你最好先自我介绍一下。 然后 你去问她吧。 ] 那位身着狼族服饰的女子握住了你的手部，紧紧地握了两次，但同样，她没有回答你的问题——至少没有用言语来回答。握手部结束后，她将双手部合拢，左手部朝外，右手部朝内，然后将拇指的指尖对角线地压在一起，接着将两根食指伸直，分别指向左右两侧，其余的手部指则自然地弯曲成松开的拳头。 她点了点头，将双手部朝你伸来，同时注视着你的眼睛。你完全不明白这是什么意思，也不明白她想要向你表达什么——你当时只是问了她名字而已…… 你仔细观察她的双手部，以及她手部指的排列方式。你的目光顺着那图案的轮廓移动，最终认出了那是一个字母“Z”。难道她……是在试图回答你的问题吗？ Z？”你问道。她的笑容变得更加灿烂，露出了一口整整齐齐的牙齿，然后用力地点了点头，以至于耳朵都因为这个动作而晃动起来。看到你理解了她的意图以及她想要表达的意思，她非常高兴，于是急切地做出了下一个字母的形状：她的双手部朝外，将拇指和食指的指尖轻轻捏在一起，弯曲成一个小圆圈。这个字母就是“O”。 哦？”你问道，而她再次点了点头，那灿烂的笑容让她的双眼仿佛弯成了月牙。 然后，她放下了双手部。她没有再试图拼出自己名字的其余部分。你又陷入了另一种令人尴尬的沉默之中，与她一起静静地等待着。 难道……再也没有了吗？”你小心翼翼地问道。她摇了摇头。 “你的名字叫佐吗？”你问道，她点了点头，然后伸手部握住了你的双手部，轻轻地握了握。你感觉到，她应该并不经常有机会与他人交流，而能够有一个叫她名字的人陪伴在她身边，对她来说一定是一件很愉快的事情。 [pc.dcb |你问她，究竟是否有必要做所有这些事情。 |你显然认为，她保持沉默一定有原因。 |你问她发生了什么事——是猫人族把她的舌头弄掉了还是怎么回事？ ] 作为回应，她将脸转向上方，脸庞直直地朝向天空，但她的目光依然紧盯着你。她的脖子上有一道长长的、深深的疤痕，从一侧延伸到另一侧——她的喉咙曾经被割开了。 真的说不出话来。 [pc.isDK |你问她为什么没有治愈那个伤。 她先前的笑容渐渐消失了，取而代之的是一幅不悦的表情。她把一根食指在另一根食指上反复滑动了几下，模仿着轮子转动的动作。显然，这是个漫长的故事，你短期内是听不到这个故事的结局的。 ]原来如此，这就解释了为什么她会保持沉默。你告诉她你并不是有意要打扰她，但她只是微笑着眨了眨眼，然后几次指向地面。想必这已经不是她第一次需要解释自己为什么不说话了，但即便如此，她看起来依然很开心能够和别人交流。

rows.original: You ask her how she managed to heal her stab wound like that – it was there, you know it was, and there’s still a gaping hole in her clothes to prove it, but, after just a bit of pressure, it’s as if the fight never happened to begin with. How did she manage that? [pc.cl whitemage |Is it a newer method of healing magic that you’re unfamiliar with? |Is it a skill you could be taught? ] You’re so caught up in your rapid-fire questioning that it takes you a moment to realize that she isn’t going to answer any of them. She stands still, patiently waiting for you to stop, and when you do, her lips spread into a coy, wry grin. [pc.dcb |You sigh through your nose and purse your lips, saying nothing more. |"Sorry," you say, a bit frustrated at both yourself, and the fact that you’ll probably never know her secrets. |"Wow, this is hard," you say, your brow furrowing as you try to think of a question she can answer without using words. Zo soundlessly laughs – yes, it is indeed difficult. ] Zo steps into your space, her hands coming up to rest on your cheeks. It’s an intimate position, but you assume that she isn’t about to reward you for coming to her rescue – she’s a mysterious woman, and, for all you know, this is how she’s trying to answer your questions. Her fingers find various spots across your face: her thumbs press gently against your lower jaw, but in asymmetrical spots. One finger presses gently beneath your eye; two go behind one ear; two more press into different spots on your forehead; her short fingers crawl some distance down the back of your neck. Once all ten of her fingers gently press against various, seemingly-random spots on your skull, she just... waits. You feel her fingers move ever-so-slightly, adjusting again and again, looking for the perfect spot on your head to press against, but you don’t know what she’s actually trying to achieve. After an awkward moment of her probing your skull with her fingers, her eyes close, and she takes a deep breath, in through her nose, and then a long, slow, even exhale through her mouth. Her hair begins to shift and move behind her neck – not that you have a clear look at it from here, but it’s difficult not to spot the motion. You feel different. It’s slight, but sudden. You feel like you’re being lifted into the air – you wiggle your toes, just to be sure that you’re still on the ground, and, yes, you aren’t floating. Some previously-unknown energy within you is being riled up, like water in a hot pot trying to boil; your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple] feel[s|s] like [s|it’s|they're] trying to crawl on [s|its|their] own across your body, spurred towards something. You’re reminded of a flower, standing up to face the sun, and just moments away from blooming. When Zo opens her eyes, her normally-vibrant-green eyes have turned a shimmering silver, and what’s more, her now-silver-cornea almost look like they’re shifting, like waves on a beach. But before you can begin to guess what’s happened, your own vision begins to, for lack of a better term, shiver; the color drains from everything around you, all at once, until your world turns monochrome. Shapes all lose their solid outlines, replaced by jagged, vibrating lines that imply solidity, but constantly change and shift as time passes. Standing right in front of you is a shapeless mass of lines and differently-hued grays, blacks, and silvers that do not presume to be any single forgone shape, but, somehow, your mind still recognizes it as Zo. You try to turn your head, but Zo keeps your head in place with her hands, so you try to see what you can around you with only your eyes. Trees in the distance appear as nearly-two-dimensional, with only a pair of lines suggesting where their trunks begin and end, and their canopies are a buzzing, transmuting static of solid gray that move, but do not flutter, in the wind. A random bird flies through the sky within your field of vision, and it looks more like a puddle, or maybe even a flag with rounded corners, as it breezes through the sky; the shapes and lines that imply its form don’t convey motion, and instead, it’s simply existing, from place to place, and yet, your mind accepts that that is, immutably, a bird. Everything that your eyes see, your mind accepts as what they 'are’ on the surface: a tree is a tree, and a bird is a bird, and Zo is and always will be Zo. You have no issues interpreting what you’re seeing as what they truly are, and it takes some realization that, despite knowing what these things are, what you’re seeing is something different. Different, but the same. You’ve never seen a bird look like that before, but you know it to be a bird. Each living thing within your eyesight is shrouded in a mist that shimmers around their shapeless forms: a cloud that, depending on the creature, varies in density, size, and intensity in their silvery color. They linger around the forms they come from like an aura, and from them, you understand what that creature is feeling better than any words or body language could express. Zo’s aura is all-pervasive, bright enough and strong enough to demand your undivided attention, but you nonetheless see the auras of all others, like stars blinking in the night sky. From the edges of your eyes, you can even see your own aura[pc.corruptionRange 0 50 | | – and how it ripples slowly and viscously, bending and rolling over itself like a turbulent, oily sludge. It’s your first look at the real you, and it’s a wholly unattractive thing ].
rows.translation: 你问她，她究竟是怎么让那处刺伤痊愈的——那伤口明明还在那里啊。 知道 确实如此，她的衣服上至今还留有明显的洞痕为证，但只要稍加施压，就好像那场打斗从来就没有发生过一样。她究竟是怎么做到的呢？ [pc.cl whitemage |这是一种你还不熟悉的新型治愈魔法吗？ |这是一种可以通过学习掌握的技能吗？ ] 你一直忙于连珠炮般地提问，以至于过了好一会儿才意识到她根本不会回答其中任何一个问题。她静静地站在那里，耐心地等待你停止提问，而当你终于停下来的时候，她的嘴角浮现出一丝俏皮而略带讽刺的微笑。 [pc.dcb |你通过鼻子叹了口气，然后抿紧嘴唇，再没有说任何话。 |对不起，”你说道，心中既对自己感到有些懊恼，也意识到自己可能永远也无法了解她的秘密。 |哇，这真难，”你说道，眉头紧锁，努力思考着一个她能够不用语言就能回答的问题。佐无声地笑了——没错，确实很难。 确实如此。 很难。 ] 佐走进你的空间，她的双手部轻轻放在你的脸颊上。这个动作显得十分亲密，但你认为她应该不会…… 奖励 感谢你前来救她——她是个神秘的女人，谁知道呢，也许这就是她试图解答你那些疑问的方式。 她的手部指轻轻触碰着你脸上的各个部位：她的拇指轻轻按压着你的下颌，但按压的位置并不对称。 她用一根手部指轻轻按压你的眼眶下方，另外两根手部指则伸到你的耳后，还有两根手部指按在你的前额不同位置；她的短手部指沿着你的后颈向下滑动了一段距离。当她的十根手部指全都轻轻按压在你头骨上的那些看似随意的位置时，她就这样…….. 等待着。你能感觉到她的手部指在微微移动，一次又一次地进行调整，试图找到最适合按压在你头上的位置，但你却不知道她究竟想要达到什么目的。 在她用手部指探查你的头骨的那一阵尴尬时刻之后，她闭上了眼睛，深吸一口气，通过鼻子将空气吸入体内，然后又通过嘴巴缓缓地呼出长长的一口气。 她的头发开始在脖子后面晃动、移动——虽然从这里看不太清楚，但这种动静还是很容易被注意到的。 你感觉到了…… 不同。 这种感觉很微妙，但却来得突然。你会觉得自己仿佛被抬到了半空中——你会动动脚趾，只是为了确认自己仍然站在地面上，而确实，你并没有在漂浮。你体内某些此前未知的能量正在被激发起来，就像火锅里的水正在努力沸腾一样…… [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple] 感受到[s|s] 喜欢 [s|它是|他们是] 正试图爬行着 [s|它|他们的] 那种感觉仿佛贯穿了你的整个身体，驱使着你朝着某个方向前进。你会想起一朵花，它正挺立着迎接阳光，距离绽放仅剩片刻之遥。 当佐睁开眼睛时，她那原本充满活力的绿色眼睛已经变成了闪烁的银色，而且，她那现在变成了银色的角膜似乎还在不断变化，就像海滩上的波浪一样。 但在你开始猜测发生了什么之前，你的视线本身也会开始——实在找不到更好的词语来形容——出现颤抖的现象；你周围的一切颜色都会突然消失，直到你的世界变得一片单调。 所有的物体都失去了它们清晰的轮廓，取而代之的是那些参差不齐、不断颤动的线条…… 意味着 这种形态虽然稳固，但会随着时间的流逝而不断发生变化。此刻站在你面前的，是一团由线条以及不同色调的灰色、黑色和银色组成的无定形物质。它并不试图呈现出某种特定的形状，但不知为何，你的脑海仍然将其认作是“佐”。 你试图转动头部，但佐用双手部将你的头固定住，于是你只能用眼睛来观察周围的环境。远处的树木看起来几乎像是二维的图像，只有几条线条大致标出了树干的起始和结束位置，而它们的树冠则呈现出一种不断变化、嗡嗡作响的灰色阴影，这些阴影在风中移动，但却并不会飘动。 一只陌生的鸟儿划过你的视野，它在天空中飞行的样子更像是一个水坑，又或许是一面边缘圆润的旗帜；那些构成它形象的线条和形状并不能传达出任何运动的感觉，它只是静静地存在于那里，从一处飞到另一处。然而，你的大脑却自然而然地认定，那确实是一只鸟。 你眼睛所看到的一切，你的头脑都会将其表面上的样子视为其真实本质：树就是树，鸟就是鸟，而Zo永远都是Zo。你不会怀疑自己所看到的事物就是它们的真实模样，但你需要某种领悟才能意识到，尽管你知道这些东西到底是什么，但实际上你所看到的却是不同的东西。不同，却又似乎相同。你以前从未见过这样的鸟，但你知道那确实是一只鸟。 在你视线所及的每一个生物身上，都笼罩着一层薄雾，这层雾气围绕着它们那无形的轮廓闪烁着微光：根据生物种类的不同，这层雾的密度、大小以及银色的亮度也会有所差异。这些雾气就像一种光环，萦绕在生物的身边，通过它们，你能比任何语言或肢体语言都更清晰地理解那生物此刻的感受。 佐的光环无处不在，它如此明亮、如此强烈，以至于会让你不得不全神贯注地注视它；但与此同时，你仍然能够看到其他所有人的光环，它们就像夜空中闪烁的星星一样。甚至，你还能隐约看到自己自身的光环。[pc.corruptionRange 0 50 | | ——以及它是如何缓慢而黏稠地波动、弯曲、翻滚的，就像一股湍流般的油污淤泥。这是你第一次看到这一景象。 真实的 你，而这一点实在毫无吸引力可言。 ].
rows.raw: ' You ask her how she managed to heal her stab wound like that – it was there, you know it was, and there’s still a gaping hole in her clothes to prove it, but, after just a bit of pressure, it’s as if the fight never happened to begin with. How did she manage that? [pc.cl whitemage |Is it a newer method of healing magic that you’re unfamiliar with? |Is it a skill you could be taught? ] You’re so caught up in your rapid-fire questioning that it takes you a moment to realize that she isn’t going to answer any of them. She stands still, patiently waiting for you to stop, and when you do, her lips spread into a coy, wry grin. [pc.dcb |You sigh through your nose and purse your lips, saying nothing more. |"Sorry," you say, a bit frustrated at both yourself, and the fact that you’ll probably never know her secrets. |"Wow, this is hard," you say, your brow furrowing as you try to think of a question she can answer without using words. Zo soundlessly laughs – yes, it is indeed difficult. ] Zo steps into your space, her hands coming up to rest on your cheeks. It’s an intimate position, but you assume that she isn’t about to reward you for coming to her rescue – she’s a mysterious woman, and, for all you know, this is how she’s trying to answer your questions. Her fingers find various spots across your face: her thumbs press gently against your lower jaw, but in asymmetrical spots. One finger presses gently beneath your eye; two go behind one ear; two more press into different spots on your forehead; her short fingers crawl some distance down the back of your neck. Once all ten of her fingers gently press against various, seemingly-random spots on your skull, she just... waits. You feel her fingers move ever-so-slightly, adjusting again and again, looking for the perfect spot on your head to press against, but you don’t know what she’s actually trying to achieve. After an awkward moment of her probing your skull with her fingers, her eyes close, and she takes a deep breath, in through her nose, and then a long, slow, even exhale through her mouth. Her hair begins to shift and move behind her neck – not that you have a clear look at it from here, but it’s difficult not to spot the motion. You feel different. It’s slight, but sudden. You feel like you’re being lifted into the air – you wiggle your toes, just to be sure that you’re still on the ground, and, yes, you aren’t floating. Some previously-unknown energy within you is being riled up, like water in a hot pot trying to boil; your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple] feel[s|s] like [s|it’s|they're] trying to crawl on [s|its|their] own across your body, spurred towards something. You’re reminded of a flower, standing up to face the sun, and just moments away from blooming. When Zo opens her eyes, her normally-vibrant-green eyes have turned a shimmering silver, and what’s more, her now-silver-cornea almost look like they’re shifting, like waves on a beach. But before you can begin to guess what’s happened, your own vision begins to, for lack of a better term, shiver; the color drains from everything around you, all at once, until your world turns monochrome. Shapes all lose their solid outlines, replaced by jagged, vibrating lines that imply solidity, but constantly change and shift as time passes. Standing right in front of you is a shapeless mass of lines and differently-hued grays, blacks, and silvers that do not presume to be any single forgone shape, but, somehow, your mind still recognizes it as Zo. You try to turn your head, but Zo keeps your head in place with her hands, so you try to see what you can around you with only your eyes. Trees in the distance appear as nearly-two-dimensional, with only a pair of lines suggesting where their trunks begin and end, and their canopies are a buzzing, transmuting static of solid gray that move, but do not flutter, in the wind. A random bird flies through the sky within your field of vision, and it looks more like a puddle, or maybe even a flag with rounded corners, as it breezes through the sky; the shapes and lines that imply its form don’t convey motion, and instead, it’s simply existing, from place to place, and yet, your mind accepts that that is, immutably, a bird. Everything that your eyes see, your mind accepts as what they 'are’ on the surface: a tree is a tree, and a bird is a bird, and Zo is and always will be Zo. You have no issues interpreting what you’re seeing as what they truly are, and it takes some realization that, despite knowing what these things are, what you’re seeing is something different. Different, but the same. You’ve never seen a bird look like that before, but you know it to be a bird. Each living thing within your eyesight is shrouded in a mist that shimmers around their shapeless forms: a cloud that, depending on the creature, varies in density, size, and intensity in their silvery color. They linger around the forms they come from like an aura, and from them, you understand what that creature is feeling better than any words or body language could express. Zo’s aura is all-pervasive, bright enough and strong enough to demand your undivided attention, but you nonetheless see the auras of all others, like stars blinking in the night sky. From the edges of your eyes, you can even see your own aura[pc.corruptionRange 0 50 | | – and how it ripples slowly and viscously, bending and rolling over itself like a turbulent, oily sludge. It’s your first look at the real you, and it’s a wholly unattractive thing ]. '

rows.original: Suddenly, Zo removes her hands from your head, and just like that, your vision is brought back to normal. You no longer see trees as two-dimensional squiggly lines, and now you see their thick trunks and brown bark with lush, green leaves as they all are. Zo herself is no longer a formless mass surrounded by a shimmering silver aura, but merely a lupine woman wearing a bloodstained shirt. You’re at a total loss for words. You had glimpsed the world in a truly different way: you could see every living creature not for what they appear to be, but for what they are, on a metaphysical level. For the few moments that Zo had her hands on you, your universe had changed, to something familiar-yet-alien. A bird had never looked like that to you before; you had never imagined that it could look like that; and now, you’ll never look at a bird the same way again. [pc.corruptionRange 1 100 |Zo’s own eyes are still the vibrant, shimmering silver as they were before she started, and while she’s looking straight into your own eyes, you get the sense that she isn’t looking at you. She lowers her right hand to your chest, her fingers against your collarbone. She straightens them, her claws sharply jutting against your [pc.skinFurScales], before splaying, each finger coming to rest at different, and very specific and deliberate, spots along your neck, just as she had done with your head before. They tense and rub against your collar, and then– You aren’t sure what she just did, but you feel... lighter. Clearer. The cobwebs behind your eyes are brushed away, and your thoughts feel a bit more focused. [pc.corruptionRange 40 100 |Not by a whole lot, all told, but the difference is noticeable to you. ]You feel... [pc.corruptionRange 0 1 100 |purified. Like you’re whole again. |perhaps 'cleansed’ is too strong a word, but you feel more like yourself than you have in some time. ] ] Zo pulls back, returning her hands to her side, and, with a blink, her eyes return to their deep emerald-green state. She smiles at you sweetly, but the curves of her lips don’t reach quite as high, and her eyelids are beginning to droop. Whatever she’s done, it must be a bit tiring. "Can you teach me?" you blurt out suddenly. Whatever she’s done, and whatever power she has, [pc.isDK |you want in. You can barely keep a straight thought on all the applications a skill like hers could have. |you could help the world so much more if you had just a fraction of what she has. ] Zo considers the question for a moment – before letting out a long, nearly-exaggerated yawn, her tongue rolling from her mouth for effect. She points to you first; then to the ground; then, she points to the sky and spins her finger in a circle. Unfortunately, her answer isn’t as simple as a yes-or-no, and if you want to learn how to communicate with her, you’re going to need to learn how to interpret pantomiming, and quickly. You try and parse her meaning. You, then the ground, then her finger spinning in the air. Maybe... you, here, and... do laps? Is the lesson starting right now, and she wants you to go for a run? You ask her if that interpretation is correct, and she shakes her head. Her smile, while still worn, keeps on her face patiently; she’s probably used to people taking their time with figuring out her meanings. You try again. You, here, and... maybe the finger in the air isn’t referring to you. Is she pointing at the clouds? The sky? The [dayNight |sun |moon ]? Does she want you to come back later? Running your second guess by her, she smiles and nods. She wants you to come back some other time. From the look on her face, [dayNight |she’s probably after a moment to herself for a nap |it’s past her bedtime. Not that you can blame her – you’d probably be in bed by now too, if the life of an adventurer didn’t have such chaotic hours ]. Zo pats you on the shoulder, then walks past you, heading towards the ramshackle building at the edge of the clearing. That must be where she lives – or, at least, where she goes to sleep. Well, that’s that. If you want to learn more about Zo’s skills, and perhaps learn a way to harness that power for yourself, you’ll just need to come back in a bit.
rows.translation: 突然，佐将她的手部从你的头上拿开，就这样，你的视线恢复了正常。你不再看到树木只是一些二维的弯曲线条，现在你可以清楚地看到它们粗壮的树干、棕色的树皮，以及茂盛的绿叶。 佐自己已经不再是一个被闪烁的银色光环包围的无形存在，而只是一个穿着沾满血迹的衬衫的狼族女性。 你完全不知道该说些什么。你曾经以一种完全不同的方式看待这个世界：你能够看到每一个生物，不是根据它们外表呈现出来的样子，而是根据它们真正的本质来看待它们。 是。 从形而上学的角度来看，在佐将你的手部放在你身上的那短短几秒钟里，你的整个世界都发生了变化。 改变了。 那种熟悉却又陌生的感觉……你以前从未见过这样的鸟；你也从未想象过它会是这样的样子。 可以 看吧，现在你再看任何一只鸟，都会觉得它和以前不一样了。 [pc.corruptionRange 1 100 |佐的眼睛依然保持着那种充满活力、闪烁着银光的神采，就像在她开始这一切之前一样。当她直视着你的眼睛时，你会有一种感觉——她其实并没有在看你。 在……时候 你。 她将右手放在你的胸前，手指触碰到你的锁骨。她伸直手指，那些尖锐的“爪子”紧紧地抵在你的身上。 [pc.skinFurScales]在开始按摩之前，她的每一根手部指都会分别落在你颈部的不同位置，这些位置都是经过精心挑选的。她就像之前按摩你的头部那样，用手部指轻轻触碰、揉搓你的脖子，然后—— 你不确定她刚刚做了什么，但你感觉……轻松了许多，思绪也变得清晰起来。仿佛眼前的迷雾被一扫而空，你的注意力也更加集中了。 [pc.corruptionRange 40 100 |总的来说，差距并不是很大，但这种差异对你来说却是显而易见的。 ]你感觉…… [pc.corruptionRange 0 1 100 |得到了净化。仿佛重新变得完整了。 |或许“净化”这个词有点过于强烈了，但你的感觉确实是这样。 你自己 这已经是你很长时间以来第一次拥有这样的东西了。 ] ] 佐收回双手部，将其放在身体两侧，眨眼间，她的眼睛又恢复了那深绿色的色泽。她对你露出了甜美的微笑，但她的嘴角并没有上扬得那么高，眼睑也开始下垂。无论她刚才做了什么，想必都让人感到有些疲惫吧。 “你能教我吗？”你突然脱口而出。无论她掌握了什么能力，无论她做过什么事情…… [pc.isDK |你肯定感兴趣的。像她这样的能力，能应用在多少领域里，光是想想就让人兴奋不已。 |如果你能拥有她所拥有的一小部分资源，你就能为这个世界做出更多的贡献。 ] 佐思考了片刻，然后打了一个长长的、几乎有些夸张的哈欠，还故意把舌头吐出来耍了个花招。她先指了指你，然后指向地面，接着又指向天空，同时用手部指画了一个圆圈。 不幸的是，她的回答并不是简单的“是”或“否”，如果你想学会如何与她交流，你就必须尽快学会如何解读她的肢体语言。你试图弄清楚她的意思。 你，然后是地面，接着是她在空中旋转的手部指。也许……你，在这里，然后……绕圈跑？难道这节课现在就要开始了，而她想让你去跑步吗？ 你问她这种理解是否正确，她却摇了摇头。 她的笑容虽然依然挂在脸上，但却显得十分耐心；她大概已经习惯了人们需要一些时间来理解她的意思。 你再试一次吧。你，就是你，还有……也许那个举在空中的手部指并不是在指你。 她是在指向云朵吗？还是在看天空？ [dayNight |太阳 |月亮 ]她是想让你晚点再来吗？” 当你向她询问这个意思时，她微笑着点了点头。她其实是想让你改天再来。从她脸上的表情来看，她是这个意思。 [dayNight |她大概想找個安静的地方小睡一会儿吧。 |已经过了她该睡觉的时间了。不过也不能怪她——如果冒险者的生活没有这么混乱的作息时间，你现在可能也已经上床睡觉了吧。 ]佐轻拍着你的肩膀，然后从你身边走过，朝着空地边缘那座破旧的建筑物走去。那里应该就是她居住的地方——或者至少是她睡觉的地方。 好吧，就这样吧。如果你想了解更多关于佐的能力的信息，或许还想学会如何将自己也赋予这样的力量，那么你就需要再回来一趟了。

[var0
        |You don’t see any reason to keep fighting: by your every calculation, the centaurs have you overpowered, and it’d be safer for you[party.som|| and [comp1.name]| and your party] to stand down and submit to their demands – assuming they’re after something more than just to slaughter you. 
        |[pc.HPDefeated|After that last blow, the pain shooting up your arms and across your body has you lose your grip on your [pc.weapon], and you collapse to your knees|After that last display, you find that you don’t have the strength of will to hold onto your [pc.weapon], much less keep fighting, and it slips from your fingers as you collapse to your knees]
    ]
    
    Upon seeing your [var0
        |surrender
        |defeat
    ], the lupine warrior you’ve been with keeps her arms up, her fur standing on end, wary and afraid for what’s going to happen, but when the centaurs approach you, she doesn’t put up much more of a fight – if she couldn’t win with you by her side, then she isn’t about to win on her own.
    
    One of them roughly grabs her by the branded strands of her hair, gripping all four ‘branches’ of it in one large, burly hand, and yanking her backward, pulling her off her feet and dragging her off to the rim of the grove. To her credit, she doesn’t yelp or cry out in pain or defeat, despite the rough handling – she’s as tough a lupine as they come, apparently.
    
    That leaves you[party.som
        |
        | and your companion
        |and your companions
    ] with the other three....

        |你没有任何理由继续战斗了：根据你的所有计算，半人马们显然在力量上占据了优势，继续战斗对你来说只会更加危险。[party.som|| 以及 [comp1.name]| 还有你的队友们] 必须退让并满足他们的要求——前提是他们真正的目的并非只是要消灭你。 
        |[pc.HPDefeated|在那一记重击之后，剧烈的疼痛从手臂蔓延到全身，让你完全失去了控制…… [pc.weapon]然后你跪倒在地。|在经历了那最后一次展示之后，你发现自己已经没有足够的意志力来坚持下去了。 [pc.weapon]更不用说继续战斗了，当你双膝跪地倒下时，它就从你的手指中滑落了。]

[var0 |Zo swings the sword once: a single, long, slow, swing, from the outside swinging in, with exaggerated wrists movements to make the sword twirl and spin as it moves. The swing has zero merit as an attack, but it nonetheless looks very elegant, and she’s graceful and fluid in returning to a neutral, at-the-ready stance. Some of her swings have her bend and twist her body in ways that you would never expect a swordfighter to move: the weight of the sword forces her to lean and twist too far in one direction or the other, but as soon as you think she’s going to lose her balance, she twists and spins the scabbard in her other hand, and she’s back upright – and after pausing for a moment to recollect herself, she’s back at it. |When Zo swings the sword, it’s a slow, wide, practically lazy vertical arc, swinging downward by the wrist and twisting to graze against her left shoulder. Carelessly, she lets go of the sword’s hilt – but then, with the momentum it had built with the swing, she bends herself at the waist, and the sword loops around her shoulder, the flat side spinning across her arm and the edge whizzing just above her flattened ears. With the sword still twirling above her shoulder, she brings her arms together, spinning the scabbard between her fingers and seamlessly passing it from one hand to the next. As the sword spins across her shoulders, making its way to her right, she seamlessly catches its tip with the opening to the scabbard, using the blade’s momentum to slide it back into the sheath. After that impressive display of swords-dancing, Zo stands up straight – and rubs at her ear, massaging at it soothingly. The swings aren’t particularly fierce, and after they both reach the apex of the swing, she bends forward at the waist and lets go of them both. Both the sword and the scabbard spin along her outstretched arms, twirling down the lengths of her forearms and biceps. She raises her left arm and lowers her right, putting them both at an angle – the sword’s tip glides perfectly into the opening of the scabbard, sheathing the weapon fluidly as they both spin across her raised arms. But she isn’t done: once the weapon is sheathed, she changes the position of her arms, lowering her left and raising her right. The sword continues to spin, using the motion of her body to pick up some momentum; once it spins fast enough, the sword slides free, the pristine metal of the blade glinting in the sunlight. Once the weapon and the sheath are separate again, Zo bends her arms, curving her forearms downward and twisting her hands so that her palms face outward. Despite the sharp blade spinning across her body, she’s moving with the practiced, mastered comfort of a dancer performing for herself; and with just another rotation, she catches the sword in her left hand and the scabbard, with a reversed grip, in her right. She had changed hands without setting either of them down. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐站在那片圆形平原上远处那片长满草丛、无人使用的空地上。她的右手部握着一把剑：剑身长度大约与她的手部臂相当，而剑柄与剑尾加起来的长度则约为剑身长度的一半。这把剑非常漂亮，经过精心打磨，显得崭新无瑕——这说明佐从未用它进行过战斗。而从她握剑的方式来看，这也把剑显然并不是为战斗而设计的。 除了这份新鲜感之外，这把剑本身并没有什么特别引人注目的地方：没有装饰品，没有徽章或镶嵌物，没有任何值得特别关注或感兴趣的地方。 她的左手部握着的，显然就是这把剑的剑鞘，她是以一种反向握持的方式握着它的。 这个剑鞘也并没有什么特别之处：外壳是由经过打磨、上过漆的深蓝色木头制成的，边缘还装饰着金色边纹。不过，整个剑鞘似乎都被金属骨架加固过了——这样或许能让它变得更重，从而与这把剑的重量相匹配吧？ [var0 |佐将剑挥动了一次：那是一次缓慢而悠长的挥动，从剑的外侧开始向内侧移动，同时手腕做出夸张的动作，使得剑在挥动的过程中不断旋转。这种挥剑动作本身并没有任何攻击性，但看起来却非常优雅，而她也在回到中立、准备战斗的姿势时展现出了娴熟而流畅的动作。 她的某些挥剑动作会让她以完全出乎人们意料的方式弯曲和扭转身体：剑的重量迫使她向某个方向过度倾斜或扭转，但就在你以为她会失去平衡的瞬间，她会用另一只手转动剑鞘，立刻恢复直立姿势——稍作调整后，她又会继续攻击。 |当佐挥动剑时，那是一道缓慢而宽阔的、几乎有些懒散的垂直弧线——她通过手腕的动作将剑向下挥动，同时让剑身发生扭转，使得剑刃轻轻擦过她的左肩。她有些随意地松开了剑柄，但凭借着挥动时所产生的惯性，她立刻弯下腰，剑便绕过她的肩膀，剑身平直的部分在她的手臂上划过，而剑刃则从她扁平的耳廓上方呼啸而过。 她将剑仍在肩上旋转着，双手将剑柄握在一起，让剑鞘在手指间不断转动，然后流畅地将剑柄从一只手换到另一只手。当剑在她的肩上旋转着移向右侧时，她巧妙地用剑鞘的开口接住了剑尖，借助剑刃的惯性，将剑顺利地插回了剑鞘中。 在完成了那场令人印象深刻的剑舞表演之后，佐站直了身体，然后揉了揉耳朵，轻轻按摩着它。想必那场表演并没有看上去那么完美吧。 |深吸一口气后，佐将剑与剑鞘同时向相反方向垂直挥动。这些动作并不特别猛烈，当它们都达到挥动的最高点时，她便弯下腰，松开了双手。 剑与剑鞘一同沿着她伸直的双臂旋转，顺着她的前臂和二头肌的轮廓不断转动。她抬起左臂，同时放下右臂，使两者呈一定角度——剑尖精准地滑入剑鞘的开口中，当它们在她的双臂上旋转时，武器便流畅地被收了起来。 但她还没有结束：当武器被收回剑鞘后，她调整了自己的手臂位置，将左臂放下，右臂抬起。剑继续旋转，借助她身体的动作获得动力；当剑旋转得足够快时，它就会从剑鞘中滑出，剑刃上那纯净的金属在阳光下闪闪发光。 当武器与剑鞘再次分离时，佐弯曲双臂，前臂向下弯曲，双手同时转动，使手掌朝外。尽管锋利的剑刃正在她的身体周围旋转，她的动作却如同一位为自己表演的舞者那样娴熟而自如。仅仅再转动一次，她就用左手接住了剑，而用右手反握住了剑鞘。她完成了这个动作，却丝毫没有让任何一把武器从手中掉落。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你随时都可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴在绳子上的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]

Some of her swings have her bend and twist her body in ways that you would never expect a swordfighter to move: the weight of the sword forces her to lean and twist too far in one direction or the other, but as soon as you think she’s going to lose her balance, she twists and spins the scabbard in her other hand, and she’s back upright – and after pausing for a moment to recollect herself, she’s back at it. |When Zo swings the sword, it’s a slow, wide, practically lazy vertical arc, swinging downward by the wrist and twisting to graze against her left shoulder. Carelessly, she lets go of the sword’s hilt – but then, with the momentum it had built with the swing, she bends herself at the waist, and the sword loops around her shoulder, the flat side spinning across her arm and the edge whizzing just above her flattened ears. With the sword still twirling above her shoulder, she brings her arms together, spinning the scabbard between her fingers and seamlessly passing it from one hand to the next. As the sword spins across her shoulders, making its way to her right, she seamlessly catches its tip with the opening to the scabbard, using the blade’s momentum to slide it back into the sheath. After that impressive display of swords-dancing, Zo stands up straight – and rubs at her ear, massaging at it soothingly. It must not have been as perfect as it looked. |After taking a breath, Zo swings both the sword and the scabbard vertically, in opposite directions. The swings aren’t particularly fierce, and after they both reach the apex of the swing, she bends forward at the waist and lets go of them both. Both the sword and the scabbard spin along her outstretched arms, twirling down the lengths of her forearms and biceps. She raises her left arm and lowers her right, putting them both at an angle – the sword’s tip glides perfectly into the opening of the scabbard, sheathing the weapon fluidly as they both spin across her raised arms. But she isn’t done: once the weapon is sheathed, she changes the position of her arms, lowering her left and raising her right. The sword continues to spin, using the motion of her body to pick up some momentum; once it spins fast enough, the sword slides free, the pristine metal of the blade glinting in the sunlight. Once the weapon and the sheath are separate again, Zo bends her arms, curving her forearms downward and twisting her hands so that her palms face outward. Despite the sharp blade spinning across her body, she’s moving with the practiced, mastered comfort of a dancer performing for herself; and with just another rotation, she catches the sword in her left hand and the scabbard, with a reversed grip, in her right. She had changed hands without setting either of them down. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

rows.original: Zo stands in the far, grassy, unused lot in the circular plain. In her hands are the unique weapon that she had used against the centaurs when you first met her: the two, short, thick sticks made of wood, attached by their ends with a rope. You had never really seen a weapon quite like it before: it’s not a whip and it’s not a sword, so you could guess that it’s a weapon best used for bludgeoning, but it nonetheless moves through the air like a whip and some of the movements resemble swinging it like a sword. [var0 |Despite appearing to be somewhat skilled with the weapon when you first helped her with the centaurs, Zo moves with some caution as she whips it around herself, careful to swing it a bit more broadly and slowly than she should in a real fight. Even still, while the weapon is moving slowly enough for you to track with your eyes, it’s erratic enough that you can’t predict where it’s next going to arc – and, evidently, neither can Zo, as she mistakenly whaps herself in the leg with it. She stops, winces, and rubs at the spot for a moment, before resuming her stance... with a bit of a lopsided balance. |As if to demonstrate to you, Zo begins to swing the weapon, twirling it through the air with shocking speed – even from where you are, across the entire clearing, you can hear it cut and whistle through the air as she swings it. Most of its movements are broad, but the swings themselves are quick as a flash, before Zo catches the stick she isn’t holding with her other hand. Spinning her wrist and twirling it around in her fingers make the free stick arc and pivot in directions you could barely even parse, much less predict in a real fight. |After readying her body, Zo swings her arm once, before catching the free end of her weapon with her left armpit. You only saw the one swing, but you heard its high-pitched whistle cut through the air at least three times, the free end of the weapon cutting and slicing through the air in front of her faster than your eye can track. She swings it three more times – at least, going by the motion of her arm – and it whizzes through the air another nine. It’s going so fast that you can’t even see it move. How is anyone supposed to fight that? ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐站在那片圆形平原上那片遥远的、长满草丛且无人使用的空地上。她手部中握着那件你在初次遇见她时她用来对抗半人马的独特武器：两根短而粗的木棍，两端用绳子连接在一起。你以前从未见过这样的武器：它既不是鞭子，也不是剑，因此你可以推测，这种武器最适合用来击打敌人，但它挥动时的轨迹却像鞭子，而某些动作则类似于用剑挥击。 [var0 |当初你在帮助她对抗半人马时，她使用那件武器的动作似乎还算娴熟，但后来她在挥舞武器的时候变得格外谨慎——她将武器在身周挥动得幅度更大、速度也更慢，显然比在真正的战斗中应该使用的动作要更加小心。 即便如此，这种武器的移动速度虽然慢到足以让你用眼睛追踪它的轨迹，但其运动轨迹却极其不规则，因此你根本无法预测它下一刻会朝哪个方向移动——显然，Zo也同样无法预判，结果她不小心用自己的武器打到了自己的腿上。 她停了下来，皱起了眉头，揉了揉那个地方一会儿，然后又恢复了原来的姿势……不过她的平衡有点不稳，有点歪歪扭扭的。 |仿佛是为了向你展示这一点，佐开始挥动那件武器，以惊人的速度在空气中旋转着它——即使是从你所在的地方，穿过整个空地，你也能听到它在挥动时划过空气发出的声响。 它的动作大多幅度较大，但挥动的速度却快如闪电——在佐用另一只手抓住那根原本没有握住的棍子之前，这一切都已经发生得无影无踪了。她旋转手腕，让棍子在手指间快速转动，这使得棍子会划出难以理解的弧线，并朝各种方向转动，在真正的战斗中，人们根本无法预判这些动作的走向。 |当她调整好自己的姿势后，佐挥动手臂一次，然后用左腋窝夹住了武器的自由端。你只看到了那一次挥动，但却听到了那尖锐的啸声划破空气的声音…… 最少 她连续三次挥动武器，武器的自由端在空气中快速移动，速度之快快得连人的眼睛都跟不上。她又挥动了三次——至少从她手臂的动作来看是这样——武器又一次在空气中呼啸而过。 九它的移动速度太快了，甚至让人看不清它在移动。这样的敌人，人们要怎么才能与之战斗呢？ ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却根本不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]

rows.original: Off in the far corner of the clearing is Zo, tending to her fruit and vegetable patch. She’s mostly nude, save for her underwear; her two-piece outfit hangs off the garden’s sole apple tree, on the lowest branch, each piece billowing in the wind – doing some farming work, especially if she’s bare-handed, in clothing that’s entirely white would have been more trouble to clean than it would be worth, clearly. Luckily, the grove surrounding the clearing is pretty effective at blocking wind, so she doesn’t have to worry about her clothes flying away from an errant gust[pc.corruptionRange 0 40 | |, as... entertaining as it would be. ] [rand |The fruits on the garden’s lone apple tree must have ripened fairly recently, because she’s standing in the tree’s shade, reaching for some of the lower-hanging fruits, trying to grasp at them with her hands. At her feet is her clay jar: with every apple she plucks, she places into the jar carefully, going elbow-deep before letting it go. [var0 |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. She tries to reach some of the lower ones by jumping, and her fingers brush the bottom side of the apples, knocking them around on their stems, but it’s no good: Zo is just too short to get them. She’s going to need a bit of help to harvest those ones. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. Even standing on her toes, she can’t quite reach some of the ones that are a little higher up. But with a jump, she can – she can reach every apple on the tree. Whatever training she’s been doing on the side, it’s apparently allowed her to jump [silly |good |much higher than usual ]. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. There’s no way she’d be able to reach them, even standing on her toes – so, instead, she reaches up with her hand, and the bulbous ends of her braided hair begin to levitate on their own behind her head. Suddenly, the apple she was reaching for simply falls off its stem and into her open hand. And just to prove it wasn’t a coincidence, she does it again. ] |She’s on her hands and knees, mostly nude save for her underwear, digging into the dirt with her bare claws, trying to plough the earth and get to the vegetables ready to harvest directly. You... suppose claws could make for a replacement trowel, although they wouldn’t be very effective or sanitary. Still, from the looks of things, she’s making some decent headway: her potato patch has four plough lines (each of them likely hand-dug), and she’s halfway through the second. [var0 |With each potato and carrot she unearths, she places them in her clay pot before getting to the next one. And she doesn’t look too distraught or overworked from it either: her body moves with a certain comfortable grace, almost like she was dancing to a tune only she could hear. |She’s digging up her vegetables with surprising, almost unreal speed: she digs into the earth with both hands, reaching for a potato with one and a carrot with the other, and, without even looking, cuts it straight out of the earth and tosses it into her clay jar. She must have only just started if she’s able to work this fast. |And she doesn’t look like she’s ‘digging’ for her food so much as she’s simply... reaching for it: her hand slides into the earth almost as easily as a shirt sleeve, and when she grips onto a vegetable, it doesn’t resist when she plucks it out, leaving its roots still buried in the ground. It’s difficult to imagine that Zo’s training has made her into such a proficient farmer, but your eyes aren’t lying – especially when she does it again. ] |She’s plucking through her garden’s fruit bush, plucking the fruit straight from the branches before placing them into her clay jar. Every now and again, she inspects one of the bush fruits, before almost guiltily popping it into her mouth for a light, quick sneak-peak of whatever she intends to do with them later. It doesn’t look like any natural bush that you’ve seen: from the way it grows around the potato patch, it looks like Zo’s managed to cultivate a small orchard of berry bushes into an unnatural shape, and you can’t tell if it’s all one large, massive, funny-shaped bush with multiple stems, or if it’s a handful of smaller ones. Either way, the shrub grows longer than it does wide or tall, and eventually curves in an L, hooking the potato patch into its curve and protecting it from the border of the grove.[var0 |From the looks of where Zo is, she’s about halfway done with cleaning the bush out – although she’d probably go a bit faster if she didn’t stop to steal a sample every few plucks. |Zo doesn’t look like she’s gone too far into her harvesting, but she also looks like she’s only just started. And the way she plucks them is, for lack of a better word, impressive: she plucks them right off their stems before rolling them down her forearm, and when it gets to her elbow, she flicks it upward, sending the berries through the air and dunking into the clay pot, all without her even looking over her shoulder. She could clear the whole bush within minutes with a technique like that. |This time, she has the clay pot placed fairly close to the bush, as ‘underneath’ it as it can fit. Then, once she’s satisfied, she leans underneath the bush, gripping it by its trunk, and giving the whole thing a single, sturdy shake... and every single berry on the bush flings through the air, their flight paths all arcing for the mouth of the pot. It almost looks like divine intervention, the way every berry funnels into the mouth of the pot with that one shake – with the exception of one, single, solitary berry, which travels almost vertically, and straight back down into Zo’s open mouth. ] ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 在空地的最远角落，佐正在照料她的果菜园。她几乎全身赤裸，只穿着内衣；她的那套两件套服装挂在花园里唯一的苹果树上，最低的那根树枝上——每件衣服都在风中飘动。显然，如果她在进行农活时穿着全白的衣服，既不方便也不利于清洁。 幸运的是，空地周围的树林能够很好地阻挡风，因此她不必担心衣服会被突然吹走。[pc.corruptionRange 0 40 | |尽管这可能会很有趣…… ] [rand |花园里那棵唯一的苹果树上的果实肯定是在最近才成熟的，因为她正站在树荫下，试图去摘那些挂在较低位置的果实。她的脚边放着一个陶罐：每摘到一个苹果，她都会小心翼翼地把它放进罐子里，直到罐子快被苹果填满才放下手中的果实。 [var0 |然而，那些挂在较高树枝上的苹果对她来说确实有些够不着。她试着跳起来去够那些较低的苹果，手指虽然触到了苹果的底部，但只是把它们在果柄上碰来碰去，根本无法摘下来——佐实在太矮了，根本够不到那些苹果。她需要一些帮助才能把它们摘下来。 |不过，那些长在较高树枝上的苹果，对她来说还是有点够不着。即使她踮起脚来，也还是无法拿到那些位置较高的苹果。但是，如果她跳一下的话，就一定能拿到它们了。 每个 唾手可得的东西。不管她私下进行了哪些训练，显然这些训练让她具备了这样的能力。 [silly |不错 |比平常高得多 ]. |然而，那些长在较高树枝上的苹果，对她来说确实有些难以触及。即使她踮起足部来，也根本够不到它们——于是，她只好伸出手部去。这时，她那束编成的头发突然开始在她的背后自主地飘起来。不一会儿，她试图去摘的那个苹果竟然真的从树枝上掉了下来，落在了她张开的手部中。为了证明这并非巧合，她又试了一次，结果依然如此。 ] |她双膝跪地，几乎全身赤裸，只穿着内衣，用赤裸的双手部在泥土中挖掘，试图翻动土壤，直接找到那些可以收获的蔬菜。你…… 假设 虽然用爪子来代替铁锹使用效果并不理想，也不太卫生，但看起来她还是取得了一些进展：她的土豆地已经开出了四条沟渠（每一条都很可能是她亲手部挖的），而第二条沟渠也已经挖到了一半。 [var0 |每当她挖出一颗土豆或一根胡萝卜，就会把它们放进陶罐里，然后再继续挖下一颗。她看起来丝毫没有因为这些工作而感到疲惫或烦躁：她的动作带着一种自然而优雅的节奏，仿佛正在随着只有她自己能听到的旋律跳舞一样。 |她挖蔬菜的速度快得惊人，几乎让人觉得不真实：她用双手同时挖土，一只手去抓土豆，另一只手去拿胡萝卜，甚至都不看就直接把它们从土里挖出来，然后扔进她的陶罐里。如果她真的才刚开始挖菜，能够这么快地完成这些动作，那她肯定速度快得离谱。 |而且她看起来并不是在认真地“寻找”食物，而只是…… 达到 她轻松地将手伸进土里，就像把袖子套上去一样自然。当她抓住某种植物并拔出来时，那植物丝毫不会反抗，它的根依然埋在土里。很难相信，佐的训练竟然让她成为了如此熟练的农夫，但你的眼睛确实在见证这一切——尤其是当她再次这么做的时候。 ] |她正在采摘花园里的果丛里的果实，直接将它们从树枝上摘下来，然后放入陶罐中。偶尔，她会仔细检查其中某个果实，然后几乎带着一丝内疚的感觉将其放入口中，快速品尝一下，以便稍后决定该如何处理这些果实。 这种植物看起来完全不像你见过的任何天然灌木：从它围绕土豆田生长的方式来看，似乎是佐成功地将一片浆果灌木丛培育成了这种不自然的形态。你根本无法分辨这是由一株庞大而形状奇特的多茎灌木组成的，还是由几株较小的灌木组合而成的。 无论如何，这种灌木的生长速度都是高度大于宽度，最终会呈L形弯曲，将土豆田围在弯曲的部分之内，从而保护它免受树林边缘的侵害。[var0 |从佐现在的位置来看，她应该已经清理了大约一半的灌木丛了——不过，如果她不每隔一会儿就停下来摘一些样本的话，速度应该会更快一些。 |佐看起来并没有把采摘工作进行得太久，但同时也显得她才刚刚开始。而她采摘这些植物的方式，用一个不太恰当的词来形容的话…… 令人印象深刻她将浆果直接从枝子上摘下，然后让它们沿着前臂滑落；当它们到达肘部时，她会轻轻一弹，让浆果飞入陶罐中——整个过程她甚至都不需要回头看。用这样的方法，她几分钟内就能摘光整株灌木上的浆果。 |这一次，她把陶罐放在离灌木丛相当近的地方，尽量让它位于灌木丛的“下方”。等她满意之后，她就俯身到灌木丛下方，抓住它的树干，然后用力摇晃整个装置一次。……灌木丛上的每一颗浆果都飞向空中，它们的飞行轨迹全都朝着陶罐的口部弯曲着飞去。当陶罐轻轻一摇，所有浆果都整齐地落入罐中时，这一幕简直就像是神灵的干预——只有一颗浆果例外，它几乎垂直地飞落，直接回到了佐张开的嘴里。 ] ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你也注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]
rows.raw: " Off in the far corner of the clearing is Zo, tending to her fruit and vegetable patch. She’s mostly nude, save for her underwear; her two-piece outfit hangs off the garden’s sole apple tree, on the lowest branch, each piece billowing in the wind – doing some farming work, especially if she’s bare-handed, in clothing that’s entirely white would have been more trouble to clean than it would be worth, clearly. Luckily, the grove surrounding the clearing is pretty effective at blocking wind, so she doesn’t have to worry about her clothes flying away from an errant gust[pc.corruptionRange 0 40 | |, as... entertaining as it would be. ] [rand |The fruits on the garden’s lone apple tree must have ripened fairly recently, because she’s standing in the tree’s shade, reaching for some of the lower-hanging fruits, trying to grasp at them with her hands. At her feet is her clay jar: with every apple she plucks, she places into the jar carefully, going elbow-deep before letting it go. [var0 |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. She tries to reach some of the lower ones by jumping, and her fingers brush the bottom side of the apples, knocking them around on their stems, but it’s no good: Zo is just too short to get them. She’s going to need a bit of help to harvest those ones. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. Even standing on her toes, she can’t quite reach some of the ones that are a little higher up. But with a jump, she can – she can reach every apple on the tree. Whatever training she’s been doing on the side, it’s apparently allowed her to jump [silly |good |much higher than usual ]. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. There’s no way she’d be able to reach them, even standing on her toes – so, instead, she reaches up with her hand, and the bulbous ends of her braided hair begin to levitate on their own behind her head. Suddenly, the apple she was reaching for simply falls off its stem and into her open hand. And just to prove it wasn’t a coincidence, she does it again. ] |She’s on her hands and knees, mostly nude save for her underwear, digging into the dirt with her bare claws, trying to plough the earth and get to the vegetables ready to harvest directly. You... suppose claws could make for a replacement trowel, although they wouldn’t be very effective or sanitary. Still, from the looks of things, she’s making some decent headway: her potato patch has four plough lines (each of them likely hand-dug), and she’s halfway through the second. [var0 |With each potato and carrot she unearths, she places them in her clay pot before getting to the next one. And she doesn’t look too distraught or overworked from it either: her body moves with a certain comfortable grace, almost like she was dancing to a tune only she could hear. |She’s digging up her vegetables with surprising, almost unreal speed: she digs into the earth with both hands, reaching for a potato with one and a carrot with the other, and, without even looking, cuts it straight out of the earth and tosses it into her clay jar. She must have only just started if she’s able to work this fast. |And she doesn’t look like she’s ‘digging’ for her food so much as she’s simply... reaching for it: her hand slides into the earth almost as easily as a shirt sleeve, and when she grips onto a vegetable, it doesn’t resist when she plucks it out, leaving its roots still buried in the ground. It’s difficult to imagine that Zo’s training has made her into such a proficient farmer, but your eyes aren’t lying – especially when she does it again. ] |She’s plucking through her garden’s fruit bush, plucking the fruit straight from the branches before placing them into her clay jar. Every now and again, she inspects one of the bush fruits, before almost guiltily popping it into her mouth for a light, quick sneak-peak of whatever she intends to do with them later. It doesn’t look like any natural bush that you’ve seen: from the way it grows around the potato patch, it looks like Zo’s managed to cultivate a small orchard of berry bushes into an unnatural shape, and you can’t tell if it’s all one large, massive, funny-shaped bush with multiple stems, or if it’s a handful of smaller ones. Either way, the shrub grows longer than it does wide or tall, and eventually curves in an L, hooking the potato patch into its curve and protecting it from the border of the grove.[var0 |From the looks of where Zo is, she’s about halfway done with cleaning the bush out – although she’d probably go a bit faster if she didn’t stop to steal a sample every few plucks. |Zo doesn’t look like she’s gone too far into her harvesting, but she also looks like she’s only just started. Then, once she’s satisfied, she leans underneath the bush, gripping it by its trunk, and giving the whole thing a single, sturdy shake... and every single berry on the bush flings through the air, their flight paths all arcing for the mouth of the pot. It almost looks like divine intervention, the way every berry funnels into the mouth of the pot with that one shake – with the exception of one, single, solitary berry, which travels almost vertically, and straight back down into Zo’s open mouth. ] ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

|她挖蔬菜的速度快得惊人，几乎让人觉得不真实：她用双手同时挖土，一只手抓土豆，另一只手抓胡萝卜，甚至都不看就直接把它们从土里挖出来，然后扔进她的陶罐里。如果她真的才刚开始挖菜，居然能这么快，那她肯定是个高手。 |而且她看起来并不是在认真地“寻找”食物，而只是…… 达到 她轻松地将手伸进土里，就像把袖子套上去一样自然。当她抓住某种植物并拔出来时，那植物丝毫没有反抗，它的根依然埋在土里。很难相信，佐的训练竟然让她成为了如此熟练的农夫，但你的眼睛不会欺骗你——尤其是当她再次做出这个动作时。 ] |她正在采摘花园里的果丛里的果实，直接将它们从树枝上摘下来，然后放入陶罐中。偶尔，她会仔细检查其中某个果实，然后几乎带着一丝内疚的心情将其放入口中，快速品尝一下，以便稍后决定该如何处理这些果实。 这种植物看起来完全不像你见过的任何天然灌木：从它围绕土豆田生长的方式来看，似乎是佐成功地将一片浆果灌木丛培育成了这种不自然的形态。你根本无法分辨这是由一株巨大而形状怪异的灌木组成的，还是由几株较小的灌木组合而成的。 无论如何，这种灌木的生长速度都是高度大于宽度，最终会呈L形弯曲，将土豆田围在弯曲的部分之内，从而保护它免受树林边缘的侵害。[var0 |从佐现在的位置来看，她应该已经清理了差不多一半的灌木丛了——不过如果她不每隔几下就停下来摘取一些样本的话，速度应该会更快一些。 |佐看起来并没有把采摘工作进行得太久，但同时也显得她才刚刚开始。而她采摘这些植物的方式，用一个不太恰当的词来形容的话…… 令人印象深刻她将浆果直接从枝子上摘下，然后让它们沿着前臂滑落；当它们到达肘部时，她会轻轻一弹，让浆果飞入陶罐中——整个过程她甚至都不需要回头看。用这样的方法，她几分钟内就能摘光整株灌木上的浆果。 |这一次，她把陶罐放在离灌木丛相当近的地方，尽量让它位于灌木丛的“下方”。等她满意之后，她就俯身到灌木丛下方，抓住它的树干，然后用力摇晃整个装置一次。……灌木丛上的每一颗浆果都被抛向空中，它们的飞行轨迹全都朝着陶罐的口部弯曲着飞去。当陶罐轻轻一摇，所有浆果都整齐地落入罐中时，这一幕简直就像是神灵的干预——唯一例外的是有一颗浆果，它几乎垂直地飞落，直接落回了佐张开的嘴里。 ] ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]
rows.raw: "\n\n Off in the far corner of the clearing is Zo, tending to her fruit and vegetable patch. She’s mostly nude, save for her underwear; her two-piece outfit hangs off the garden’s sole apple tree, on the lowest branch, each piece billowing in the wind – doing some farming work, especially if she’s bare-handed, in clothing that’s entirely white would have been more trouble to clean than it would be worth, clearly. Luckily, the grove surrounding the clearing is pretty effective at blocking wind, so she doesn’t have to worry about her clothes flying away from an errant gust[pc.corruptionRange 0 40 | |, as... entertaining as it would be. ] [rand |The fruits on the garden’s lone apple tree must have ripened fairly recently, because she’s standing in the tree’s shade, reaching for some of the lower-hanging fruits, trying to grasp at them with her hands. At her feet is her clay jar: with every apple she plucks, she places into the jar carefully, going elbow-deep before letting it go. [var0 |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. She tries to reach some of the lower ones by jumping, and her fingers brush the bottom side of the apples, knocking them around on their stems, but it’s no good: Zo is just too short to get them. She’s going to need a bit of help to harvest those ones. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. Even standing on her toes, she can’t quite reach some of the ones that are a little higher up. But with a jump, she can – she can reach every apple on the tree. Whatever training she’s been doing on the side, it’s apparently allowed her to jump [silly |good |much higher than usual ]. |The apples on the higher branches, though, are a bit more out of her league. There’s no way she’d be able to reach them, even standing on her toes – so, instead, she reaches up with her hand, and the bulbous ends of her braided hair begin to levitate on their own behind her head. Suddenly, the apple she was reaching for simply falls off its stem and into her open hand. And just to prove it wasn’t a coincidence, she does it again. ] |She’s on her hands and knees, mostly nude save for her underwear, digging into the dirt with her bare claws, trying to plough the earth and get to the vegetables ready to harvest directly. You... suppose claws could make for a replacement trowel, although they wouldn’t be very effective or sanitary. Still, from the looks of things, she’s making some decent headway: her potato patch has four plough lines (each of them likely hand-dug), and she’s halfway through the second. [var0 |With each potato and carrot she unearths, she places them in her clay pot before getting to the next one. And she doesn’t look too distraught or overworked from it either: her body moves with a certain comfortable grace, almost like she was dancing to a tune only she could hear. |She’s digging up her vegetables with surprising, almost unreal speed: she digs into the earth with both hands, reaching for a potato with one and a carrot with the other, and, without even looking, cuts it straight out of the earth and tosses it into her clay jar. She must have only just started if she’s able to work this fast. |And she doesn’t look like she’s ‘digging’ for her food so much as she’s simply... reaching for it: her hand slides into the earth almost as easily as a shirt sleeve, and when she grips onto a vegetable, it doesn’t resist when she plucks it out, leaving its roots still buried in the ground. It’s difficult to imagine that Zo’s training has made her into such a proficient farmer, but your eyes aren’t lying – especially when she does it again. ] |She’s plucking through her garden’s fruit bush, plucking the fruit straight from the branches before placing them into her clay jar. Every now and again, she inspects one of the bush fruits, before almost guiltily popping it into her mouth for a light, quick sneak-peak of whatever she intends to do with them later. It doesn’t look like any natural bush that you’ve seen: from the way it grows around the potato patch, it looks like Zo’s managed to cultivate a small orchard of berry bushes into an unnatural shape, and you can’t tell if it’s all one large, massive, funny-shaped bush with multiple stems, or if it’s a handful of smaller ones. Either way, the shrub grows longer than it does wide or tall, and eventually curves in an L, hooking the potato patch into its curve and protecting it from the border of the grove.[var0 |From the looks of where Zo is, she’s about halfway done with cleaning the bush out – although she’d probably go a bit faster if she didn’t stop to steal a sample every few plucks. |Zo doesn’t look like she’s gone too far into her harvesting, but she also looks like she’s only just started. And the way she plucks them is, for lack of a better word, impressive: she plucks them right off their stems before rolling them down her forearm, and when it gets to her elbow, she flicks it upward, sending the berries through the air and dunking into the clay pot, all without her even looking over her shoulder. She could clear the whole bush within minutes with a technique like that. |This time, she has the clay pot placed fairly close to the bush, as ‘underneath’ it as it can fit. Then, once she’s satisfied, she leans underneath the bush, gripping it by its trunk, and giving the whole thing a single, sturdy shake... and every single berry on the bush flings through the air, their flight paths all arcing for the mouth of the pot. It almost looks like divine intervention, the way every berry funnels into the mouth of the pot with that one shake – with the exception of one, single, solitary berry, which travels almost vertically, and straight back down into Zo’s open mouth. ] ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

rows.original: Zo sits in the far, grassy, unused lot in the circular plain, directly across from your path. She’s sitting cross-legged with her feet resting high on her legs, her soles pointed upward – [pc.ra catfolk |an easy position to get into and maintain, but you can’t say it’s your favorite. |you wince at even entertaining the thought of flexing your own legs into that sort of position. ] Her hands are in front of her and her elbows are pointed out, the butts of her palms pressed together and inverted from one another: her right hand’s fingers point up to the sky, while her left hand’s fingers point down at the earth. Her long, bushy tail is laid out flatly onto the grass behind her, and, most peculiarly, her hair is lifting into the air behind her, the bulbous, braided ends floating totally still behind her skull. [var0 |Her eyes are closed, and her body looks to be at total peace with itself and the world around her. You could shout her name and you don’t think you’d break her peace – or maybe her concentration, it’s difficult to tell from your distance. A light gust of wind gently billows toward you, and you don’t notice that the leaves in the trees behind Zo are likewise swaying away from her. |As usual, Zo’s eyes are closed, and her body is still – but, moreover, the whole world around her appears still as could be, too. The grass does not bend underneath its own weight; the leaves on the nearby trees do not rustle in the wind, if indeed the wind is even blowing around her; she is so still within her world that a sparrow, apparently mistaking her for an ornament, flies to her and perches on her tall, stiff, triangular ear... and it doesn’t bend underneath the bird’s weight. |Although Zo’s body is still, it’s incorrect to say that she isn’t moving. Her legs are crossed and her eyes are closed, but she is not sitting – she’s floating a good two feet straight off the ground. She, and a number of pebbles from the surrounding, grassy plain, all of which have taken two elliptical orbits around her body. The bulbous ends of her braided hair all stand on end, directly above her skull, but they don’t wave or shake in the wind: it’s almost like she’s being suspended in the air by them, as if she was a puppet and they her strings. And, throughout it all, she looks to be at total peace: you wouldn’t be surprised if she didn’t even realize what she was doing. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐坐在那片圆形平原上远处、长满草丛且无人使用的空地上，正好位于你行走路线的对面。她盘腿而坐，双足部高高搁在腿上，足部底朝上—— [pc.ra catfolk |这个职位很容易获得，也容易保持，但你也不能说这是你最喜欢的职位。 |一想到要自己把腿摆成那种姿势，你就会感到一阵不适。 ] 她的双手部举在身前，肘部向外伸展，手部掌根部相互挤压并呈反向弯曲：她的右手部手部指朝天，而左手部手部指则指向地面。她那条又长又浓密的尾巴平铺在身后的草地上，最奇特的是，她的头发也向后飘扬在空中，那些呈球状、编织好的发梢在她的头后静止地悬着。 [var0 |她的双眼紧闭，整个人仿佛与自己以及周围的世界完全处于和谐之中。即使你大声呼喊她的名字，你也不会认为这会打破她的宁静——或者也许会打扰到她的专注，但从你现在的距离来看，实在很难分辨。一阵轻风缓缓吹来，你甚至没有注意到，在佐身后的树木上，树叶也在随风轻轻摇曳。 |像往常一样，佐的眼睛紧闭着，她的身体也一动不动——而且，她周围的一切似乎也都静止不动。草儿并没有因为自身的重量而弯曲；附近树木上的叶子也没有在风中沙沙作响，毕竟是否真的有风在吹动她周围的环境呢？她…… 所以 在她自己的世界里，有一只麻雀似乎把她当成了装饰品，飞到了她身边，停在了她那高高的、僵硬的三角形耳朵上……而那耳朵在鸟的重量下竟然没有弯曲。 |虽然佐的身体静止不动，但说她完全没有在移动也不准确。她的双腿交叉着，双眼也闭着，但她并不是坐着——而是处于另一种状态。 漂浮的 她离地面有足有两英尺高。她，以及周围草地上的一些小石子，都沿着两条椭圆形的轨道绕着她的身体旋转。她那编成的辫子的末端全都竖了起来，正好位于她的头骨上方，但它们并没有在风中摆动或摇晃——就好像是她被这些辫子悬在半空中一样，就像她是一个木偶，而这些辫子则是她的牵线。 而在整个过程中，她看起来完全处于一种平静的状态：如果你知道她甚至没有意识到自己在做什么，你也不会感到惊讶。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你也会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]

rows.translation: 佐坐在那片圆形平原上遥远而长满草丛、无人使用的空地上，正好位于你前进路线的对面。她盘腿而坐，双足部高高搁在腿上，足部底朝上—— [pc.ra catfolk |这个职位很容易获得，也容易保持，但你也不能说这是你最喜欢的职位。 |一想到要自己把腿摆成那种姿势，你就忍不住会皱起眉头来。 ] 她的双手部举在身前，肘部向外伸展，手部掌根部相互挤压并呈反向弯曲：她的右手部手部指朝天，而左手部手部指则指向地面。她那条修长浓密的尾巴平铺在身后的草地上，最奇特的是，她的头发也向后飘扬在空中，那些呈球状、编织好的发梢在她的头后静止地悬着。 [var0 |她闭着双眼，整个人似乎都与自己以及周围的世界处于完全的和谐之中。即使你大声呼喊她的名字，你也不会认为这会打破她的宁静——或者也许会打扰到她的专注，但从你现在的距离来看，实在很难分辨。一阵轻风缓缓吹向你，而你却没有注意到，在佐身后的树木上，树叶也在同样地随风摇摆。 |像往常一样，佐的眼睛紧闭着，她的身体也一动不动——而且，她周围的一切似乎也都静止不动。草儿并没有因为自身的重量而弯曲；附近树木上的叶子也没有在风中沙沙作响，毕竟是否真的有风在吹动她周围的环境呢？她就处于这样一种静止的状态中。 所以 在她自己的世界里，有一只麻雀似乎把她当成了装饰品，飞到了她身边，停在了她那高高的、僵硬的三角形耳朵上……而那耳朵在鸟的重量下竟然没有弯曲。 |虽然佐的身体静止不动，但说她完全没有在移动也不准确。她的双腿交叉着，双眼也闭着，但她并不是坐着——而是处于另一种状态。 漂浮的 她高高悬在离地面大约两英尺的地方。她，以及周围草地上的一些小石子，都沿着椭圆形的轨道绕着她的身体旋转。她那编织而成的头发，其球状的发梢全都竖立着，正好位于她的头骨上方，但却没有在风中摆动或摇晃——仿佛是这些头发将她悬在了半空中，就像她是一个木偶，而那些头发则是牵动她的线一样。 而在整个过程中，她看起来完全处于一种平静的状态：如果你知道她甚至没有意识到自己在做什么，你也不会感到惊讶。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]
rows.raw: "\n\n Zo sits in the far, grassy, unused lot in the circular plain, directly across from your path. She’s sitting cross-legged with her feet resting high on her legs, her soles pointed upward – [pc.ra catfolk |an easy position to get into and maintain, but you can’t say it’s your favorite. |you wince at even entertaining the thought of flexing your own legs into that sort of position. ] Her hands are in front of her and her elbows are pointed out, the butts of her palms pressed together and inverted from one another: her right hand’s fingers point up to the sky, while her left hand’s fingers point down at the earth. Her long, bushy tail is laid out flatly onto the grass behind her, and, most peculiarly, her hair is lifting into the air behind her, the bulbous, braided ends floating totally still behind her skull. [var0 |Her eyes are closed, and her body looks to be at total peace with itself and the world around her. You could shout her name and you don’t think you’d break her peace – or maybe her concentration, it’s difficult to tell from your distance. A light gust of wind gently billows toward you, and you don’t notice that the leaves in the trees behind Zo are likewise swaying away from her. |As usual, Zo’s eyes are closed, and her body is still – but, moreover, the whole world around her appears still as could be, too. The grass does not bend underneath its own weight; the leaves on the nearby trees do not rustle in the wind, if indeed the wind is even blowing around her; she is so still within her world that a sparrow, apparently mistaking her for an ornament, flies to her and perches on her tall, stiff, triangular ear... and it doesn’t bend underneath the bird’s weight. |Although Zo’s body is still, it’s incorrect to say that she isn’t moving. Her legs are crossed and her eyes are closed, but she is not sitting – she’s floating a good two feet straight off the ground. She, and a number of pebbles from the surrounding, grassy plain, all of which have taken two elliptical orbits around her body. The bulbous ends of her braided hair all stand on end, directly above her skull, but they don’t wave or shake in the wind: it’s almost like she’s being suspended in the air by them, as if she was a puppet and they her strings. And, throughout it all, she looks to be at total peace: you wouldn’t be surprised if she didn’t even realize what she was doing. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

rows.original: Zo is standing on a tall, upright [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |log |stick |stick ] that she’s planted into the dirt, directly at the end of your footpath. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |The log is about as wide around as her own leg, and she’s standing on it with only one foot, pressed flatly against its tip |The stick is only an inch or so in diameter, and she’s standing on it with her toes, balanced on just a few small digits |The stick is only an inch or so in diameter, and she’s standing on it with her toes, balanced on just a few small digits ], while her other leg is bent at the knee, her foot pressed against her leg. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |The log isn’t very tall – maybe only about half as tall as she is, but nonetheless, it’s a solid chunk of wood that she had to find, move, then plant into the dirt by herself. |The stick is a bit on the tall side, standing upright about as tall as she is; it must have taken some time to whittle down a tree branch to be as straight, long, and sturdy as this one. |The stick is standing very tall and upright out of the ground, nearly twice as tall as she is; it must have taken some time to whittle down a tree branch to be as straight and long as this one. Owing to its length, it also doesn’t look especially sturdy. ] Her hands are in front of her and her elbows are pointed out, the butts of her palms pressed together and inverted from one another: her right hand’s fingers point up to the sky, while her left hand’s fingers point down at the earth. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |Her body is a bit shaky, standing on the log as it is: if you had to guess, her self-imposed challenge this time is to find the literal balance she needs to properly stand on the log without falling over. Every minute adjustment she makes to herself causes her to reflexively overcorrect, causing every little jostle, every little fidget, to compound on themselves, but the fact that she hasn’t tipped over yet is proof enough of her success so far. |She’s gotten rather good at it: standing so still on such a flimsy, narrow foothold is an impressive skill, and she’s gotten it down to a T. The bulbous ends of her braided hair hover laterally from her head, constantly shifting and changing on their own, while the rest of her body is seemingly motionless – maybe she hasn’t truly perfected it, and the most minute adjustments she needs to make is with her hair alone. Even still, you doubt you’d ever be able to achieve that kind of balance. |True to her form, she’s achieved true equilibrium: there is no part of her body that is off-balance with the thin, long stick she’s standing on. Even her hair, which she previously needed to maintain her balance with minute adjustments, hangs slack down her neck. A butterfly with white wings flits its way up to Zo, landing on the base of her tail – and, in response, she leans ever so slightly forward to adjust, a change so imperceptible that you’d never be able to see it yourself without your own training. When it leaves after a moment, she leans back, standing perfectly upright once again. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var0 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐站在一座高高的、笔直的建筑上。 [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |日志记录 |粘住 |粘住 ] 它被种在了泥土里，正好位于你小路的尽头。 [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |这根原木的宽度大约和她自己的腿一样，而她现在只用一只脚站在上面，将脚掌平贴在原木的顶端。 |这根棍子的直径只有一英寸左右，而她却用脚趾站在上面，仅仅依靠那几根细小的脚趾来保持平衡。 |这根棍子的直径只有一英寸左右，而她却用脚趾站在上面，仅仅依靠那几根细小的脚趾来保持平衡。 ]而她的另一条腿的膝盖处弯曲着，脚部紧贴着那条腿。 [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |这根原木并不是很高——大概只有她身高的一半左右，但无论如何，它仍然是一块坚实的木头，而她必须亲自去寻找、搬运，然后把它种到土里去。 |这根棍子有点长，直立起来时差不多和她的身高一样高；要把一根树枝削成这样笔直、这么长、这么结实，肯定花费了不少时间。 |那根棍子直直地插在地上，高度几乎是她的两倍；要把一根树枝削成这样笔直、这么长的形状，肯定花费了不少时间。正因为它的长度太长，看起来反而并不特别结实。 ] 她的双手部举在身前，肘部向外伸展，手部掌根部相互挤压并呈反向弯曲：她的右手部手部指朝天，而左手部手部指则指向地面。 [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |她的身体有些颤抖，就这样站在那根原木上：如果让你猜的话，她这次给自己设定的挑战，就是找到那种能够让她稳稳站在原木上而不会摔倒的平衡感。她所做的每一个微小的调整，都会引发她无意识的过度反应，因此哪怕是最轻微的晃动或不安，都会逐渐累积起来。但事实上，她至今还没有摔倒，这一事实本身就已经证明了她的成功。 |她已经做得相当熟练了：在如此脆弱、狭窄的立足点上保持静止，确实是一项令人赞叹的技能，而她已经将这一技巧掌握得炉火纯青。她编织而成的头发在头部两侧自然垂下，不断自行摆动变化，而她身体的其他部分却仿佛一动不动——也许她真的没有移动。 确实如此 她已经将其完善到了极致，现在她只需要对发型进行一些细微的调整而已。即便如此，你仍然会感到怀疑…… 你会…… 是否能够真正达到那种平衡。 |一如既往，她达到了真正的平衡状态：她站立时所依靠的那根细长的棍子，让她身体的每一个部位都处于稳定的位置。就连她的头发，以前还需要通过微小的调整来保持平衡，现在也自然地垂落在她的脖子上。一只拥有白色翅膀的蝴蝶飞到了佐的身边，落在了她尾巴的根部——作为回应，她微微倾斜了一下身体。 略微 这种变化是如此微妙，以至于除非你接受过专门的训练，否则根本无法察觉到它的存在。当那种感觉在片刻之后消失后，她又会挺直身体，重新站得笔直如初。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var0 |你也注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你随时都可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴在绳子上的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却根本不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]
