rows.raw: "\n\n Zo is standing on a tall, upright [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |log |stick |stick ] that she’s planted into the dirt, directly at the end of your footpath. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |The log is about as wide around as her own leg, and she’s standing on it with only one foot, pressed flatly against its tip |The stick is only an inch or so in diameter, and she’s standing on it with her toes, balanced on just a few small digits |The stick is only an inch or so in diameter, and she’s standing on it with her toes, balanced on just a few small digits ], while her other leg is bent at the knee, her foot pressed against her leg. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |The log isn’t very tall – maybe only about half as tall as she is, but nonetheless, it’s a solid chunk of wood that she had to find, move, then plant into the dirt by herself. |The stick is a bit on the tall side, standing upright about as tall as she is; it must have taken some time to whittle down a tree branch to be as straight, long, and sturdy as this one. |The stick is standing very tall and upright out of the ground, nearly twice as tall as she is; it must have taken some time to whittle down a tree branch to be as straight and long as this one. Owing to its length, it also doesn’t look especially sturdy. ] Her hands are in front of her and her elbows are pointed out, the butts of her palms pressed together and inverted from one another: her right hand’s fingers point up to the sky, while her left hand’s fingers point down at the earth. [zo.equilibriumRange 0 1 2 |Her body is a bit shaky, standing on the log as it is: if you had to guess, her self-imposed challenge this time is to find the literal balance she needs to properly stand on the log without falling over. Every minute adjustment she makes to herself causes her to reflexively overcorrect, causing every little jostle, every little fidget, to compound on themselves, but the fact that she hasn’t tipped over yet is proof enough of her success so far. |She’s gotten rather good at it: standing so still on such a flimsy, narrow foothold is an impressive skill, and she’s gotten it down to a T. The bulbous ends of her braided hair hover laterally from her head, constantly shifting and changing on their own, while the rest of her body is seemingly motionless – maybe she hasn’t truly perfected it, and the most minute adjustments she needs to make is with her hair alone. Even still, you doubt you’d ever be able to achieve that kind of balance. |True to her form, she’s achieved true equilibrium: there is no part of her body that is off-balance with the thin, long stick she’s standing on. Even her hair, which she previously needed to maintain her balance with minute adjustments, hangs slack down her neck. A butterfly with white wings flits its way up to Zo, landing on the base of her tail – and, in response, she leans ever so slightly forward to adjust, a change so imperceptible that you’d never be able to see it yourself without your own training. When it leaves after a moment, she leans back, standing perfectly upright once again. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var0 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

rows.original: Zo is standing in the doorframe to the little hut she calls her home, and standing about a dozen paces from her, in the middle of your footpath, is a training dummy, with two arms and only one leg, made of sticks and held together with twine; the dummy wears a vest of dried, woven wheat that she had plucked from elsewhere in Harvest Valley, and a helmet made of a broken metal pot with several holes around its base. Given how little material she had to work with, and the relative inexperience she has working with them, it’s an impressive scarecrow. Zo’s legs are separate and braced, and her arms are raised, rotating in a wide, slow, broad circle in front of her with her palms out. Given her stance, and the stern way she’s staring down the dummy (that you can tell, anyway – it’s difficult to say for certain underneath her silver mask), the dummy is likely a target, and not just a scarecrow. Once her hands complete the circle in front of herself, she brings them together, the butts of her palms and each of her fingertips pressed against each other. She brings them to her side, then, after a moment of focus, thrusts both of her arms forward, her two palms, still connected by their bases, pointed towards the dummy. [var0 |Nothing happens, though. The bulbous ends of Zo’s braided hair lift into the air behind her, suspended on nothing, and there’s a light gust of wind that rustles the loose fabric of her outfit, but that’s all. Undeterred, Zo starts again, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself again. |The bulbous ends of her braided hair lift into the air behind her, shaking vibrantly, and the clothes on her body flutter in a sudden rush of wind. You hear the creaking of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home's |shack’s old ]walls as a force pushes against them... but the dummy, standing a dozen feet away, doesn’t even acknowledge whatever it is Zo just tried to do. The force she had put into the strike wasn’t enough to reach it. You can’t tell whether Zo is satisfied with whatever progress she’s making, because only a moment later, she’s back at it, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself again. |As soon as she thrusts her hands forward, the clothing on her body flutters violently against her fur, caught in a fierce wind; the walls of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|old shack] creak and strain to maintain their shape; and the bulbous ends of her braided hair stand straight up, shaking intensely, held by some invisible force. The grass between Zo and the dummy bends outward, forming a pathway straight through it from it to her, sequentially pushed by something traveling at an intense speed; once it hits the dummy, it’s thrust backward, struck by an intense kinetic force, its helmet flying clear off its head. Then, suddenly, it’s all over, just as quickly as it began. Zo takes a moment to herself, satisfied with her progress – before she starts again, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself, preparing to strike the dummy from the distance she’s at once more. The dummy itself is standing – though a bit worse for wear. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐站在她称之为家的小屋的门口，而在距离她大约十几步远的小路上，有一个训练假人。这个假人有两只手部臂但只有一条腿，是由树枝拼成并用绳子固定在一起的；假人身上穿着一件用丰收谷其他地方采集来的干小麦编织而成的背心，头戴的则是一个底部有几个洞的破金属锅制成的头盔。 考虑到她可用的素材如此有限，再加上她在处理这类素材时确实经验不足，但最终做出的成果依然相当出色。 佐的双腿是分开的，并且被固定在了适当的位置上，她的双臂则高高举起，在她面前做着缓慢而宽广的圆周运动，手部掌始终朝外。 从她的姿态以及她凝视着那个假人的严肃神情来看——至少从她银色面具下透露出的神情来看，这个假人很可能是她的攻击目标，而不仅仅是一个吓人的稻草人。 当她的双手部在身前完成一圈动作后，她将双手部合拢，手部掌的背面和指尖都紧密地贴在一起。 她将他们拉到自己身边，然后集中注意力片刻后，双臂向前伸出，两只手部掌的掌心仍然相连，共同指向那个假人。 [var0 |然而，什么也没有发生。佐编织好的头发那圆润的末端在她的身后悬在空中，仿佛没有任何东西支撑着它们；有一阵微风轻轻吹过，使她衣服上的松软布料微微摆动，但也就仅此而已。毫不气馁，佐重新开始尝试——她双脚保持静止，双臂则再次在身前画出宽阔的圆圈。 |她那编成的辫子两端高高翘起，在身后随风剧烈摆动，她身上的衣服也突然被风吹得飘动起来。你能听到那些辫子发出的吱吱声…… [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|家的 |老掉牙的 ]墙壁仿佛是一股力量，不断冲击着她……但那个站在十几英尺外的假人，却丝毫没有理会Zo刚刚尝试做的那件事。她使出的力量显然还不够，无法影响到那个假人。你无法判断Zo对自己所取得的进展是否满意，因为仅仅片刻之后，她又重新开始了尝试——双腿保持静止，双臂再次在身前画出宽阔的圆弧。 |每当她将双手部向前伸出时，她身上的衣物就会在狂风中剧烈地飘动，紧紧贴在她的皮毛上；她的身体四周的墙壁…… [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|小屋|破旧的小屋] 这些物体在努力保持自己的形状，发出吱嘎声和断裂声；她编织而成的头发那些球状的末端也直直地竖立着，剧烈地摇晃着，仿佛被某种无形的力量所束缚。在佐和那个假人之间的草丛被向外推挤，形成了一条从假人延伸到她所在位置的通道——这一切都是因为有某种东西以极高的速度在移动，不断地推动着草丛；而当这些草丛碰到假人时，又会因为受到巨大的动能冲击而被向后推挤，导致假人头上的头盔被撞飞。 然后，一切突然就结束了，就像开始时一样迅速。佐花花了一点时间来反思自己的表现，对目前的进展感到满意——之后她又重新开始了练习。这次，她保持双腿静止，双臂在身前画出大圈，准备从刚才那个距离再次击打假人。 这个假人本身是站立着的——不过看起来已经有些破旧了。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴在绳子上的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却根本不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线范围的。 ]

rows.translation: 佐站在她称之为家的小屋的门口，而在距离她大约十几步远的小路上，有一个训练假人。这个假人有两只手部臂但只有一条腿，是由树枝拼成并用绳子固定在一起的；假人身上穿着一件用丰收谷其他地方采集来的干小麦编织而成的背心，头戴的则是一个底部有几个洞的破金属锅制成的头盔。 考虑到她可用的素材如此有限，再加上她在处理这类素材时确实缺乏经验，这个稻草人做得还是相当不错的。 佐的双腿是分开的，并且被固定在了适当的位置上，她的双臂则高高举起，在她面前做着缓慢而宽广的圆周运动，手部掌始终朝外。 从她的姿态以及她那凝视着假人的严肃神情来看——至少从她银色面具下透露出的神情来看，这个假人很可能是她的攻击目标，而不仅仅是一个吓人的稻草人。 当她的双手部在身前完成一圈动作后，她将双手部合拢，手部掌的背面和指尖相互紧贴在一起。 她将他们拉到自己身边，然后集中注意力片刻后，双臂向前伸出，两只手部掌的掌心仍然相连，共同指向那个假人。 [var0 |然而，什么也没有发生。佐编织而成的头发在她的背后飘扬起来，仿佛没有任何东西支撑着它们；一阵微风轻轻吹过，使她衣服上的布料发出沙沙声，但也就仅此而已。毫不气馁，佐重新开始尝试——她双腿保持静止，双臂则再次在身前画出宽阔的圆圈。 |她那编成的辫子两端高高翘起，在身后随风剧烈摆动，她身上的衣服也突然被风吹得飘动起来。你能听到那些辫子发出的吱吱声…… [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|家的 |老掉牙的 ]墙壁仿佛是一股力量，不断冲击着她……但那个站在十几英尺外的假人，甚至没有丝毫反应，仿佛完全没注意到Zo刚刚尝试做的事情。她使出的力量显然还不够，无法影响到那个假人。你无法判断Zo对自己所取得的进展是否满意，因为仅仅片刻之后，她又重新开始尝试了——双腿保持静止，双臂再次在身前画出宽阔的圆弧。 |每当她将双手部向前伸出时，她身上的衣物就会在狂风中剧烈地飘动，紧紧贴在她的皮毛上；她的身体四周的墙壁也会…… [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|小屋|破旧的小屋] 这些物体在努力维持着自己的形状，发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响；她编织而成的头发那些球状的末端也直直地竖立着，剧烈地摇晃着，仿佛被某种无形的力量所牵引。在佐和那个假人之间的草丛被向外压弯，形成了一条从假人延伸到她所在位置的通道——这一切都是因为有某种东西以极高的速度在移动，不断地推动着草丛；而当这些被推动的草丛碰到假人时，又会因为受到巨大的动能冲击而被向后推挤，导致那些假人的头盔被猛地甩掉。 然后，一切都突然结束了，就像开始时一样迅速。佐花花了一点时间来反思自己的表现，对目前的进展感到满意——之后她又重新开始了练习。这次，她双足部保持静止，双臂在身前画出大圈，准备从刚才那个距离再次击打假人。 这个假人本身是站立着的——不过看起来已经有些破旧了。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你随时都可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴住的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却根本不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]
rows.raw: "\n\n Zo is standing in the doorframe to the little hut she calls her home, and standing about a dozen paces from her, in the middle of your footpath, is a training dummy, with two arms and only one leg, made of sticks and held together with twine; the dummy wears a vest of dried, woven wheat that she had plucked from elsewhere in Harvest Valley, and a helmet made of a broken metal pot with several holes around its base. Given how little material she had to work with, and the relative inexperience she has working with them, it’s an impressive scarecrow. Zo’s legs are separate and braced, and her arms are raised, rotating in a wide, slow, broad circle in front of her with her palms out. Given her stance, and the stern way she’s staring down the dummy (that you can tell, anyway – it’s difficult to say for certain underneath her silver mask), the dummy is likely a target, and not just a scarecrow. Once her hands complete the circle in front of herself, she brings them together, the butts of her palms and each of her fingertips pressed against each other. She brings them to her side, then, after a moment of focus, thrusts both of her arms forward, her two palms, still connected by their bases, pointed towards the dummy. [var0 |Nothing happens, though. The bulbous ends of Zo’s braided hair lift into the air behind her, suspended on nothing, and there’s a light gust of wind that rustles the loose fabric of her outfit, but that’s all. Undeterred, Zo starts again, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself again. |The bulbous ends of her braided hair lift into the air behind her, shaking vibrantly, and the clothes on her body flutter in a sudden rush of wind. You hear the creaking of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home's |shack’s old ]walls as a force pushes against them... but the dummy, standing a dozen feet away, doesn’t even acknowledge whatever it is Zo just tried to do. The force she had put into the strike wasn’t enough to reach it. You can’t tell whether Zo is satisfied with whatever progress she’s making, because only a moment later, she’s back at it, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself again. |As soon as she thrusts her hands forward, the clothing on her body flutters violently against her fur, caught in a fierce wind; the walls of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|old shack] creak and strain to maintain their shape; and the bulbous ends of her braided hair stand straight up, shaking intensely, held by some invisible force. The grass between Zo and the dummy bends outward, forming a pathway straight through it from it to her, sequentially pushed by something traveling at an intense speed; once it hits the dummy, it’s thrust backward, struck by an intense kinetic force, its helmet flying clear off its head. Then, suddenly, it’s all over, just as quickly as it began. Zo takes a moment to herself, satisfied with her progress – before she starts again, keeping her legs still as her arms start the wide circle in front of herself, preparing to strike the dummy from the distance she’s at once more. The dummy itself is standing – though a bit worse for wear. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ] "

rows.original: Zo is kneeling just to the left of the footpath, closer to you than the garden, in front of a flower patch that, presumably, she planted herself. You don’t know much about flowers, and you don’t know what kind of flowers she has in her garden, but you at least know that they aren’t blooming; the petals, while all vibrant shades of pinks and reds, are closed, weighing down on their own stems, causing them to droop. They must not be in season? [var0 |Her hands are both gently cupped underneath one of the bulbs, and she’s eyeing the flower with some intensity. The bulbous ends of her braided hair vibrate on their own behind her head; all the flowers in her garden began to stretch and stand upright, pointing their closed bulbs towards her, but still, they stubbornly refuse to bloom. After a long moment, Zo blinks and turns away, rubbing at her eyes beneath her silver mask, before getting right back to it. |Her hands are planted against the soil of one of the shorter flowers, its stem hooked into the crotches of her thumb and index fingers. As she closes her eyes, the bulbous ends of her braided hair begin to lift into the air, one after the other, and every flower in the garden slowly begins to lean toward her. But, most of all, the flower right in front of her suddenly begins to grow – only a few inches in total, but that’s far more in such a short space of time than you had ever expected a floor to grow like that. Once she’s done, she cups the bulb of the flower in both her hands, but does nothing more. |Zo kneels in front of the whole flower garden, her eyes shut and her hair floating flatly behind her, evenly spaced out from her head. At first, nothing happens – but, after a few moments, each of the flowers in the garden, starting with the ones furthest from her and ending with the ones closest, each begin to lean towards her as they bulbs peel back and bloom, revealing their vibrant purples, yellows, and oranges to her. When she opens her eyes, she smiles, and the flowers all gently lean back into their upright position. ] Once you step into the clearing, Zo’s ears perk, and the bulbous, braided ends of her hair quiver on their own. She turns, and as soon as she sees you, she smiles and waves, welcoming you into her clearing. [var1 |You also notice that, in the time since you last left her, the bodily magic she used on herself to make her breasts larger and lactating has since worn off, and she’s returned to her original C-cup shape and form. You could always ask her to go back to their stature, of course.... ] [zo.hasKids |Notably absent is Vai; with Zo being his mother, normally, he’s practically tied to her like a dog on a leash, but he’s not anywhere to be seen at the moment. He must be having a nap in his crib; there’s no way Zo would have let him out of her sight otherwise. ]
rows.translation: 佐正跪在小路左侧，离你比花园更近，站在一片她自己种植的花丛前。你对花卉了解不多，也不清楚她花园里种的是什么花，但至少你可以看出这些花并没有开花——那些色彩鲜艳的粉色和红色花瓣都紧紧闭合着，沉甸甸地挂在花茎上，使得花朵整体都低垂下来。看来这些花现在应该还不是花期吧？ [var0 |她的双手轻轻地将其中一株球茎捧在手中，目光紧紧地注视着那朵花。她编织而成的长发在背后微微晃动；她花园里的所有花朵都开始伸长身子，直立起来，将那些闭合的球茎朝向她方向，但它们依然固执地不肯绽放。过了一会儿，佐眨了眨眼，转过头去，在银色面具下揉了揉眼睛，然后又继续开始她的动作。 |她的双手紧贴着其中一朵较矮的花朵的茎部，那花茎紧紧钩住了她的拇指和食指的指缝。当她闭上眼睛时，她那编成辫子的头发的一簇簇发梢开始一根根地飘向空中，而花园里的每一朵花也缓缓地朝着她的方向倾斜过来。 但最重要的是，她眼前的那朵花突然开始生长了——虽然总共只长了几英寸，但在这么短的时间内，这样的生长速度远远超出了人们的预期。当花朵长到一定程度后，她用双手将花球捧在手中，之后便再也没有采取任何行动。 |佐跪在整片花园的前面，双眼紧闭，头发平展地垂在身后，均匀地散开。起初，什么也没有发生——但过了一会儿，花园里的每一朵花，从最远的那朵开始，一直到最近的那朵，都开始向她倾斜。它们的花蕾逐渐绽放，展现出鲜艳的紫色、黄色和橙色，将它们的美丽展现给了她。 当她睁开眼睛时，露出了微笑，那些花朵便全都轻轻地向后仰去，重新恢复到了直立的姿势。 ] 一旦你走进那片空地，佐的耳朵就会立刻竖起来，她那束蓬松的、编成辫子的头发也会自动开始颤动。她转过身来，一看到你，就立刻露出了笑容，挥手部欢迎你来到她的这片空地。 [var1 |你还会注意到，在你上次离开她之后，她曾经使用在自己身上、用来让胸部变大并促进乳汁分泌的魔法效果已经消失了，她的胸部也恢复到了原本的C罩杯大小和形态。 你完全可以邀请她再次回到他们身边。 身高 当然…… ] [zo.hasKids |值得注意的是，Vai并没有出现。既然Zo是他的母亲，通常情况下，他应该像被拴在绳子上的狗一样一直跟着她，但此刻他却根本不见踪影。他肯定正在婴儿床里小睡吧；否则Zo绝对不会让他离开自己的视线。 ]

rows.original: Enter Zo’s house and see what sort of living condition she’s putting up with.
rows.translation: 走进佐的家，看看她究竟是在什么样的生活环境中生活的。
rows.raw: "Enter Zo’s house and see what sort of living condition she’s putting up with."

rows.original: Get a better look at Zo. She probably wouldn’t mind!
rows.translation: 仔细看看佐吧，她应该不会介意的！
rows.raw: "Get a better look at Zo. She probably wouldn’t mind!"

rows.original: Zo’s method of training is unique, and focuses more on building up the self’s body than learning how to move with any weapon. She’d probably appreciate a training partner, and you might be able to learn a thing or two yourself.
rows.translation: 佐的训练方法与众不同，她更注重增强自身的身体素质，而非学习如何使用各种武器进行战斗。她可能会需要一个训练伙伴，而你或许也能从中学到一些东西。
rows.raw: "Zo’s method of training is unique, and focuses more on building up the self’s body than learning how to move with any weapon. She’d probably appreciate a training partner, and you might be able to learn a thing or two yourself."

rows.original: You can’t hope to match Zo’s pace without becoming a reclusive monk like herself, and any more training is likely going to exhaust and confuse you. Better to let what you’ve learned today settle before going again.
rows.translation: 如果你不想像佐那样变成一个与世隔绝的隐士，就根本不可能跟上她的速度；继续训练只会让你精疲力竭、陷入困惑。最好先让今天学到的知识在心中沉淀一下，然后再继续努力。
rows.raw: "You can’t hope to match Zo’s pace without becoming a reclusive monk like herself, and any more training is likely going to exhaust and confuse you. Better to let what you’ve learned today settle before going again."

rows.original: Zo has the uncanny ability to... cleanse a person of the taint that has pervaded their bodies and their souls, bit by bit. [pc.corruptionRange 1 50|Some part of you is remiss to ask her to take your burdens onto herself, but you could use the help, and surely she’d be happy to help you.|As fun as it is being, well, who you are, there’s a niggling voice in your heart of hearts that won’t shut the hell up if you don’t at least ask.]
rows.translation: 佐拥有某种不可思议的能力…… 净化 一个被那种污秽逐渐侵蚀了身体与灵魂的人。 [pc.corruptionRange 1 50|你内心有一部分在犹豫，不敢让她来承担你的负担，但实际上你很需要她的帮助，而她肯定也会乐意帮助你的。|尽管这样很有趣，也很符合你的性格，但在你内心深处，总有一个声音不停地提醒你：如果你不至少试一试，这个声音就永远不会停止唠叨。]
rows.raw: "Zo has the uncanny ability to... cleanse a person of the taint that has pervaded their bodies and their souls, bit by bit. [pc.corruptionRange 1 50|Some part of you is remiss to ask her to take your burdens onto herself, but you could use the help, and surely she’d be happy to help you.|As fun as it is being, well, who you are, there’s a niggling voice in your heart of hearts that won’t shut the hell up if you don’t at least ask.]"

rows.original: You’ve already asked Zo to cleanse you of your corruption today. You don’t want to overload the poor girl, and you doubt she’d say yes anyway. She needs her rest, too!
rows.translation: 你今天已经请求佐帮助你清除内心的污秽了。你不想给这个可怜的女孩增添太多负担，而且你也怀疑她是否会答应你的请求。她也需要休息啊！
rows.raw: "You’ve already asked Zo to cleanse you of your corruption today. You don’t want to overload the poor girl, and you doubt she’d say yes anyway. She needs her rest, too!"

rows.original: Your body and your soul are totally clean of any and all corruption! You don’t need Zo to perform this on you.
rows.translation: 你的身体与灵魂已经彻底清除了所有的污秽与邪恶！你根本不需要Zo来为你做这件事。
rows.raw: "Your body and your soul are totally clean of any and all corruption! You don’t need Zo to perform this on you."

rows.original: Zo lives in some derelict shack out in the middle of nowhere. This is no place for anyone to be living, let alone by themselves – bring up the possibility of fixing her home up.
rows.translation: 佐住在一个偏远地区的破旧小屋里。这样的地方根本不适合任何人居住，更别说让一个人独自生活了——有人提议帮她修缮房子。
rows.raw: "Zo lives in some derelict shack out in the middle of nowhere. This is no place for anyone to be living, let alone by themselves – bring up the possibility of fixing her home up."

rows.original: Ask Zo if you can... see the baby again, as she had shown you when she first conceived.
rows.translation: 你可以问问Zo看是否可以…… 看到 那个宝宝，就像她最初怀孕时向你展示的那样。
rows.raw: "Ask Zo if you can... see the baby again, as she had shown you when she first conceived."

rows.original: You, Zo, and Vai are a family now. Why not spend some time with them together?
rows.translation: 你现在和佐、瓦伊是一家人了，为什么不一起花些时间陪陪他们呢？
rows.raw: "You, Zo, and Vai are a family now. Why not spend some time with them together?"

rows.original: Zo has very few personal possessions – she sleeps on what could charitably be called a ‘pile.’ But that’s no good for a baby: [zo.isPregnant|it’s|Vai’s] going to need [zo.isPregnant|it’s|his] own, proper crib.
rows.translation: 佐几乎没有个人物品——她睡觉的地方，用客气点的说法，也就是一堆乱七八糟的东西。但这对一个婴儿来说，显然不太合适。 [zo.isPregnant|它是|Vai的] 需要 [zo.isPregnant|它是|他的] 自己的小窝。
rows.raw: "Zo has very few personal possessions – she sleeps on what could charitably be called a ‘pile.’ But that’s no good for a baby: [zo.isPregnant|it’s|Vai’s] going to need [zo.isPregnant|it’s|his] own, proper crib."

rows.original: You have the crib parts with you, and Gwyneth was clear that the instructions ought to be easy enough for a [pc.isDK|idiot.|‘fool.’] You and Zo should be able to put it together
rows.translation: 你手头有那些零件，而且格温妮丝也明确说过，这些说明书应该足够简单，任何人都能看懂。 [pc.isDK|白痴。|傻瓜。] 你应该能和佐一起完成这件事。
rows.raw: "You have the crib parts with you, and Gwyneth was clear that the instructions ought to be easy enough for a [pc.isDK|idiot.|‘fool.’] You and Zo should be able to put it together"

rows.original: Now that you and Zo are a bit more physically and intimately acquainted, surely she’d be all too eager to get started on some... alternative training.
rows.translation: 现在你和佐在身体上和感情上都已经更加亲密了，她肯定也会非常乐意开始一些…… 替代方案 训练。
rows.raw: "Now that you and Zo are a bit more physically and intimately acquainted, surely she’d be all too eager to get started on some... alternative training."

rows.original: Zo’s open to the idea of taking your relationship to the next level, if you’d have her. You rebuked her the last time she offered – hopefully, she’s still willing to cross that line with you, now that you’re a bit more ready.
rows.translation: 如果你愿意的话，Zo很愿意将你们的关系提升到一个新的阶段。上次她提出这个想法时，你拒绝了她；不过希望现在你准备得更充分了，她仍然愿意和你一起迈出这一步。
rows.raw: "Zo’s open to the idea of taking your relationship to the next level, if you’d have her. You rebuked her the last time she offered – hopefully, she’s still willing to cross that line with you, now that you’re a bit more ready."

rows.original: You never know, maybe she’s a bit more receptive to it than she appears. You won’t know until you try, right?
rows.translation: 谁知道呢，也许她对这件事的接受程度比看上去要高一些。只有尝试过了才能知道，对吧？
rows.raw: "You never know, maybe she’s a bit more receptive to it than she appears. You won’t know until you try, right?"

rows.translation: 佐拥有那种神秘的能量，因此她能够施展许多身体技巧。如果她能用这种能量来治愈伤口，那么她是否也能用它来……让自己的资产变得更多呢？

rows.original: Zo is a lupine woman standing at a little less than six feet tall. She has tall, pointed, triangular ears on top of her head, framing a head of back-length, dusky-black hair that’s been braided into four long strands, each of them capped into a bulbous knot. The knots are pinched at their tops with silver rings, and whenever Zo does her mystical energy tricks, the four braided strands move seemingly on their own, acting as a focus for her and her techniques. Zo’s fur is long and straight all throughout, but is thick and coarse, making it uncomfortable for her to brush against the grain. It has darker, bolder colors all throughout: browns and tans make up most of her ears, face, neck, and shoulders, with her back being solid black all the way down to just above her rear, and all along the upper side of her ankle-length tail. Her front is colored cream, starting at her lower jaw, with it turning full, snowy white down her front, curving into a white V at her crotch. The upper side of her arms and the front of her legs are light-brown, while the undersides and the backs are darker. [zo.pregDays 30 90 150 |Sitting on her chest are a pair of [zo.isLactating |large, fat, milky E-cups that strain against the top of her outfit, staining them with her milk. Beneath them, her stomach muscles are so thoroughly defined that you can make out the ridges and curves of her abs even through the thickness of her fur. It hangs off her arms and billows around her legs; the front of her top hangs over her waistline, with the lower hem being sewn into a broader opening, giving it greater flexibility around her thighs, and her pants are kept up by a too-broad fabric belt that’s slightly off-white compared to the rest of her outfit. While it looks too large, its excess material ensures that she has total freedom of movement without being so cumbersome and overdone that she risks tripping over herself. Also, the rip that her top had taken when you first met her has been hand-sewn – it isn’t an expert job and the fix isn’t seamless with the rest of the fabric, but you can tell that it also wasn’t her first patch job. She doesn’t usually wear it when she isn’t training, but, likewise, she doesn’t remove it when she is. 她穿着一套白色制服，纽扣部位以及手腕处都装饰着银色的边纹；乍一看，这套服装似乎对她来说有点太大，但这种设计似乎是故意的。制服松松地挂在她的手臂上，下摆在大腿处自然摆动；上衣的前部垂到了她的腰际，而下摆则被缝成了一个更宽的开口，这样就能让她的大腿部位活动得更自如。她的裤子则用一条颜色略偏米白色的宽布料腰带系着。 虽然如此…… 看起来 尺寸太大，多余的布料使得她能够拥有完全的活动自由。 没有 rows.raw: " Zo is a lupine woman standing at a little less than six feet tall. She has tall, pointed, triangular ears on top of her head, framing a head of back-length, dusky-black hair that’s been braided into four long strands, each of them capped into a bulbous knot. The knots are pinched at their tops with silver rings, and whenever Zo does her mystical energy tricks, the four braided strands move seemingly on their own, acting as a focus for her and her techniques. Zo’s fur is long and straight all throughout, but is thick and coarse, making it uncomfortable for her to brush against the grain. It has darker, bolder colors all throughout: browns and tans make up most of her ears, face, neck, and shoulders, with her back being solid black all the way down to just above her rear, and all along the upper side of her ankle-length tail. Her front is colored cream, starting at her lower jaw, with it turning full, snowy white down her front, curving into a white V at her crotch. The upper side of her arms and the front of her legs are light-brown, while the undersides and the backs are darker. [zo.pregDays 30 90 150 |Sitting on her chest are a pair of [zo.isLactating |large, fat, milky E-cups that strain against the top of her outfit, staining them with her milk. It’ll take time for them to revert back to C-cups, but she doesn’t seem to mind – it’s possibly a unique challenge for her, to maintain her training while her body is so top-heavy and off-balance |pert, firm C-cups that move and bounce less than you’d think with her motions – keeping the girls in check must be a part of her training (or she’s using her body’s energy to hold them still) ]. Beneath them, her stomach muscles are so thoroughly defined that you can make out the ridges and curves of her abs even through the thickness of her fur, although the bump of her pregnancy is starting to show underneath them. The rest of her body, while toned and defined, aren’t so muscular, aside from her hips and thighs, which are wider across than her shoulders – she’s a strong woman, and she’d be able to hold her own in any fight, but you also probably wouldn’t bet on her in any competitions... provided she didn’t intend to cheat by using her life’s energy to help her lift. |Sitting on her chest are a pair of large, fat, milky E-cups that strain against the top of her outfit, staining them with her milk. The pregnancy has started taking its toll on her breasts – if you can consider bigger boobs a ‘toll’ – and they’re starting to strain against the form-fitting top of her outfit, and her milk occasionally makes wet stains against the fabric. Beneath them, her stomach muscles are so thoroughly defined that you can make out the ridges and curves of her abs even through the thickness of her fur, but they pale in comparison to the rotundity of her pregnant bump; the kid inside of her is growing rather quickly, and easily fills out the whole of her stomach. The rest of her body, while toned and defined, aren’t so muscular, aside from her hips and thighs, which are wider across than her shoulders – she’s a strong woman, and she’d be able to hold her own in any fight, but you also probably wouldn’t bet on her in any competitions... provided she didn’t intend to cheat by using her life’s energy to help her lift. |Sitting on her chest are a pair of large, fat, milky E-cups that strain against the top of her outfit, staining them with her milk. The pregnancy has started taking its toll on her breasts – if you can consider bigger boobs a ‘toll’ – and they’re starting to strain against the form-fitting top of her outfit, and her milk occasionally makes wet stains against the fabric. It won’t be too much longer before the baby is ready. It’ll take time for them to revert back to C-cups, but she doesn’t seem to mind – it’s possibly a unique challenge for her, to maintain her training while her body is so top-heavy and off-balance |pert, firm C-cups that move and bounce less than you’d think with her motions – keeping the girls in check must be a part of her training (or she’s using her body’s energy to hold them still) ]. Beneath them, her stomach muscles are so thoroughly defined that you can make out the ridges and curves of her abs even through the thickness of her fur. The rest of her body, while toned and defined, aren’t so muscular, aside from her hips and thighs, which are wider across than her shoulders – she’s a strong woman, and she’d be able to hold her own in any fight, but you also probably wouldn’t bet on her in any competitions... provided she didn’t intend to cheat by using her life’s energy to help her lift. ] She wears a white uniform with silver trimmings along her buttoned-front and along her wrists; at first glance, the getup looks to be about a size too large for her, but that appears to have been intentional. It hangs off her arms and billows around her legs; the front of her top hangs over her waistline, with the lower hem being sewn into a broader opening, giving it greater flexibility around her thighs, and her pants are kept up by a too-broad fabric belt that’s slightly off-white compared to the rest of her outfit. While it looks too large, its excess material ensures that she has total freedom of movement without being so cumbersome and overdone that she risks tripping over herself. Also, the rip that her top had taken when you first met her has been hand-sewn – it isn’t an expert job and the fix isn’t seamless with the rest of the fabric, but you can tell that it also wasn’t her first patch job. Finally, Zo has a mask made of pure silver that’s been specially made and fitted for her and her lupine face. It covers her cheeks, temples, and her nose and eyes, with a hook going up and between her ears to keep it steady, but it has holes for her to breathe and see through. She doesn’t usually wear it when she isn’t training, but, likewise, she doesn’t remove it when she is. Coupled with the silver rings capping the bulbs in her braided hair, your best guess is that they help her with focusing her energies while she’s performing her techniques."

rows.original: You ask Zo if she’s willing to perform that technique that she did on you not too long ago. You don’t know if what she did was quantifiable; all you know is that, immediately after, you felt... cleaner. More focused. More like... yourself. [pc.corruptionRange 0 50 |You hope it’s not too much to ask from her: the last time she did it, she seemed pretty exhausted afterwards. |As much fun as it is not giving a damn and doing what you like, when you like, with or to you like, you have to admit, whatever she did to you, it felt better than how you feel now. ] Zo smiles and nods, more than happy to oblige. She steps forward, introducing herself into your personal space, and extends her hands, her fingers finding your shoulder. Before, you were a bit apprehensive about whatever it was she was going to do, but this time, you know what to expect, and you don’t resist. Before she begins, her eyes close in a hard, elongated blink, and when they open, her deep, emerald-green eyes have turned into a shimmering silver, glowing against the silver of her mask. Whenever your eyes begin to wander, like bees to honeydew, they’re brought back to her own. Zo stares intently in your direction – not so much at you as it is through you, focused on something that is about you and pertains to you, but is, at the same time, not you. She lowers her right hand to your chest, her fingers against your collarbone, and then she straightens them, her claws sharply jutting against your [pc.skinFurScales], before splaying, each finger coming to rest at different, and very specific and deliberate, spots along your neck. They tense and rub against your collar, and then– Like you had hoped she would do, and like she had done, you suddenly feel... lighter. Clearer. Different, but also, the same: you feel like how you were a lifetime ago, but, at the same time, you feel the same way you’ve always had. It was like you were wearing torn, heavy, dirty clothing, and you had simply removed it[pc.corruptionRange 1 100 |; it’s not a massive, life-altering change, but it’s real, tangible difference ]. You feel [pc.corruptionRange 0 1 33 66 |whole again. Purified. Cleansed. And it’s all thanks to Zo. |much better; like you had stepped out of a bath and the day’s grime has been washing from your [pc.skinFurScales]. |not a whole lot different, to be honest – if you had just removed a dirty shirt, you still need to remove your dirty pants, and then wash your dirty [pc.skinFurScales]. But it’s a start. |largely unchanged, on the whole, but whatever change there was is perceptible enough for you to know that she isn’t a quack. You’re deep in the shit, as it were, and Zo’s pulled you out by less than an inch, but it’s less than an inch that you’ve redeemed for yourself. ] Zo pulls back, returning her hands to her side, and, with a blink, her eyes return to their deep emerald-green state. She smiles at you sweetly, but the curves of her lips don’t reach quite as high, and her eyelids are beginning to droop. Whatever she’s done, it must be a bit tiring. Still, she’s more than happy to have you here, and she bounds on her toes, rocking back and forth, with her green eyes on you, waiting for you to break the ice. It’s not like she’s about to start, after all.
rows.translation: 你询问佐是否愿意再次使用她不久前对你使用过的那种技巧。你并不确定她当时所做的效果如何。 可量化的你只知道，在那一刻之后，你会感到……更加清醒。更加专注。更加像……真正的自己。 [pc.corruptionRange 0 50 |你希望这个要求对她来说不会太过分：上次她做这件事的时候，之后看起来确实非常疲惫。 |尽管随心所欲、为所欲为、在任何你想做的时间做你想做的事情确实很有趣，但…… 向 你得承认，不管她对你做了什么，那种感觉确实存在。 更好 比你现在的感受还要糟糕。 ] 佐微笑着点了点头，非常乐意帮忙。她走上前，进入了你的个人空间，伸出了双手部，她的手部指轻轻触到了你的肩膀。之前，你对她要做的任何事情都感到有些忐忑不安，但这一次，你知道会发生什么，所以没有反抗。 在她开始说话之前，她会紧紧地闭上眼睛，长长地眨动一下；当她再次睁开眼睛时，那双深邃的翡翠绿眼睛已经变成了闪烁的银色，在她银色的面具映照下熠熠生辉。每当你的目光开始游离，就像蜜蜂被蜜糖吸引一样，它们总会再次被吸引回到她的双眼上。 佐正专注地盯着你的方向——不过其实并没有那么专注。 在……时候 你本来就是这样的。 通过 你，专注于某件事情…… 关于 你和…… 与……相关 对你来说是这样，但同时，又并非如此。 你她将右手部放在你的胸前，手部指触碰到你的锁骨，然后她伸直手部臂，那些锋利的指甲紧紧地抵在你的身上。 [pc.skinFurScales]在开始演奏之前，你的每一根手部指都会落在脖子上不同的、非常精确且经过刻意安排的位置。这些手部指会绷紧，然后与你的衣领摩擦…… 正如你所希望的那样，也正如她确实做到的那样，你突然感到……轻松了许多。思绪也变得清晰起来。有些不同，却又仿佛一切如旧：你感觉自己仿佛回到了很久以前的状态，但同时，那种感受也与你一直以来所拥有的感觉并无二致。就好像你之前穿着一件破旧、重型、肮脏的衣服，而现在，你终于把它脱掉了。[pc.corruptionRange 1 100 |这并不是一个会彻底改变人们生活的巨大变化，但确实存在，而且这种变化是真实可感的。 ]你感觉…… [pc.corruptionRange 0 1 33 66 |恢复如初。得到了净化。 已净化。 而这一切都要归功于Zo。 |好多了；就好像你刚从浴缸里出来，一天的污垢都被冲洗掉了。 [pc.skinFurScales]. |说实话，并没有太大区别——如果你只是脱掉了脏衬衫，那么你还是需要脱掉脏裤子，然后把它们都洗干净。 [pc.skinFurScales]但这总是一个开始吧。 |总体而言，变化不大，但即便存在一些变化，也…… 是 这种迹象已经足够明显，让你明白她并不是个骗子。可以说，你现在正处于困境之中，而Zo只是把你从深渊中拉了出来而已——但正是这短短的一寸距离，让你重新获得了自我救赎的机会。 ] 佐收回双手部，将它们放在身体两侧，眨了眨眼，她的眼睛又恢复了那深绿色的色泽。她甜美地对你笑了笑，但她的嘴角并没有上扬到最高处，眼睑也开始下垂。不管她刚才做了什么，肯定让她感到有些疲惫。 不过，她还是很高兴你能来到这里。她踮起脚尖，身体前后摇晃着，那双绿色的眼睛紧紧地盯着你，等待着你先开口打破沉默。毕竟，她并不会主动开始这个话题的。

rows.original: [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3 |You enter the little building that sits at the edge of the grove. The building isn’t especially large: it’s the size of maybe three or four rooms at a typical inn, but without any walls to separate them, and the building is more akin to a great big box than a real house or living space. On the outside, all four walls have recently been replaced with cut logs that couldn’t have been a few weeks old when they were first installed, their bark facing outward. The building stands straight up, with a sturdy base and a good, thick roof that’s been fastened in place with corks and screws. The building has two glass windows, one on the north and south wall each, both of them just as new and crystal-clear. The only doorframe in the building has a brand new door installed, fastened into the doorframe with hinges that are so new that they don’t creak when the door swings. The interior of the house matches the exterior for quality and recency: before, the floor would creak underneath your footsteps and the whole thing was marked and scratched after years and years of furniture being scraped over it. Now, the floor doesn’t make a sound underneath your footsteps, and its wood is fresh enough that the sunlight bouncing off it illuminates the room in a warm golden-bronze glow. There’s a fire pit in the southwestern corner with a chimney that’s been recently set with caulk so fresh that you’d think you could swipe your finger along it and it’s slough off. There is no furniture, save for [zo.vaiExists |a crib [flags.ZO_CRIB 3 |made of sturdy oak that you and Zo had made yourselves |made of ramshackle sticks and twigs that Zo managed to wrangle together herself ], and ]a small bed that Zo’s made for herself in the far corner beneath the northern window, and even it is little more than a pile of hay and grass clipping with two blankets on top of a bed frame. The few material items that Zo owns – some sewing equipment, including thread; a washing board; some basic cooking utensils; a metal cooking pot; a large, claw bucket; and a cup – are neatly strewn about the bed, within arm’s reach of the edge. Overall, it’s unconventional as far as a home goes – it’s all one room, after all, with no kitchen, closets, dedicated bedroom, or space for guests, like a living room or even a foyer – but it’s a pretty cozy place, especially after all the repairs. The roof is tall and sturdy; the walls are strong and thick; the floor is tough and robust, absorbing your footsteps perfectly... and, the one feature that Zo likes the most: the door is brand new and has a deadbolt. |You enter the dilapidated little building that sits at the edge of the grove. The building isn’t especially large: it’s the size of maybe three or four rooms at a typical inn, but without any walls to separate them, and the building is more akin to a great big box than a real house or building. On the outside, the walls are showing signs of rot and wear, having been battered by the elements for too many years without any real upkeep. The wooden walls are still standing straight, but their logs are starting to soften and they’ve long since turned green from decay and moss. The building has two glass windows, one on the north and south wall each, and, while they’re dirty, they’re still intact. The only doorframe in the building is missing its door completely. The interior of the house isn’t exactly much better: the floor creaks and moans with your every footstep, and the floor is marked and scratched all to hell from things being dragged across it for a generation. There’s a fire pit against the eastern wall, with a stone chimney that looks like a good, solid strike from a hammer or even a boot could cause the whole thing to dislodge. There is no furniture, save for a small bed that Zo’s made for herself in the far corner, beneath the northern window, and even it is little more than a pile of hay and grass clippings with two blankets. The few material items that Zo owns – some sewing equipment, including thread; a washing board; some basic cooking utensils; a metal cooking pot; a large, clay bucket; and a cup – are neatly strewn about her bed, within arm’s reach of the edge. Still, it’s better than nothing: the ceiling is undamaged, keeping the rain and snow from piling down, and the walls at least provide some semblance of protection. It’s far from a lost cause: it just needs some attention – maybe add some interior walls to separate the place into rooms, to give it a cozier feel; replace and repair the exterior walls, giving it some extra life; maybe thatch the roof a bit for some insulation; give it a new door; clean out the fire pit and replace the chimney stone-by-stone – and it could be turned into a lovely little hut for Zo to sleep in. ] [var0 |Zo herself is nowhere to be seen, and her things have been left so undisturbed that you could be told that the place has been abandoned for years, and you’d believe it. Knowing her, though, she’s probably just outdoors, training. |[var1 |Zo sits at the edge of her bed, mostly naked save for a plain, featureless, white bra and panties, with the top of her white suit lying across her lap. She’s running the needle and thread through it, patching a hole she’s torn into it with her training. When you enter her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|hut], she waves to you and smiles – apparently not the least little bit concerned about being underdressed, but, well, this is her home – but doesn’t get up to greet you. |Zo sits at the fire pit, prodding at a small fire she’s made underneath her metal cooking pot. You can hear the sound of water boiling in between the occasional clinks and clanks of her utensils poking around in it; although she’s clearly cooking something, it doesn’t have much of a smell. She looks over her shoulder to you, and smiles and waves once she recognizes you, but she isn’t in a hurry to show you in, and instead goes right back to her cooking pot. |Zo is sitting on both her knees, her legs tucked beneath her body, in front of a small line of six candles placed in a straight row along the fire pit. She has her hands together, the butts of her palms pressed against each other: her left hand’s fingers pointed to the floor while her right’s are pointed to the ceiling. Her eyes and mouth are shut; her triangular ears stand upright on her head, unflinching; and her braided hair occasionally quivers and moves on its own at their bulbous tips. But, as soon as you enter, her concentration is broken, and her eyes open to see you. She doesn’t seem too upset, though: she greets you with a warm smile and a wave, although she lets you see yourself in. |Zo sits underneath the southern window, mostly naked save for a plain, featureless, white bra and panties, diligently scrubbing her outfit against her washing board. Her top’s already been done and hangs by a string she had rigged up against the window on the wall, and she’s gotten started on her pants, scrubbing at the fabric and getting them as white and clean as you know they can be. When you walk into the building, she greets you with a warm smile and a wave – apparently unconcerned about being underdressed, but, well, it’s not like she owns another outfit – but she doesn’t stop her cleaning to greet you, and lets you show yourself in. |Zo sits underneath the southern window, her hands dipping into her large, clay pot again and again, splashing around some water she’s collected into it. When she pulls her hands out, you can see the gleam of silver in the moonlight streaming in through the window – she’s polishing her mask, and every time she pulls it out, she looks it over for any chinks or deformities. When you step into the building, she smiles and waves to you, the mask still in her hand, before she goes right back to polishing, apparently not in a rush to show you in. ] |Zo is sound asleep in her bed, face-down into her makeshift pillow. Her clothes are left on a laundry line hanging over the opposite window; beside her bed are her shortsword, kept in its scabbard, and her more unique weapon: the two sticks held together by rope. She doesn’t rouse when you enter the building... but her braided hair, resting on her back, quivers slightly, the bulbous ends lifting into the air less than an inch once you set foot into the room. rows.translation: [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3 |你走进了那座位于小树林边缘的小房子。这座房子并不大：大概只有普通客栈里三四个房间的大小，而且没有墙壁将这些房间分隔开来，因此它更像是一个巨大的箱子，而不是真正的房屋或居住空间。 从外观上看，这栋建筑的四面墙最近都被换成了新砍下的原木，这些原木在安装时肯定还不到几周大，它们的树皮都是朝外的。这座建筑竖立得非常笔直，基座十分坚固，屋顶也厚实耐用，所有部件都是用螺丝和钉子固定好的。 这座建筑有两扇玻璃窗，北墙和南墙各有一扇，这两扇窗都崭新的，透明度极高。建筑里唯一的门框上安装着一扇全新的门，门扇通过铰链与门框连接在一起，这些铰链非常新，以至于门在开关时不会发出任何吱嘎声。 房子的内部装修在质量与新颖程度上都与外部风格相匹配：以前，走在地板上时脚底下会发出吱吱声，而且由于多年来各种家具不断摩擦，整个地板都布满了痕迹和划痕。 此刻，你的脚步踩在地板上时不会发出任何声响，而地板的木质材质十分新鲜，阳光照射在上面后，会散发出温暖的金铜色光芒，照亮整个房间。房间的西南角有一个火坑，旁边还有一根烟囱——最近人们刚刚用密封材料对它进行了修补，修补得如此彻底，以至于你甚至觉得可以用手指去触碰它，它都不会有任何松动或脱落的迹象。 除了……之外，没有任何家具。 [zo.vaiExists |一个婴儿床 [flags.ZO_CRIB 3 |这种材料是由坚固的橡木制成的，而这块橡木正是你和Zo一起亲手制作的。 |这些东西是由佐自己动手用一些破旧的树枝和细枝拼凑而成的。 ]，以及 ]在北窗下方的那个角落里，Zo为自己搭了一张小床，甚至…… 它 总体来说，这种住宅设计确实有些非传统——毕竟整个房子只有一个房间，没有厨房、衣柜、专用的卧室，也没有供客人使用的空间，甚至连客厅或门厅都没有——但经过一番修缮之后，这里确实变得相当舒适了。 屋顶高大结实，墙壁坚固厚实，地板坚硬耐用，能够完美地吸收你的脚步声……而Zo最喜欢的，就是那扇崭新的门，它还装了防盗锁。 rows.raw: " [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3 |You enter the little building that sits at the edge of the grove. The building isn’t especially large: it’s the size of maybe three or four rooms at a typical inn, but without any walls to separate them, and the building is more akin to a great big box than a real house or living space. On the outside, all four walls have recently been replaced with cut logs that couldn’t have been a few weeks old when they were first installed, their bark facing outward. The building stands straight up, with a sturdy base and a good, thick roof that’s been fastened in place with corks and screws. The building has two glass windows, one on the north and south wall each, both of them just as new and crystal-clear. The only doorframe in the building has a brand new door installed, fastened into the doorframe with hinges that are so new that they don’t creak when the door swings. The interior of the house matches the exterior for quality and recency: before, the floor would creak underneath your footsteps and the whole thing was marked and scratched after years and years of furniture being scraped over it. Now, the floor doesn’t make a sound underneath your footsteps, and its wood is fresh enough that the sunlight bouncing off it illuminates the room in a warm golden-bronze glow. There’s a fire pit in the southwestern corner with a chimney that’s been recently set with caulk so fresh that you’d think you could swipe your finger along it and it’s slough off. There is no furniture, save for [zo.vaiExists |a crib [flags.ZO_CRIB 3 |made of sturdy oak that you and Zo had made yourselves |made of ramshackle sticks and twigs that Zo managed to wrangle together herself ], and ]a small bed that Zo’s made for herself in the far corner beneath the northern window, and even it is little more than a pile of hay and grass clipping with two blankets on top of a bed frame. The few material items that Zo owns – some sewing equipment, including thread; a washing board; some basic cooking utensils; a metal cooking pot; a large, claw bucket; and a cup – are neatly strewn about the bed, within arm’s reach of the edge. Overall, it’s unconventional as far as a home goes – it’s all one room, after all, with no kitchen, closets, dedicated bedroom, or space for guests, like a living room or even a foyer – but it’s a pretty cozy place, especially after all the repairs. The roof is tall and sturdy; the walls are strong and thick; the floor is tough and robust, absorbing your footsteps perfectly... and, the one feature that Zo likes the most: the door is brand new and has a deadbolt. |You enter the dilapidated little building that sits at the edge of the grove. The building isn’t especially large: it’s the size of maybe three or four rooms at a typical inn, but without any walls to separate them, and the building is more akin to a great big box than a real house or building. On the outside, the walls are showing signs of rot and wear, having been battered by the elements for too many years without any real upkeep. The wooden walls are still standing straight, but their logs are starting to soften and they’ve long since turned green from decay and moss. The building has two glass windows, one on the north and south wall each, and, while they’re dirty, they’re still intact. The only doorframe in the building is missing its door completely. The interior of the house isn’t exactly much better: the floor creaks and moans with your every footstep, and the floor is marked and scratched all to hell from things being dragged across it for a generation. There’s a fire pit against the eastern wall, with a stone chimney that looks like a good, solid strike from a hammer or even a boot could cause the whole thing to dislodge. There is no furniture, save for a small bed that Zo’s made for herself in the far corner, beneath the northern window, and even it is little more than a pile of hay and grass clippings with two blankets. The few material items that Zo owns – some sewing equipment, including thread; a washing board; some basic cooking utensils; a metal cooking pot; a large, clay bucket; and a cup – are neatly strewn about her bed, within arm’s reach of the edge. Still, it’s better than nothing: the ceiling is undamaged, keeping the rain and snow from piling down, and the walls at least provide some semblance of protection. It’s far from a lost cause: it just needs some attention – maybe add some interior walls to separate the place into rooms, to give it a cozier feel; replace and repair the exterior walls, giving it some extra life; maybe thatch the roof a bit for some insulation; give it a new door; clean out the fire pit and replace the chimney stone-by-stone – and it could be turned into a lovely little hut for Zo to sleep in. ] [var0 |Zo herself is nowhere to be seen, and her things have been left so undisturbed that you could be told that the place has been abandoned for years, and you’d believe it. Knowing her, though, she’s probably just outdoors, training. |[var1 |Zo sits at the edge of her bed, mostly naked save for a plain, featureless, white bra and panties, with the top of her white suit lying across her lap. She’s running the needle and thread through it, patching a hole she’s torn into it with her training. When you enter her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|hut], she waves to you and smiles – apparently not the least little bit concerned about being underdressed, but, well, this is her home – but doesn’t get up to greet you. |Zo sits at the fire pit, prodding at a small fire she’s made underneath her metal cooking pot. You can hear the sound of water boiling in between the occasional clinks and clanks of her utensils poking around in it; although she’s clearly cooking something, it doesn’t have much of a smell. She looks over her shoulder to you, and smiles and waves once she recognizes you, but she isn’t in a hurry to show you in, and instead goes right back to her cooking pot. |Zo is sitting on both her knees, her legs tucked beneath her body, in front of a small line of six candles placed in a straight row along the fire pit. She has her hands together, the butts of her palms pressed against each other: her left hand’s fingers pointed to the floor while her right’s are pointed to the ceiling. Her eyes and mouth are shut; her triangular ears stand upright on her head, unflinching; and her braided hair occasionally quivers and moves on its own at their bulbous tips. But, as soon as you enter, her concentration is broken, and her eyes open to see you. She doesn’t seem too upset, though: she greets you with a warm smile and a wave, although she lets you see yourself in. |Zo sits underneath the southern window, mostly naked save for a plain, featureless, white bra and panties, diligently scrubbing her outfit against her washing board. Her top’s already been done and hangs by a string she had rigged up against the window on the wall, and she’s gotten started on her pants, scrubbing at the fabric and getting them as white and clean as you know they can be. rows.original: [var0 |[var1 |You tell Zo that you had been thinking a little bit about... her offer, from before. The one where she was, well, frankly, kind of blunt about her intentions and how she wanted to advance her relationship with you. Zo’s ears perk up, and she keeps her eyes on you, trained on your expression with undivided attention. Her smile hasn’t waned, but her pupils shrink a little bit, and her tail stands a bit more erect behind her – she’s clearly a bit excited about what you’re going to say next, but she’s trying to play it cool. You hadn’t expected a woman living as monistic a lifestyle as her to still, uh, be vulnerable to her own body’s whims and needs, but to leave her to suffer through that when she could use a partner’s own specific brand of ‘healing’ wouldn’t be right. You tell her that, after thinking about it for a little bit... there’s no denying that escalating your relationship is going to change it forever, and that you two would no longer be just a teacher and a student. But maybe that’s worth the risk. And maybe you already don’t see her as just your teacher, but you need something more to solidify that. |[zo.hasKids |As much as you enjoy seeing Vai and Zo together – your family, bonding with you as a mother to your son, and as your lover – you were... sort of hoping for a more intimate moment with Zo. You were hoping that you’d get to spend some time with her, not as the parent to her kid, or as her student. As something... else. Zo smiles – a knowing, closed-mouth, crinkled-nose smile that looks somewhat lecherous. She knows exactly what it is you want, and she wants it too. There’s more to being a family than just looking after a baby: you two have to look after each other and your needs as well. Still, there’s the fact that there’s a baby in between you.... She, however, has just the plan for that. She cradles Vai in her arm, leaning him against her right arm and against her chest, and she puts her nose up against his to get his attention. Once their eyes meet, Zo purses her lips, then opens her mouth wide, wider, and holds it there for a moment before snapping it shut. She’s pantomiming a yawn. Vai, at first, looks up at her with all the curiosity of a baby still unsure of what to make of the world. She does it again... and this time, Vai yawns as well. Zo’s eyes sit half-lidded, lazily scanning Vai’s face for any changes, and she yawns again after a moment. And Vai, once again, reciprocates, his own eyes beginning to droop as she cradles him back and forth in her arms. A few minutes pass with Zo and Vai yawning at each other, until, eventually, Vai’s eyes shut, and he’s sound asleep in her arms. She presses her nose against his to double-check, and he doesn’t respond at all. Vai is a heavy sleeper; he’ll wake up when he’s good and ready. Zo leads you into her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack], carefully placing Vai inside the crib at the foot of her bed. When she stands back up, she yawns again, this time for real. She didn’t go through all that effort for some privacy with you just so go to sleep: with some urgency, she turns around and grabs you by the wrists, pulling you towards the bed, not that you need help finding it. Once you’re at the edge of her mattress, she spins, your hands still in hers, until your back is against it; with a shove, you’re sitting on your ass of the bed, with Zo sitting on your lap, her thighs spread over yours. |You lean on your right leg, your hand on your hip. You take a short breath through your nose as you nibble into your bottom lip, scanning Zo from head to toe, drinking in her features with your eyes. Given that you’ve seen her naked and at her most vulnerable, you’d have thought that she wouldn’t be so averse to admiration and attention like this, but from the way she smiles sheepishly and averts her gaze, she’s still a little bit unused to it. You ask Zo if she’d like to blow off a little bit of steam. To see you as something other than her student for a few hours. She still can’t bring herself to look at you head-on, at least at first, but you can see her own eyes scanning your own body. rows.translation: 你询问佐，是否可以一起用武器练习技巧，体验那种握在手部中时、仿佛武器已成为你手部臂延伸部分、成为你自身一部分的感觉。当你的武器与身体完美融合之后，与她一起练习时所感受到的那种平静与和谐，是你在其他任何时候都无法体验到的。.. 而就在你最需要的时候，它出现了，拯救了你。 佐歪着头，带着歉意皱起了眉头。她低头看着自己的肚子，右手部轻轻抚摸着肚子上那个小小的凸起，然后，带着些许遗憾，她摇了摇头：“不行。当她怀着你的孩子时，进行那种类型的训练会让她感到很不自在。” 就在你准备提出其他建议的时候，她将手部放在你的胸前；然后，她把双手部的掌心相对，手部指朝你的方向；接着，她用右手部的食指指着自己；随后，她用食指和中指分别指向自己的两只眼睛，最后再次将这两根手部指指向你。 她的意思是…… 你 你仍然可以自己完成这些任务，而她可以观察并给予指导；只是她无法与你一起一起完成这些任务而已。 虽然你可能会觉得自己在错过些什么，但实际上这种安排也是可行的。毕竟你现在已经掌握了这些技巧，剩下的就是不断练习，将所学的知识内化为自己的本能反应，而这就需要你反复不断地进行练习。
rows.raw: " You ask Zo if you two could practice your skills with a weapon and the sensation you get when you hold it, as if it were an extension of your arm – a piece of yourself. The equanimity you feel with her after attuning your weapon to your body like that is unlike anything else you experience... and it’s come to your rescue when you needed it most before. Zo tilts her head to one side and frowns apologetically. She looks down at her stomach, her right hand rubbing the small bump on her tummy, then, with some regret, she shakes her head ‘no.’ She’s not comfortable performing that sort of training when she’s carrying your child. Just as you were about to suggest something else, she rests her hand on your chest; then, she puts her hands together at the palms, her fingers pointed towards you; then, she points her herself with her right index finger; then, she points towards both of her eyes with her index and middle fingers before pointing them towards you again. She’s suggesting that you can still do them yourself, and she can watch and teach; she just can’t perform them with you. Although it might feel like you’re missing something, that still works for you. You’ve mastered these techniques yourself by now anyway; it’s just a matter of refining what you know down until it’s second-nature to you, and that means doing them again and again and again."

rows.original: [var0 |You ask Zo if she’s willing to swords-dance with you again. Being able to move so fluidly with a sword has some advantages that you would never have guessed before you practiced with her, and you’d like to keep yourself keen. |You’d never guess it from the way she carries herself, or the way she dresses, but Zo is a wonderful dancer, and she uses the most unusual of props with her movements: while you could see a dancer move with a cane, or a pole, and you’ve even heard of dancers playing with fire, you’ve never seen anyone dance with a sword and scabbard like she does. You ask Zo if she’s willing to try and teach you to dance like that – or, at least, if she’s willing to dance like that for you. ] [flags.ZO_BAB_RANDO |Zo nods once, hefting Vai into her arms and taking him into the [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|house|shack] to put him to bed for the time being. Although you and Zo are masters at what you two do, it’s nonetheless safer that your baby isn’t in the presence of you whipping around weapons for the sake of your training, no matter how confident you two are. When she emerges, Vai is gone, and in his place is Zo’s sword, still in its scabbard, gripped just beneath where the sword’s cross guard meets the sheath. Once she gets back to the grassy field, she bows, but doesn’t give you the blade; instead, she unsheathes it herself: the sword’s edge grinds sharply against the reinforced skeleton of the scabbard, and the flawless, untainted steel of the blade glints in the sunlight. |Zo nods once and gently grips you by the wrist, pulling you towards the empty, grassy field towards the back of her grove. [var1 |She already has the sword and the scabbard in her possession: she sheathes it, then bows before you, with the weapon spread across both of her open palms, before she unsheathes it again, the flawless, untainted steel of the blade glinting in the sunlight as its edge grinds against the reinforced skeleton of the scabbard. Perhaps that was all for courtesy? |Once you’re there, she points to you, then points down to the grass, then points up to the sky, and turns and leaves for her shanty to retrieve her sword. Once she returns, she stands in front of you with the sword, still sheathed in its scabbard, across both her upturned palms. Once she gets back to the grassy field, she bows, but doesn’t give you the blade; instead, she unsheathes it herself: the sword’s edge grinds sharply against the reinforced skeleton of the scabbard, and the flawless, untainted steel of the blade glints in the sunlight. ] ] [zo.equanimityRange 0 1 2 3 |She hands you the scabbard with her left hand, and turns the sword into a reverse grip in her right. She’s not going to trust you with the sword on your first lesson. That would be foolish. Once you have it, she holds out her occupied hand, the sword held perpendicular to the ground, in her reverse grip, her palm facing upward; she thrusts her fist a few times, motioning for you to mimic her stance. You do, and already the sensation feels alien to you: the scabbard is weighted similarly to a sword, in that it’s heavy all throughout and the elongated end tries to pull your wrist down to the ground. Holding it in a reverse grip tenses different muscles in your wrist, too – it’s only been a moment and it already feels more strenuous on your hand to hold the scabbard so unnaturally. It’s difficult for Zo to not notice that you’re having such a difficult time with holding the scabbard. Despite your conscious attempts to keep it steady, she’s the type of person that can notice the smallest of things, and your wrist being a bit shaky with the sheath is probably clear as could be to her. Still, she smiles patiently, waiting for you to tell her that you’re ready to continue. When you do, she demonstrates a simple trick: she flicks her wrist forward and releases her grip on her sword as she twists her hand, her palm facing downward. The sword, drawn by the momentum, spins once, the blade of the sword swishing through the air diagonally, the tip swinging close enough to her face to make you flinch, but she barely reacts to it. Once the sword makes a single, full rotation, she grabs it again and motions to you, to replicate what she just did. You look at your hand, palm-side facing up, the scabbard clenched in your fingers. It shouldn’t be too hard, should it? One little twirl? You lean the scabbard backward a bit, before you fling the weighted scabbard forward in your hand and you release your grip– And the whole thing flies forward, spinning harmlessly through the air in front of you, hitting the grass with a soft thud. You didn’t even make it halfway. Zo laughs to herself, her chest heaving with her breath and her eyes shut into crescents, although no sound escapes her throat. She retrieves the scabbard for you, plucking it from the grass with her free hand, and presenting it to you again. When you reassume the grip, she pushes down on your wrist, realigning your balance, and pulls gently on your fingers, telling you to lighten your grip slightly before the spin. Then, she steps back and lets you try again. You spin it again– And you whap yourself right in the shoulder with the end of the scabbard, before it falls to the grass at your feet. But you made progress that time! |She hands you the scabbard with her left hand, and turns the sword into a reverse grip in her right. You made some decent progress with her last lesson, and you even managed to complete a single twirl with the scabbard, but she isn’t quite ready to trust you with the sword yet. Not that you blame her. This time, Zo holds the sword upright, the blade pinched between her thumb and index finger just above the sword’s wrist guard with her other hand pressed behind her back. You know that the sword is sharp, so the way she’s pinching it gives you some pause: if she slips, it’ll damn-near cut her thumb off. But, even though it’s just her two fingers, the blade is held sturdy and upright, waiting unflinchingly for you to mimic her grip. Once you do, Zo flicks her wrist forward and releases her grip on the sword. The handle swings outward, away from her, and the bladed end comes swinging down onto her shoulder; you flinch for her when the gleaming metal of the sword hits her arm, but the motion of the flick had twisted the blade so its broad end came down on her sleeve instead. Fluidly, she lifts her arm upward, starting at her wrist, then her elbow, to continue the sword on its forward-rolling motion, until the tip of the blade lifts off her sleeve, tracing along the fabric of her suit, it traces along her fingers, where she catches it again, pinched once more between her thumb and index finger. She doesn’t bother completing a second loop: you probably get the picture, but she nonetheless lowers the blade gently until she can grip onto its handle. Then, with her patient smile turning her eyes into crescents beneath her silver mask, she motions to you, allowing you to have your turn. The scabbard isn’t even a little sharp, taking away one of the scarier aspects of performing the same trick, but it’s still heavy, and if you accidentally reflect the motion of the scabbard into your arm instead of absorbing it, it’s probably going to leave a bit of a bruise. You try to mentally plan out the motion of the scabbard; the momentum it’s going to have with its weight as it comes down; the motion your arm will have to take in order to absorb its weight... and, not to forget, you have to bounce it back upward so that you can catch the opposite end of the scabbard between your fingers again. Once you’re ready, after a breath, you flick your wrist backward, sending the scabbard down onto your arm. You follow its motion, sinking your arm just as it bears down on you, absorbing the motion into you rather than reflecting it. So far so– When you try to bounce it back upward, you don’t put in enough force, and you accidentally readjust your arm. The scabbard bounces almost straight up, then, its open end hits you square on the arm before bouncing onto the grass below. If that had been the sword, that would have been its pointed tip skewering into you. You rub at the spot that the scabbard had hit you, soothing the sudden, dull pain there. You had gotten so close; it’s frustrating that you managed to get halfway on the first try, but you couldn’t clinch out the whole thing. Zo, though, has the opposite reaction: she has her hand on your other shoulder, and she’s enthusiastically smiling and nodding at you, positively enforcing your progress – she can’t exactly confirm, but you’re given the impression that you had surpassed her expectations on your first go. You may not have succeeded, but that doesn’t mean you did poorly. Zo stands beside you to pick up the scabbard for you, and once it’s between your fingers again, she slowly demonstrates the motion your arm should take with her own: you had gotten the first half down, but on the second, you jerked your arm suddenly and sharply. By her demonstration, you learn to keep the fluidity of your motion steady all throughout: to let the scabbard recoil through its own motion by moving with it, rather than to force it. She steps back, giving you space to try again. |By now, you’ve proven yourself at least somewhat proficient with swords-dancing – not even halfway to the degree that she is, but well enough that you can get your twirls and your bounces in with some fluidity and without a risk of hurting yourself too badly. Without any hesitation, Zo hands you the sword, the blade pointed down at the ground, keeping the scabbard for herself. You’re a bit apprehensive about taking the blade, but your teacher has unwavering faith that you can accomplish your next dance. Perhaps all you need is a bit of self-confidence... and to remember what you’ve learned so far, about keeping calm and level. Zo holds the scabbard in a reverse grip: her unoccupied left hand is balled into a fist and pressed against her right, looking as if she’s punching forward with both fists at once. She lifts the blade counterclockwise, then lets it fall, releasing her grip on all her fingers except her smallest; with its momentum, she twists the scabbard in between all eight of her fingers as it moves, swinging it in front of herself like a great, heavy fan, twisting it top-over-bottom over and over until it finally comes to the small finger in her left hand, where she catches it and holds it still, ending the scabbard’s journey in a reverse grip in her left hand. [var2] As difficult as that looked, you figure that that might actually be a bit easier with the sword: the grip of the sword is thinner than the scabbard, meaning it’ll be easier to pass finger-to-finger. Still, this is a real, sharpened blade in your hands: if you lose control while it’s on the upswing, the danger of it coming down on your wrists is very real. You keep what you had learned from your previous lessons on swords-dancing in mind as you lift the blade in a reverse grip. By this point, your muscles don’t nearly strain as hard to keep it aloft. The most important things to keep in mind are to let the sword move as it naturally wants to, with the momentum of the blade swinging top-over-bottom as it moves between your fingers, and to not force it to move in any particular direction. And the second-most important thing is to remain calm. There’s a state of equanimity that you need to achieve while you’re dancing with a blade: the way it moves, the way its edge sings as it cuts through the air, is not unlike you circling your lips and whistling. The sword isn’t a wild creature: it’s an extension of yourself. It moves the way it does because you have bid it to; if it doesn’t move the way you expect it to, that’s because of you, not because of it. You look down at your hands. The sword sits in your left hand, in reverse grip. You’ve already completed the task, on your first try, without any conscious input. You don’t remember doing it at all; the only physical reminder that it even happened is that your fingers feel a bit stretched. Zo approaches you with a knowing, caring smile, and she slides the scabbard onto the blade until it clicks into place, fully sheathing the sword. With both of her hands free, she holds you by both of your wrists, and she leans in to press her nose to yours as her eyes close in contentment. It’s a proud, sobering moment for you both: you have learned all you need to swords-dance like she can, and she’s taught you all she can. You have succeeded as her student, and she has succeeded as your teacher. |By now, you’ve proven yourself at least somewhat proficient with swords-dancing – not even halfway to the degree that she is, but well enough that you can get your twirls and your bounces in with some fluidity and without a risk of hurting yourself too badly. Perhaps all you need is a bit of self-confidence... and to remember what you’ve learned so far, about keeping calm and level. Zo holds the scabbard in a reverse grip: her unoccupied left hand is balled into a fist and pressed against her right, looking as if she’s punching forward with both fists at once. Still, this is a real, sharpened blade in your hands: if you lose control while it’s on the upswing, the danger of it coming down on your wrists is very real. And the second-most important thing is to remain calm. There’s a state of equanimity that you need to achieve while you’re dancing with a blade: the way it moves, the way its edge sings as it cuts through the air, is not unlike you circling your lips and whistling. The sword isn’t a wild creature: it’s an extension of yourself. It moves the way it does because you have bid it to; if it doesn’t move the way you expect it to, that’s because of you, not because of it. You look down at your hands. The sword sits in your left hand, in reverse grip. You’ve already completed the task, on your first try, without any conscious input. You don’t remember doing it at all; the only physical reminder that it even happened is that your fingers feel a bit stretched. Zo approaches you with a knowing, caring smile, and she slides the scabbard onto the blade until it clicks into place, fully sheathing the sword. With both of her hands free, she holds you by both of your wrists, and she leans in to press her nose to yours as her eyes close in contentment. It’s a proud, sobering moment for you both: you have learned all you need to swords-dance like she can, and she’s taught you all she can. You have succeeded as her student, and she has succeeded as your teacher. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你询问佐是否愿意再与你一起练习剑舞。能够如此流畅地运用剑术，确实有一些你在与她练习之前根本想象不到的好处，因此你也很想继续保持这种状态。 |从她的外表举止或穿着打扮来看，你绝对想不到Zo其实是一位非常出色的舞者。她在舞蹈中使用的道具更是别具一格：虽然你可能见过舞者使用手杖或杆子作为表演道具，也听说过有人用火来进行舞蹈表演，但像她这样用剑和剑鞘来跳舞的，你还从未见过。你问Zo是否愿意教你用这种方式跳舞——或者，至少是否愿意为你跳这样的舞蹈。 ] [flags.ZO_BAB_RANDO |佐点了点头，将瓦伊抱进怀里，然后带着他走了进去。 [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|房子|简陋的小屋] 暂时让他上床睡觉吧。虽然你和Zo在各自的业务领域都非常精通，但无论如何，让宝宝不要出现在你们为了训练而挥舞武器的场景中，还是会更安全一些——无论你们有多自信。 当她出现时，Vai已经不见了，取而代之的是Zo的剑——那把仍插在剑鞘中的剑，剑柄正好位于剑格与剑鞘的连接处。当她回到那片长满草地的地方时，她鞠了一躬，但并没有将剑递给你；相反，她自己拔出了剑：剑刃与剑鞘加固的部分激烈地摩擦着，而那把毫无瑕疵、纯净无瑕的钢铁剑身在阳光下闪闪发光。 |佐轻轻点了点头，然后握住你的手部腕，将你引向她树林后方那片空旷的草地。 [var1 |她已经将那把剑及其剑鞘收入手中：她将剑插入剑鞘，然后站在你面前鞠躬，将剑横放在双掌之上；随后她再次拔出剑来，剑刃上那无瑕、纯净的钢铁在阳光下闪闪发光，剑刃与剑鞘加固的骨架相互摩擦，发出清脆的声音。或许，这一切仅仅只是出于礼貌而已？ |当你到达那里后，她指了指你，然后指向地面上的草地，接着又指向天空，随后转身走向她的小屋去取她的剑。 等她回来后，她站在你面前，将那把仍插在剑鞘中的剑横放在双手的掌心上。 当她回到那片长满草的田野上时，她鞠了一躬，但并没有将剑递给你；相反，她自己拔出了剑——剑刃与剑鞘加固的部分激烈地摩擦着，而那把剑无瑕的、纯净的钢质在阳光下闪闪发光。 ] ] [zo.equanimityRange 0 1 2 3 |她用左手将剑鞘递给你，而右手则将剑握成反握姿势。在第一次教学时，她当然不会把剑交给你保管——那样未免太冒险了。 当你接过剑后，她会伸出那只正握着剑的手，让剑垂直于地面保持反握姿势，手掌朝上，然后她会连续几次用拳头做出刺击的动作，示意你模仿她的姿势。 你这么做了，但很快就会发现这种感觉其实很陌生：剑鞘的重量与剑本身相当，它的整个部分都很重，而那延长的部分还会迫使你的手腕向下弯曲。如果用反手握法持握剑鞘，还会让你手腕上的不同肌肉处于紧张状态。才过了短短一会儿，你就已经觉得用这种不自然的握法持剑鞘非常吃力了。 对佐来说，这很难做到。 不是 你可能会注意到，自己握住剑鞘时显得非常吃力。尽管你一直在努力保持稳定，但她的注意力非常敏锐，很可能已经注意到你的手腕在握剑鞘时有些颤抖。 然而，她依然耐心地微笑着，等待着你告诉她你已经准备继续了。 当你这么说的时候，她展示了一个简单的技巧：她将手腕向前一甩，同时松开对剑的握持，然后转动手腕，使手掌朝下。 那把剑在惯性的作用下旋转了一圈，剑刃以斜线轨迹划过空气，剑尖甚至逼近她的脸庞，足以让人不自觉地退缩，但她却几乎没有做出任何反应。当剑完成这一整圈旋转后，她再次握住剑，向你示意，让你模仿她刚才的动作。 你看着自己的手掌，掌心朝上，手指紧握着那把剑鞘。其实，它根本不应该在那里。 太 难吧？只需要轻轻一扭而已…… 你先把刀鞘向后稍微倾斜一点，然后用手将装有配重的刀鞘向前甩去，同时松开手—— 整个刀鞘就会向前飞去，在你面前旋转着无害地穿过空气，最后轻轻砸在草地上。 你甚至还没走到一半。 佐暗自笑了起来，她的胸膛因呼吸而起伏，双眼弯成月牙状，但她的喉咙里却没有发出任何声音。她用空闲的手从草丛中捡起那把剑鞘，再次递给了你。 当你重新握紧把手时，她会轻轻按压你的手腕，帮助你重新调整平衡，同时还会轻轻拉扯你的手指，告诉你在开始旋转之前应该稍微放松一些握力。然后，她会退后一步，让你再试一次。 你再次转动它—— 然后用刀鞘的末端敲打自己的肩膀，之后刀鞘才掉落在你脚边的草地上。 不过这一次，你确实取得了一些进展！ |她用左手将剑鞘递给你，而右手则将剑握成了反握姿势。在上次的教学中，你确实取得了一些进步，甚至成功完成了一次用剑鞘进行的旋转动作，但她还是不太放心把剑交给你。不过，你也能理解她的顾虑。 这一次，佐将剑竖直握在手中，拇指和食指夹住剑刃的部分位于剑护手稍上方，而另一只手则放在背后。你知道这把剑非常锋利，因此她这样的握法确实让人有些担心：如果她稍一失手，手指很可能会被割伤。然而，尽管只有她的两根手指在握住剑刃，剑依然被稳稳地竖立着，毫无动摇地等待着你模仿她的握法。 当你这样做的时候，佐迅速向前甩动手腕，松开了对剑的控制。剑柄向外摆动，远离她的身体，而剑刃则朝她的肩膀方向落下；当那闪亮的金属剑刃碰到她的手臂时，你不由得一缩，但佐甩动手腕的动作使得剑刃的宽端落在了她的袖子上，而不是直接击中她的身体。 她动作流畅地抬起手臂，从手腕开始，然后是肘部，让剑继续向前滚动，直到剑尖脱离她的袖子，沿着她的西装布料滑动，再从她的手指间掠过，最后她再次用拇指和食指握住了剑柄。 她甚至没有费心去完成第二轮动作：你应该已经明白她的意图了，但她还是轻轻地放下刀刃，直到能够握住它的把手。然后，她那带着耐心的微笑让她的双眼在银色面具的映衬下呈现出弯月般的形状，她向你示意，让你轮到自己动手了。 这个剑鞘甚至没有一点锋利度，这就削弱了表演这个技巧时所带来的那种惊险感。不过它仍然很重，要是你不小心…… 反映 应该是将刀鞘套入手臂的动作，而不是…… 引人入胜的 它，它很可能会留下一些淤伤。你需要在脑海中仔细规划拔剑的动作：剑鞘在下落时会带着怎样的惯性；你的手臂需要做出怎样的动作才能缓冲这种冲击力……当然，也别忘了要把剑重新向上弹回，这样才能再次用手指抓住剑鞘的另一端。 当你准备就绪后，深吸一口气，然后向后甩动手腕，让刀鞘落回手臂上。你顺应这一动作，当刀鞘向下压来时，你也顺势将手臂下沉，让这一力量被你自己吸收，而不是将其反弹回去。 到目前为止—— 当你试图将它向上弹回时，用力不够，结果手臂又不自觉地重新调整了位置。刀鞘几乎是垂直向上弹起的，然后它的开口部分直接撞在了你的手臂上，之后才掉到下面的草地上。 如果那把剑真的刺了出来，它的锋利剑尖肯定会刺中你。 你轻轻揉搓着被剑鞘撞到的地方，试图缓解那里突然出现的钝痛。你本来已经离成功如此之近了；第一次尝试就能做到一半，实在令人沮丧，只是最终还是没能完成整个动作。
