You can see Zo, and you still intrinsically recognize her as Zo, but her vision does not register her as Zo – what you see is a cloud, vaguely in the shape of a lupine woman, and you see the aura of her lifeforce emanate brilliantly in front of you. You can see her body heat ripple away from the aura in thinner, vibrating lines. You can see the wall of her cabin behind her, and you can see the lifeforce of the ants and termites hard at work hollowing the wood out.
            
            You’ve seen this all before, and it’s all just as intense and brilliant as it was the first time. It’s a whole new way to see the world – the whole universe, with all the people and plants and animals within it. Something as mundane as running water from a stream would be a wholly new and alien experience that you’d recognize as something you’ve seen a hundred times before, but from a perspective you hadn’t realized was possible before you met her.
            
            But you don’t know what, exactly, you’re meant to be looking for specifically. Zo did this for a reason, after all....
            
            Very carefully, and without moving her fingers on your head, Zo tilts your head downward. For as intense and brilliant this new vision is, you’re still limited to the range of your normal eyesight, and it’s hard to see ‘through’ Zo or her hands holding onto your head. If any of her fingers slip even a fraction of an inch, the connection would break.
            
            When she tilts your eyes downward, you can see the rest of her body as represented by the aura of her lifeforce. The whole of her form throbs gently with her heartbeat, but no single part of her is denser than the rest.
            
            But when your eyes get to where her stomach would be... you see it. A second aura, nestled within her own. It’s small – you had just seen the lifeforce of insects inside a wall, and this tiny dot of an aura is much smaller than even those. It’s the same shimmery-silver as the rest of her aura as well, so the literal colors blend in to the point of imperception. It doesn’t pulsate like Zo’s does, and is instead a single, solid color. But it’s as obvious as a lighthouse in the dark; as a streak of black across a white canvas. Life, as clear and intent as it could ever be.
            
            You can see it with your own eyes: Zo’s conceived. She’s pregnant with your child.
            
            Her fingers pull away from your face, and just as suddenly, your normal vision returns to you. Gone are the oblique, nondescript edges and lifeforces and grayscale colors; in front of you is Zo, the bedsheet still draped over her shoulder and right breast, sitting in front of you on her shoddy bed. Her eyes are still shimmering silver and her hair is still levitating behind her, but, with a hard blink, her irises turn back to green and her braided hair hits the floor of the cabin with a heavy ‘flump’ all at once. You’re back to ‘normal.’
            
            She smiles again, her cheeks rising high enough to hide the lower half of her eyes and turn them into crescents. She does that heaving, nasally breathing that she does when she tries to laugh. She’d blush if she could through the fur on her face.
            
            You can’t think of a better way to respond to anything you’ve just seen than to lean forward, wrap your arms around her in a warm hug, and pull her back down onto the bed. And she’s all too willing to let you.
            
            You’re about to start a family with Zo. There’s more cuddling to be done."

rows.original: Eventually[pc.isBimbo |, as lame and boring as it is ], you pull yourself away from cuddling Zo – you can’t spend all day just lying in bed and cuddling and making love to your lupine lover, unfortunately. Your muscles are all stiff and sore after spending as long as you two had having baby-making sex. You groan with effort when you finally pull yourself out – and when you get up, the [pc.ra lupine catfolk |bi[silly |iiiiiiiiiii ]g ]stretch you make rights all the wrongs in your body. You and Zo take your time getting dressed, although you’re constantly distracted by Zo and what she’s let you see. [pc.hasKids |You’re already a parent and all, but... that was something new. Something irreplaceable and unforgettable. |You’re a first-time parent and all, but you don’t think even the most experienced of parents would have been prepared for that. ] You didn’t see a baby bump; what you saw was life, in the process of being formed. And now, you can’t help but imagine Zo still doing her training, with all the tumbling and the stretches and the motions, even in the state that she’s in, all while she’s carrying your child inside of her.... Zo, however, seems to recognize your apprehension. Once you’re both fully dressed, she puts herself in front of you and rests her hands on your shoulders, looking you in the eye with a soft-but-confident smile on her lips. She leans forward until her nose presses against yours, and she lets out a soft, nasally exhale; when she pulls back, she brings her hands together at the palms, then she presses their fingers into your chest; then, she brings her hands towards herself, laying them flat across her upper chest, just beneath her collarbone; then, she cups her fingers and thumbs to make a wide O-shape, and lowers her hands towards her belly, where you saw the aura within her. You aren’t positive what, specifically, it is she’s trying to communicate, but you get the general message: she’s asking you to trust her. [pc.hasKids |She might be a first-time mother herself, but she knows how to carry herself; she can learn to carry a child with her as well. |You’re both first-time parents, and you’re both figuring it out as you go, but... she’s asking you to have faith that she can at least learn to carry herself with a child in her belly. ] And, at the very least, she can only stick to the less-physically-demanding training practices and maybe come up with some new ones, if she really must. You gear up to leave Zo’s grove. But you’ll be back. You have two people counting on it, now.

rows.original: You ask Zo if it’s not too much trouble to... see the baby again. Like she had shown you the day you two had made love. At the question, she becomes all too excited for you to see the baby she’s carrying like she can once again: she nods vigorously enough for her heavy hair braids to bob up and down, and her smile spreads wide enough across her face to lift her [dayNight |mask up on her eyes slightly |cheeks up to her eyes, covering the lower half of her green irises with her cheeks ]. She takes her hands in yours and bids that you sit down[dayNight |, right there in the grass with her | next to her on her bed ], and you follow her lead. When you two are comfortable, Zo extends her hands, flicking her wrists a few times to get her sleeves down, and she sits in front of you, her fingers reaching for your face. As before, they touch down on different points: some of them near your eyes; some of them closer to your eyes; some of them around your cheekbones, reaching for some unknown point or joint you have in your face. Once all ten digits are pressed onto your [pc.skinFurScales], Zo takes a deep breath through her nose and closes her eyes, focusing on whatever spiritual energies she needs to channel her vision into you. When she opens them again, her irises have gone from deep emerald-green to a shimmering silver – and an instant later, your own vision is replaced with what it is she sees once again. The colors of the world vanish, going from thin, defined lines in their shapes to jagged, blurry edges without a specific beginning or end. Gone are the [dayNight |greens of the grass and blue of the sky |browns of her living quarters and the dark violets of the starlight ]; everything is instead replaced with shades of white and black, varying in intensity with how much life they have or contain. You can tell where the ground begins and ends; you can tell [dayNight |the circumference of a tree |the edges of the walls start and end ]; but, more importantly, you can see the lifeforce of everything more clearly than you could ever imagine before, [dayNight |down to the individual blades of grass to the birds flying through the sky |down to the insects living in the wood to the bats in the woods on the hunt ] – and to Zo, sitting right in front of you. Very gently, so as to not break her delicate hold on your face, she tilts your head downward so that your vision is directed towards her belly. Although you can see the world differently, you’re still limited by what your eyes can see, and you can only roll your eyes downward so far. With her help, you have a much easier time seeing her stomach – and the baby in her womb. [zo.pregDays 0 30 90 |The aura that you see within Zo’s belly isn’t a whole lot larger than what you saw when she first conceived, all told. You can see the lifeforce of [dayNight |the birds in the sky, off in the distance |the bugs in the wall ], and what you see within Zo isn’t much larger than any of those. But it’s nonetheless there; it’s healthy; and it’s bigger than last time. That’s your baby growing inside her, and its journey has barely only begun. |The lifeforce that you see within Zo’s belly is growing quickly – seeing your baby grow this quickly, and, well, so literally, has you feel a way you weren’t expected to feel. This is your baby, and although you’re not seeing it with your ‘real’ vision, you can recognize it as yours just by looking at it. If this lifeforce were beside another baby’s, you’d be able to tell which one was yours. And you can see the aura that is their lifeforce beat and pulsate as the seconds go by – there’s a heartbeat! |The lifeforce within Zo has gotten quite a bit larger, to the point where, if you focus, you can see the approximate outline of the curled-up baby inside her womb. Not the arms and legs, not with the position the baby’s in, but you can see where its head is, and, it being lupine, where its tail is. You can’t tell its sex, and it’s maybe only the size of a stick of butter, but... it’s there. And it’s getting big. And it’s getting ready. ] Zo gives you all the time you’d like to see your baby inside her womb. Your own hands, still free, reach forward to gently rub over the swell of her stomach; your hands come as close as they can to touching the baby’s lifeforce before you instead meet the still-cut abs of her stomach underneath the fine fur of her belly. [zo.pregDays 0 30 90 |Not that you know where you’d even hold it – its so small, it’d fit into your palm and it’d vanish if you closed your fist. |It’s large enough that it’d take up the whole space of your palm at this point – very small and precious and you’d worry about breaking it if you moved your fingers wrong, but it’s larger than before. You just need some patience. |It’s nearly large enough that you could hold it in both of your hands by now; a part of you wants nothing more than to reach out and find its tiny hand for you to hold in yours – or, more appropriately, between your fingers – and it’s getting harder and harder to remain patient. You’ll just have to settle with seeing it like this for now, but you can’t wait to greet it for real. ] Eventually, your eyes start to feel a little funny, and not in a ticklish way. Maintaining your vision like this for an extended period doesn’t feel especially comfortable; Zo must have done some training (or just long exposures) to be able to maintain it for as long as she can. You pull your hands away from Zo’s stomach, and she, understanding the action, slips her fingers from your face. Immediately, your vision returns to normal, and that uncomfortable strain in your eyes dissipates as well. Her hands reach up to cup your cheeks, and she smiles and nods toward you before glancing down at her stomach, letting you know that you can get another look whenever you want.
rows.translation: 你问佐是否太麻烦了，如果让她做…… 看到 那个宝宝……就像她在你们俩发生关系的那天向你展示过那个宝宝一样。 听到这个问题，她变得异常兴奋，迫不及待地想要让你再次看到她怀里的宝宝：她用力地点头，以至于她那重型的发辫上下晃动；她的笑容也绽开了，仿佛要把整个脸都照亮一样。 [dayNight |她在眼睛上稍微戴了些遮盖物。 |她的脸颊高高地挂在眼眶周围，将她那绿色的虹膜下半部分都遮住了。 ]她握住你的手部，示意你坐下。[dayNight |就在那片草丛里，和她在一起。 | 坐在她床边 ]你跟着她的节奏去做。 当你们俩都感到放松后，佐会伸出双手部，轻轻摆动手部腕让袖子滑落，然后坐在你面前，她的手部指会伸向你的脸。和之前一样，她的手部指会触碰到你脸上的不同部位：有些手部指会靠近你的眼睛，有些则会触碰到你的脸颊骨，甚至会探索你脸上那些不为人知的部位或关节。 当她的十根手部指全部触碰到你的脸后…… [pc.skinFurScales]佐通过鼻子深吸一口气，闭上眼睛，集中精力调动那些她所需要的灵性能量，将自己的视野传递给你。当她再次睁开眼睛时，她的虹膜已经从深绿色的颜色变成了闪烁的银色——而就在那一瞬间，你所看到的景象也被她所看到的画面取代了。 世界上的各种色彩消失了，那些原本清晰可见的线条变得模糊不清，边缘变得参差不齐，再也没有明确的起点和终点。一切都已经消失了…… [dayNight |绿草与蓝天 |她居住区域的棕色色调，以及星光所带来的深紫色光芒 ]相反，一切都被白色和黑色的不同深浅所取代，这些颜色的明暗程度取决于它们所蕴含或拥有的“生命力”的多少。你可以清楚地分辨出地面的起始和结束位置；你可以清楚地知道…… [dayNight |树木的周长 |墙壁的边缘就是这样的，从开始到结束都是如此。 ]但更重要的是，你可以比以往任何时候都更清晰地感受到万物所蕴含的生命力。 [dayNight |从每一片草叶，到在天空中飞翔的鸟儿 |从生活在木材中的昆虫，到在森林中捕食的蝙蝠，一切生物都在忙碌着。 ] 还有坐在你正前方的佐。 她非常轻柔地动作，生怕打破她那轻轻托住你脸庞的手部势，她将你的头微微向下倾斜，让你的视线能够看到她的腹部。虽然你的视野发生了变化，但仍然受到眼睛所能看到的范围的限制，你的眼球也只能向下转动到这个程度。在她的帮助下，你终于能够更容易地看到她的腹部，以及她腹中的胎儿了。 [zo.pregDays 0 30 90 |总的来说，你在佐的腹部看到的那团光晕，其实和她刚怀孕时看到的差不多大。你可以从中感受到那股生命力…… [dayNight |远处的天空中，那些鸟儿…… |隐藏的缺陷 ]在Zo里你所看到的，其大小其实并不比那些东西大多少。但它确实存在；它很健康；而且比起上次，它已经变得更大了一些。那其实就是你的宝宝在她的体内成长，而它的成长之旅才刚刚开始而已。 |你在佐的肚子里看到的那股生命力正在迅速成长——看到你的宝宝发育得如此之快，真是令人感到无比欣喜。 确实如此这种感觉，是不是让你体验到了原本并不预期会有的情绪？这就是…… 你的宝宝虽然你无法用“真正的”视觉看到它，但只要看着它，你就能认出它属于你。如果这种生命力与另一个婴儿的生命力同时存在，你也能分辨出哪一个属于你。而且，你可以看到这种生命力所散发出的光环，它会随着时间的流逝而跳动、脉动——那里确实有心跳的存在！ |佐体内的生命力已经变得相当强大了，以至于如果你仔细观察，就能看到她子宫里那个蜷缩着的婴儿的大致轮廓。虽然看不清它的手部臂和腿，但至少能分辨出它的头部位置，而由于它是一只狼犬，也能知道它的尾巴在哪里。目前还无法判断它的性别，它的大小大概只有一根黄油棒那么长，但是……它确实存在，而且还在不断长大。 准备好了. ] Zo让你能够尽情地观察自己腹中的宝宝。你的双手部依然可以自由活动，你可以将它们伸向前方，轻轻抚摸她隆起的腹部；你的手部几乎能够触碰到宝宝的生命力，但最终却只摸到了她腹部细腻的绒毛下面依然紧实的腹肌。 [zo.pregDays 0 30 90 |你甚至都不知道该把它放在哪里——它太小了，简直可以放在你的手掌里，而当你握紧拳头时，它就会消失得无影无踪。 |现在它的大小已经足以占据你整个手掌的空间了——虽然依然非常小巧珍贵，稍微一动手指就怕会把它弄坏，但确实比之前要大了。你只需要有点耐心而已。 |它现在已经大到可以让你用双手捧住了；你内心有一部分非常渴望伸出手去，握住它那小小的手——或者更准确地说，让它的手指穿过你的手指……然而，越来越难以保持耐心了。目前你只能满足于这样看着它，但你已经迫不及待地想要真正与它见面了。 ] 最终，你的眼睛会开始感到有些不适，这种不适并不是因为痒痒的感觉。长时间保持这种视觉状态并不会让人感到特别舒服；Zo肯定接受过一些训练，或者只是通过长时间的注视练习，才能保持这种状态这么久。 你将手部从佐的腹部拿开，而她也明白了你的意图，于是将自己的手部指从你的脸上移开。立刻，你的视线恢复了正常，眼睛里那种不适的紧张感也消失了。 她抬起手部捧住你的脸颊，微笑着向你点头示意，然后低头看了看自己的肚子，这样你就知道，随时都可以再看一次了。

rows.original: Although, only one... [pc.ra lupine |you were expecting a litter of anywhere from two to six, which is normal for your kind, but Zo only had room in herself for one, apparently. |you had understood that lupines typically give birth to litters between two and six, and that only having one baby at a time is considered unusual. ] But that just means that this one will have more focus and attention from its parents. She beckons you to her; you first set down the water near the hearth so it can warm up, and then you approach Zo and your baby, putting yourself up against her right-hand side and snuggling up against both her and your baby. Despite having just given birth, Zo doesn’t seem at all worn out or exhausted – all of that training and body control clearly made things easy for her. Her smile has waned, but it’s still clear as could be on her face, and you doubt it’ll be leaving any time soon. It’s hard to keep [pc.isDK |even a hardass like yourself from at least breaking into a bit of a grin |yourself from smiling any less than her ]. It’s hard to tell from your current angle, and you know it’s difficult for you both whenever you ask Zo a question, but you ask her if the baby is a boy or a girl. In response, she lifts her left hand and extends her index finger straight up. One...? What does ‘one’ mean in this context? In response to that, she curls her finger at the knuckles, up and down, again and again. She’s definitely trying to tell you something in particular. You asked if the baby was a boy or a girl, and she’s showing you the number one... ... Oh, it’s a penis. It’s a boy. Crude, but effective, you suppose. That just leaves the matter of the boy’s name. After all this time, you and Zo never got around to discussing it. It’s a difficult topic to really get into, given that the baby’s mom can’t speak, but on the other hand, you suppose, for that exact reason, she may or may not have a preference. Just in case, though, you ask her if she does. Pressing her arms together to make sure the baby doesn’t slip from against her chest – not that the baby is in a rush to go anywhere else – she brings her hands together to pantomime a name that she had in mind for him. First, she lifts her right hand and extends her index and middle fingers, both of them pointing in different diagonal directions. That one’s a V, easy enough. Next, she brings her hands together: her two index fingers press straight across from each other, their tips pressed into one-another, and she lifts her middle fingers to do the same, but from a raised, diagonal angle. She tucks in her thumbs to keep them from straggling and messing up the imagery. It’s a little more complex than the V, but... it looks like an A to you, albeit it’s a bit stout and wide. You ask if that’s correct, and she nods. Finally, she extends her index finger in her right hand straight up. That’s the whole pantomime for the letter, exactly the same as how she answered your question on whether it was a boy or a girl. In this case, it looks like the letter I. Then, she puts her hands down, going back to cradling the baby in her hands against her chest while it nurses from her. That’s it; she’s spelt the whole name out: she wants to name your baby boy Vai. Given who the baby’s mom is, it seems like a suitable name to you[silly |. You were fine with calling him Zo Two ].
rows.translation: 不过，只有一个…… [pc.ra lupine |你原本预计会生下两到六只幼崽，这对你的种类来说是很正常的，但显然，佐的身体只够容纳一只幼崽。 |你应该已经了解到，狼獾通常每次会生下2到6只幼崽，而每次只生一只幼崽的情况则被认为是不正常的。 ] 但这只意味着，这个孩子会得到父母更多的关注和照顾。 她向你招手部，你首先把水放在炉子旁边让它加热，然后你走到佐和你的宝宝身边，站在她的右侧，紧紧地依偎在她和你的宝宝身边。 尽管刚刚生完孩子，佐却丝毫没有显得疲惫不堪——所有的训练和身体控制能力显然为她带来了很大的帮助。她的笑容虽然已经不如从前那么灿烂，但依然清晰地挂在脸上，而且看起来短期内也不会消失。 很难保持下去。 [pc.isDK |就连你这样一个严厉的人，也至少露出了丝丝笑容吧。 |让自己也不要比她笑得少一点。 ]从你现在的角度很难判断，而且你也知道，每次你们问佐关于宝宝性别的问题时，对她来说都是一件很困难的事。但你们还是问了她：宝宝是男孩还是女孩？作为回答，她抬起了左手部，将食指伸得笔直。 “一……？”在这个情境下，“一”到底代表什么意思呢？ 作为回答…… 那个她反复地将手部指弯曲、伸直，显然是在试图向你传达什么特定的信息。你之前问过这个宝宝是男孩还是女孩，而她现在正在用这个动作告诉你答案…… ……哦，原来是阴茎的形状。所以这个宝宝是男孩。虽然有点粗俗，但确实很有效，不是吗？ 那就只剩下给男孩取名字这个问题了。这么长时间过去了，你和Zo一直都没有讨论过这个话题。考虑到孩子的母亲无法说话，这个话题确实很难讨论下去；但另一方面，也许正是因为这个原因，她反而可能没有特别的偏好。不过，为了保险起见，你还是问了她一下。 她将双臂紧紧抱在一起，确保婴儿不会从她胸前滑落——其实婴儿也并没有想要离开的意思。然后，她将双手部合拢，模仿着心中为这个婴儿想好的名字的发音。首先，她抬起右手部，伸直食指和中指，让这两根手部指朝不同的对角方向伸展。这个手部势代表字母“V”，很简单。 接下来，她将双手部并拢：两根食指并排伸直，指尖相互紧贴；然后她又将中指也以同样的方式伸直，但这次是以一个倾斜的角度。她把拇指收进去，防止它们影响这个手部势的形态。这个手部势比V字形稍微复杂一些，但……对你来说，它看起来更像是一个A字形，只不过这个A字形稍微粗一些、宽一些。你询问她这样是否正确，她点了点头。 最后，她用右手部的食指直直地伸向空中——这就是表示这个字母的手部势，和她之前回答你关于这个孩子是男孩还是女孩的问题时用的手部势一模一样。在这个手部势中，看起来就像是字母“I”。 然后，她把双手部放下来，重新把婴儿抱在胸前，让婴儿继续吃奶。就这样，她把整个名字都表示出来了：她想给你们的男孩取名为“Vai”。 考虑到这个宝宝的妈妈是谁，你觉得这个名字确实很合适。[silly |你之前完全不介意称他为“佐二”吧。 ].

rows.original: You and Zo stay with Vai for a time, simply enjoying being with your new family. Your teacher, lover, and baby-mother Zo, and your new son Vai, less than an hour old and already eating enough to sate someone twice his size. After a while, you figure the water’s warmed up enough by the hearth; you get up, and, noting the lack of towels in Zo’s home, improvise by dipping her top into the warm water and using that instead. [dayNight | |She was just washing that, but you assume that she won’t mind. ] [var1 |This isn’t your first time with a new kid of yours, but this feels a little different: normally, any kids that you have are either sent to the nursery in Hawkethorne, or, rarely, they stay with their other parents. This feels like it’s going to be the latter case, but... is that wise? Zo doesn’t exactly live a very accommodating life, out in the woods, with no way for Vai to be social with other babies. It’s hardly the healthiest environment for a kid to grow up in. Should you suggest to Zo that he be moved to Hawkethorne? She might not like that.... |You aren’t sure what comes next. This is uncharted territory for you: you’re now a parent, and the kid is going to live with his monastic mom in the woods. You could send Vai off to the nursery in Hawkethorne, and that’d certainly make things much easier, but you aren’t so sure if Zo would go along with it – not to mention that you sort of... were looking forward to the prospect of being a [pc.mf |dad |other-mom ] for Vai. ] Zo watches you with her brow furrowed; she understands that something is bothering you, but you haven’t said anything to her. Maybe she can just tell. Maybe she already knows what it is. With Vai firmly secured against her breasts, sound asleep, she lifts her hand and crooks her finger to you, beckoning you closer. You’re already leaning against her, but you acquiesce: you bring your face closer to hers, and when you’re close enough for your noses to touch, her hand suddenly cups your chin and she presses her lips against yours for a kiss. When she pulls away, her cheeks raise and turns her eyes into crescents underneath her smile. But she’s not done: with you as close as you are, she brings her other hand up to your head – gently, so as to not twist Vai around with her movements – and she places her fingers around your ears and temples, searching for some very specific spots on your head. You recognize what she’s doing, but this one is different; the spots she’s looking for are in completely different places, and all localized around your ears. Once she’s satisfied, she takes a deep breath through her nose and her eyes close. Her braided hair begins to lift off the ground, levitating underneath their own power. When she opens her eyes again, her emerald-green irises are replaced with shimmering silver, as before. Your own vision doesn’t change. Instead, it’s your hearing that goes: the ambient sounds of the world drown out around you, leaving you in a vacuum of noise, totally deaf to the world. But you nonetheless hear something else – something that your ears don’t register, but your mind does. It reminds you of the waves of the ocean, or a moving stream of water: something that implies motion while also trying to invoke a particular emotion. In this case, serenity and calmness. You hear it more easily out of your left ear (or, your left ‘ear’) than your right, and you hear two distinct sounds coming from two sources. One of them is larger and more defined, while the other is sharper, faster, and harder to make out. Yet they both incur the same feeling inside of you: that it’s okay. Things are better than they have been and it’s only going to get better from here. It almost feels like a mother singing a lullaby.... Your eyes go to Zo’s, her silver eyes staying focused, but she smiles again at you. Maybe you hit the nail on the head. Maybe what you’re hearing is Zo and Vai – not their voices, but something else. You’re hearing how they’re feeling in the moment; their contentment, their appreciation for you and each other, their emotions put into a manner that you can understand on a more primeval level than simply being told with words. As soon as one of Zo’s fingers slips from its position, your normal sense of hearing returns. Maybe that didn’t quite answer the concerns that you had – that this might not be the best conditions to raise a kid in – but the message that you got from both Zo and Vai were clear as day to you: Zo wants to be with her son, and Vai wants to be with his mom. They’re happy with where they are now and they want to try and stay as a family together. You’re not about to try and disrupt that.
rows.translation: 你和佐暂时留在了瓦伊身边，尽情享受与这个新家庭的相处时光。你的老师、爱人，同时也是你的奶妈——佐，以及你刚出生还不到一个小时的儿子瓦伊，他的食量之大，足以让一个体重是他两倍的人吃个饱。过了一会儿，你发现壁炉边的水已经热好了，于是起身准备使用。不过注意到佐家里没有毛巾，你便临时想出了一个办法：将她的上衣浸入温水中，然后用来擦拭身体。 [dayNight | |她刚刚在洗那个，但你却认为她不会介意。 ] [var1 |这已经不是你第一次迎接新的孩子了，但这次感觉有点不同：通常情况下，你拥有的孩子要么会被送到鹰棘镇的托儿所，要么——偶尔也会——由他们的另一位父母来抚养。这次看来似乎会属于后一种情况……不过，也还不确定呢。…这样真的明智吗？Zo的生活环境其实并不适合孩子成长——他生活在森林里，Vai也没有机会和其他幼崽一起玩耍、社交。这样的环境对孩子的成长来说显然并不健康。你是不是应该建议把Zo搬到鹰棘镇去呢？ 她可能不会喜欢那样…… |你不知道接下来会发生什么。这对你来说是一片未知的领域：你现在成为了父母，而孩子将会和他那过着隐居生活的母亲一起住在森林里。你…… 可以 把Vai送到鹰棘镇的托儿所去，这样肯定会让事情变得容易很多，但你不太确定Zo是否会同意这个主意——更不用说，你其实还挺期待能够…… [pc.mf |爸爸 |其他妈妈们 ] 为了Vai。 ] 佐皱着眉头注视着你；她明白有些事情在困扰着你，但你却什么都没告诉她。也许她能够帮上忙…… 告诉也许她已经知道那是什么了。 将Vai紧紧抱在胸前，她已经熟睡了。她抬起手，弯曲手指向你，示意你靠近一些。你本来就已经靠在她身上了，便顺着她的示意将脸凑得更近一些。当你们的鼻子几乎碰到一起时，她的手突然托住你的下巴，然后将嘴唇贴在你的嘴唇上吻了你。当她拉开距离时，她的脸颊微微上扬，笑容让她的双眼弯成了月牙形。 但她还没有结束：在你们如此靠近的情况下，她将另一只手轻轻伸到你的头上——动作非常轻柔，以免打扰到你的动作——然后用手指触碰你的耳朵和太阳穴，寻找你头部上某些特定的位置。你明白她在做什么，但这一次有所不同；她要寻找的位置完全在不同的地方，而且都集中在你的耳朵周围。 当她感到满意时，会通过鼻子深吸一口气，然后闭上眼睛。她那编成的头发开始脱离地面，凭着自己的力量悬浮在空中。当她再次睁开眼睛时，她那翡翠绿色的虹膜又变回了之前那种闪烁着银光的颜色。 你的视觉并没有发生变化，而是你的听觉出现了异常：周围的环境声彻底淹没了你的听觉，让你陷入一片嘈杂的“真空”之中，完全听不到外界的声音。然而，你仍然能够听到一些其他的东西——那些耳朵无法捕捉到的声音，但却能被你的心灵所感知。这些声音会让你联想到海洋的波浪，或是流动的水流：它们象征着运动，同时也试图引发某种特定的情感。在这种情境下，这种情感就是宁静与平和。 你用左耳听到的声音比右耳更清晰，而且你能分辨出这两个声音分别来自不同的地方。其中一个声音更加响亮、更加清晰，而另一个声音则更加尖锐、更快，也更难以分辨。然而，这两种声音都在你内心引发了同样的感受：一切都会好起来的，情况已经比以前好了，而且未来只会变得更好。这种感觉，简直就像是一位母亲在为孩子唱摇篮曲…… 你的目光落在佐身上，她那银色的眼睛依然专注地注视着你，但她又对你露出了微笑。也许你说到点子上了。也许你所听到的，其实是佐和瓦伊的内心感受——并非他们的声音，而是其他某种东西。你听到的是他们此刻的情绪：他们的满足感、他们对彼此的感激之情，这些情感以一种比语言更加原始、更加直接的方式传达了出来，让你能够真正理解他们的感受。 只要佐的某个手指从原来的位置上移开，你的正常听力就会恢复。 也许这并没有完全解答你心中的疑虑——这样的环境是否真的适合抚养孩子——但佐和瓦伊传达给你的信息非常明确：佐想要和她的儿子在一起，而瓦伊也想和他的妈妈在一起。他们对自己现在的处境很满意，也希望能够继续作为一个家庭生活在一起。 你绝对不可能试图破坏这一点。

rows.original:
Vai’s spent most of the hours with you and Zo sleeping and regaining his energy from being brought into the world, [var0 201
                    |and taking care of the baby’s been hard on Zo; she falls asleep soon after
                    |and despite using her bodily training to give birth easily and painlessly, Zo herself seemed pretty worn and tired for longer than usual
                ]. You waited with them until morning, bonding with your family and making sure Zo had everything she needed to be a good mom. Raising a child is a big effort, after all, especially since you’re not going to be around every hour of every day.
                
                Zo and Vai see you off the next morning[var0 214
                    |
                    | – figuratively, in Vai’s case, since his eyes haven’t opened yet –
                ] at the entrance to her grove. A part of you is hesitant to leave for your daily [silly
                    |grind
                    |tasks
                ], but this is, unfortunately, the way of your life. At least you’re confident in Zo and her being able to take care of herself and your son.
                
                As usual, she sends you off with a smile, a kiss, and a hug, although learning to hold her against you with Vai in between you two is going to be a little trickier. But letting them go whenever you leave is going to be harder.
                
                You leave Zo’s grove once again, but you’ll be back soon. There’s more than just Zo waiting for you there now.
rows.translation:
Vai大部分时间都是和你以及Zo一起睡觉，恢复他出生后所消耗的能量。 [var0 201
                    |照顾这个婴儿让佐感到非常疲惫，她往往在照顾完后很快就会睡着。
                    |尽管她运用了自己平时锻炼的身体素质，使得分娩过程既轻松又无痛，但佐自己看起来却比平时更加疲惫不堪。
                ]你和他们一起等待到了清晨，与家人建立了深厚的感情，同时也确保了Zo拥有成为一位好母亲所需的一切条件。毕竟，抚养孩子是一件非常耗费精力的事情，尤其是当你无法每天每时都陪伴在孩子身边的时候。

第二天清晨，Zo和Vai送你离开了。[var0 214
                    |

                ] 在她的小树林入口处。你内心有一部分其实并不愿意离开，继续过你日常的生活…… [silly
                    |苦练

"
                Vai’s spent most of the hours with you and Zo sleeping and regaining his energy from being brought into the world, [var0 201
                    |and taking care of the baby’s been hard on Zo; she falls asleep soon after
                    |and despite using her bodily training to give birth easily and painlessly, Zo herself seemed pretty worn and tired for longer than usual
                ]. You waited with them until morning, bonding with your family and making sure Zo had everything she needed to be a good mom. Raising a child is a big effort, after all, especially since you’re not going to be around every hour of every day.
                
                Zo and Vai see you off the next morning[var0 214
                    |
                    | – figuratively, in Vai’s case, since his eyes haven’t opened yet –
                ] at the entrance to her grove. A part of you is hesitant to leave for your daily [silly
                    |grind
                    |tasks
                ], but this is, unfortunately, the way of your life. At least you’re confident in Zo and her being able to take care of herself and your son.
                
                As usual, she sends you off with a smile, a kiss, and a hug, although learning to hold her against you with Vai in between you two is going to be a little trickier. But letting them go whenever you leave is going to be harder.

rows.original: When you enter Zo’s grove once again, [dayNight |you see her out in the flower fields, tending to her garden as usual and practicing her inner harmonies. She seems to like that particular form of training the most, and it’s not hard to understand why: she may be able to use her inner energies to communicate with your growing child just as well as she can with the flowers she blooms. Her ears perk upward when she hears your footsteps along the beaten gravel path leading into her grove, and when she sees you, it’s with the same, earnest, excited smile as she had been giving you lately. She stands, eager to greet you, her pregnant stomach wobbling with the effort – and just as soon as she does, she stops, her expression dropping and her eyes widening. She glances down across her body, trying to get a look at the rest of herself, but her pregnant belly is in the way of the most important part. You can see it, though: her water just broke! |you see a gentle candlelight flickering from inside of her house, letting you know exactly where she is. Despite her pregnancy, she’s always diligently at work with maintaining her home during the nighttime hours, whether it’s cleaning her clothes or doing other menial chores to make her monastic life a little easier for herself. Her ears perk upward when she hears your footsteps at the entrance to her home, and when she sees you, it’s with the same, earnest, excited smile as she had been giving you lately. She’s sitting naked as the day she was born, her clothing soaking in a washtub near her feet. When you enter, Zo stands, eager to greet you, her pregnant stomach wobbling with the effort – and just as soon as she does, she stops, her expression dropping and her eyes widening. She glances down across her body, trying to get a look at the rest of herself, but her pregnant belly is in the way of the most important part. You can see it, though: her water just broke! ] Your first instinct is to get excited, and not strictly in a good way: yes, your baby is coming any minute now, but this is hardly the conditions you were hoping for Zo to be in when she was ready. It’s hard not to fret when your baby is nearly ready to see the light of day! Zo, however, seems more amused and curious at the feeling: her brow furrows, yet her lips crook upward in a smile, and she tilts her head, as if trying to piece together what’s happening. You rush to her side to help her[dayNight | get undressed and into the house – perhaps not in that order, but your frazzled mind is going a mile a minute – | to her bed so she can get more comfortable, ] and Zo is thankful for your efforts, but she doesn’t seem to be in any rush. It’s not like where she is or what she’s doing is going to make the baby come any sooner or later. [dayNight |You lead her back into the house, letting her lean on you as you two walk, your hand tightly holding onto hers. When you’re in, you help her to the bed and undress, getting ready for what comes next. |You go to her side and let her lean against you, your hand tightly holding onto hers, as you lead her towards the bed to get more comfortable. At least she’s already undressed. ] You’re not a midwife[pc.hasKids |, but you’re not a stranger to what’s happening: you tell Zo to spread her legs and to focus on her breathing. |, and you’ve never had any kids before – you’re perhaps the least qualified person in the whole damn valley, let alone the grove! You just tell her to lean back and, uhh... spread her legs. That sounds like a reasonable start. ] However, Zo reacts differently: once she’s comfortable[dayNight | and half-naked ], her eyes shut; she takes a deep breath through her nose; and the braids of her hair begin to glow and vibrate, their ends lifting into the air under their own power. As soon as she starts, the bulge of her stomach gives a small jerk – the baby’s kicking. Maybe it knows that it’s time, as well. Her eyes half-open, and you see her irises have changed from the deep emerald green to the shimmering silver that you’re familiar with. Her pupils are dilated slightly, which is a bit unusual, but when her eyes go to yours, she gives you a small, disarming smile, letting you know that she’s fine – everything’s going to be okay. It removes the tension in your shoulders, although it only slightly calms your nerves. It does, however, give you enough clarity to think that you should probably get a warm, wet towel to hold the baby in when it arrives. [dayNight |Zo has a washtub that she uses to clean her clothes in; it’s not exactly a dignified delivery method, but it’ll have to do in a pinch. You grab it and |There is that washtub that she was just using to clean her clothes, but perhaps you shouldn’t have the baby delivered in a tub full of water she was using to clean her laundry. You grab it, toss out the soaked clothes onto a dry spot on the floor, then dump the rest of the water out just outside of the door before ] you head to a creek that runs just outside the perimeter of the grove. It’s filled in short order, but it’s also outdoor temperature. You’ll have to warm it by Zo’s hearth when you get back. Luckily, you don’t imagine that the baby will be due for at least another few hours, since her water only just broke, so there’s a bit of time to get ready–
rows.translation: 当你再次走进佐的树林时， [dayNight |你会看到她在花田里，像往常一样照料她的花园，同时修炼内心的和谐。她似乎特别喜欢这种修炼方式，这也很容易理解：因为她能够运用自己的内在能量，与你正在成长的孩子进行交流，就如同她与那些盛开的花朵交流一样自如。 当她听到你沿着那条铺满碎石的小路走向她的树林时，她的耳朵立刻竖了起来；而当她看到你时，脸上依然挂着那种同样真诚而兴奋的笑容。她站起身来，急切地想要迎接你，怀孕的腹部因为这个动作而微微晃动——然而就在她刚站起来的那一刻，她突然停住了，脸上的表情瞬间消失了，双眼也睁得大大的。 她低头看了看自己的身体，试图看看其他部位的情况，但隆起的腹部挡住了她想要看到的地方。 不过，还是可以看出来的：她的羊水刚刚破了！ |你可以看到，她屋内柔和的烛光正在闪烁，这清楚地指示着她的位置。尽管她怀孕了，但在夜晚，她依然会认真地料理家务，无论是清洗衣物，还是做其他琐碎的工作，只为让自己这种简朴的生活能够更加舒适一些。 当她听到你走近家门的脚步声时，她的耳朵立刻竖了起来；而当你出现在她面前时，她依然挂着那种同样真挚而兴奋的笑容。她此刻一丝不挂，就如同她出生那天一样，而她的衣服则浸泡在脚边的洗衣盆里。 当你走进来时，佐站了起来，迫不及待地想要迎接你，她那怀孕的肚子因为用力而微微晃动——就在她刚站起来的那一刻，她停住了，表情瞬间变得凝重，眼睛也睁得大大的。她低头看了看自己的身体，试图看看自己的其他部位，但那怀孕的肚子挡住了她想要看到的最重要部分。 你可以看到的，她的羊水刚刚破了！ ] 你的第一反应就是感到兴奋，不过这种兴奋并不完全是积极的：没错，你的宝宝随时都可能出生了，但现在的环境显然并不是你希望 Zo 在出生时所处的条件。这真的让人很难接受。 不是 当你的宝宝即将诞生时，你却为此感到焦虑和担忧！ 然而，佐似乎对这种感觉更加感兴趣，也更加好奇：她的眉头微微皱起，但嘴唇却上扬露出微笑，她还歪着头，仿佛在努力理解正在发生的事情。你立刻走到她身边，准备帮助她。[dayNight | 脱掉衣服然后进屋吧——也许顺序不必这么严格，但你现在这个混乱的思绪简直快乱成一团了…… | 让她上床休息，这样会舒服些。 ] 佐也很感激你的努力，但她似乎并不着急。毕竟，她现在的处境或正在做的事情，并不会让宝宝提前出生或推迟出生。 [dayNight |你带着她回到屋里，两人一起走的时候，让她依靠在你的身上，你的手紧紧握着她的手。进了屋后，你帮她上床并脱掉衣服，为接下来发生的事情做好准备。 |你走到她身边，让她靠在你的身上，双手紧紧握住她的手，然后带着她走向床边，让她能更舒适地躺下。至少她已经脱掉衣服了。 ] 你可不是什么助产士。[pc.hasKids |但你其实对正在发生的事情并不陌生：你告诉佐分开双腿，然后专注于呼吸。 |而且你之前也从没有孩子……你大概是整个山谷里最不合适的人选了，更别提整个森林里了！你只需要告诉她放松身体，然后……把腿分开就行了。这听起来应该是个合理的开始方法。 ] 然而，佐的反应却不同：一旦她感到舒适了，她的行为就会发生变化。[dayNight | 半裸着 ]她闭上眼睛，通过鼻子深吸一口气，她的发辫开始发轻型并振动，发辫的末端在自身力量的作用下升到了空中。当她开始移动的那一刻，她的腹部微微一颤——那是胎儿在踢腿。 也许它也知道，是时候了。 她的双眼半睁着，你可以看到她的虹膜已经从深绿色的变成了你熟悉的那种闪烁着银轻型的颜色。她的瞳孔略微放大，这有点不寻常，但当她的目轻型与你的目轻型相遇时，她露出了一个温柔而让人安心的微笑，让你知道她一切都好——一切都会顺利的。 它能缓解你肩部的紧张感，虽然只是稍微让你的神经放松一些而已。 不过，它确实能让你思路更加清晰，从而让你意识到：当宝宝出生时，准备一条温暖潮湿的毛巾来包裹宝宝应该是必要的。 [dayNight |佐有一个洗衣盆，她用它来清洗衣服；虽然这种方法看起来并不太体面，但在紧急情况下也只能将就用了。你抓起它，然后…… |有 是 就是那个她刚才用来洗衣服的浴缸……不过，或许你真的不应该在装满水的浴缸里生孩子吧。你抓起浴缸，把浸湿的衣服扔到地板上的干燥地方，然后把剩下的水倒到门外的地方…… ] 你来到了一条流淌在树林边缘的小溪旁。 水很快就被收集满了，不过由于是在户外，水温还是相当低的。回来之后，你得用佐的火炉把水加热才行。幸运的是，你觉得宝宝至少还要再等几个小时才会出生，因为她的羊水才刚刚开始破裂…… 只是 我现在手头没什么钱，所以有些时间可以用来准备。

rows.original:
When you approach Zo’s cabin in the grove, you hear something unusual: a quiet sound, almost like a sort of hum or coo, that’s barely discernable over the ambient noise of the grove around you and the sound of your own footsteps. At first, you think nothing of it.
            
            When you enter the cabin, however, there is Zo, her eyes having reverting back to their deep green and the braids of her hair having calmed back down. And cradled in both of her hands is a tiny lupine baby, hardly the size of your palm, blind as could be and squirming against her arms and her chest, its tiny hands and feet kicking against her fur as it tries to squirm its way deeper into her and find a nipple to start feeding on. The hums and coos from just outside the cabin are coming from it. You had turned away for only a few minutes, and already, you... you missed it.
            
            Zo looks up at you, her eyebrows arching upward in apology – she knows that this was a big moment for you both, but in you trying to be a good parent, you had missed the most impactful part of the whole event.
            
            Still. Just because you missed the ‘big event,’ that doesn’t mean you’re not present for the most important part. Zo’s given birth to your child. A healthy lupine child, nestled against her chest, probably hungry from all the hard work it just put in, occasionally cooing out and making whiny noises as it nestles deeper against Zo’s fur. Once it finds her nipple, it settles in and holds still.
rows.translation:
当你走近树林中的佐的小屋时，你会听到一些不寻常的声音：那种声音很轻柔，几乎像是一种嗡嗡声或轻柔的呢喃，但在周围树林的嘈杂声以及你自己的足部步声中，这种声音几乎听不见。起初，你并没有太在意这些声音。
            
            然而，当你走进小屋时，你会看到佐——她的双眼已经恢复了深绿色的颜色，头上的辫子也重新整理整齐。她双手部中怀抱着一只小小的狼崽，它的体型几乎只有你的手部掌那么大，双眼完全失明，正在她的手部臂和胸前扭动挣扎。它那小小的手部足部不断踢打着她的毛皮，试图往她身体里更深处钻去，寻找乳头开始吸奶。 小屋外传来的嗡嗡声和轻柔的鸣叫声，显然就是从里面发出来的。你只是离开了几分钟而已，就已经……开始想念它了。
            
            佐抬头看着你，她的眉毛微微上扬，露出歉意——她知道这对你们来说都是一个非常重要的时刻，但你在努力做一个好父母的过程中，却错过了整个事件中最关键的部分。
            
            不过，即使你错过了那个“重要时刻”，也并不意味着你没有参与到最关键的部分中来。佐已经为你生下了孩子——一个健康的幼崽，正依偎在她的怀里，或许因为刚刚经历了那么多的努力而感到有些饿，偶尔会发出呜呜声，然后更加紧地贴在佐的毛皮上。 一旦找到了她的乳头，它就会固定在那里，不再移动。

rows.original:
It’s been a little while since you last entered Zo’s grove, although you’ve lost track of how long it’s been, exactly. You wonder how long her pregnancy’s come; she went into heat so long ago, it feels like, and that one hot-and-heavy night, although still fresh in your memory, feels like it was years ago.
    
    Zo is nowhere to be found[dayNight
        |, which is unusual: she’s normally out in the fields doing some form of training or another. But you hear the sound of general commotion coming from her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack]; odds are good she’s in there.
        |, although you see the flicker of a gentle candlelight coming from inside her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack]; it makes sense that she’d have retired for the night
    ]. You step inside, rapping your knuckles against the door’s frame a few times to get her attention.
    
    There Zo is, sitting on her bed, her legs draping over its sides. A bucket of water sits by the shack’s hearth, warming by the fire, but not close enough that it’ll be brought to a boil. And cradled in her arms is a small lupine boy[zo.pregDays 214
        |, his eyes already opened and staring upward towards Zo
        |, his eyes firmly shut and blind to the world around himself
    ].
    
    She’s already given birth... and you missed it. The whole thing.
    
    Still, Zo doesn’t seem too displeased with you: as soon as she realizes it’s you, she hefts the baby in her arms, [zo.pregDays 214
        |trying to get it to look in your direction. It does – but it hardly registers your presence before going back to snuggling into Zo’s arms
        |motioning to you that, yes, indeed, she has given birth – and it’s your child that she’s holding
    ]. Her eyes are narrowed into slits with how wide her smile is wide enough that it could [dayNight
        |blot out the sun
        |light up the night
    ].
    
    The baby in her arms is hardly large enough to fit into her palm; it has fine fur all over its body and its tail is thin and spindly, its bushiness not yet having time to grow in. It seems somewhat timid of the world around itself, although you aren’t an expert on baby behaviors. After it’s done admiring its mom, it coos out a whiny noise and buries itself into her chest, worming its way into her fur and seeking out a nipple; once it finds one, it settles in and holds still.

rows.original:
When you enter Zo’s grove, you see the woman herself standing in the doorway to her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack], and in her arms is Vai, nestled up against her chest. She has her free hand poking at his face and at his belly, trying to get him to play along with her; occasionally, you see the flash of a pair of tiny baby hands reaching out to grip onto her fingers, pulling at them individually. When she hears your footsteps on the gravel path, her ears perk and she looks up, and as soon as she realizes that it’s you, she waves at you energetically, trying to get you to approach.

    You do, of course: that’s your lover and your son. Her smile is infectiously wide, especially when she looks back down at Vai in between dangling her fingers above him and glancing up towards you. You take your place at her side...
    
    ... and you see Vai in her arms, his eyes wide open. His dark-green eyes go from Zo’s to yours, eyeing you curiously before going back to his mother’s. They’re clear as could be, and his pupils are dilated to a healthy size for the light of the day; it’s like he’s had them open for his whole life, now. You had missed the moment when he first opened them. By a good while, it seems like.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Even you can’t help but feel a bit of a pit in your stomach at the thought. How can you expect to raise a badass progeny after yourself if you aren’t even there to raise him?
        |There’s a sinking feeling in your stomach when you think about it. It was one of his landmark achievements as a being, and you weren’t there for it.
    ] Your shoulders slump; although you’re happy to see that he’s healthy and can see just fine, you were absent for an important step in his life.
    
    Zo kindly nudges you with her head, bumping into you with the top of her scalp to try and get you to cheer up. She can’t wind back the clock... but what’s important is that you’re here now, with her and your son. There will be other landmarks in Vai’s life.

    Zo kindly nudges you with her head, bumping into you with the top of her scalp to try and get you to cheer up. She can’t wind back the clock... but what’s important is that you’re here now, with her and your son. There will be other landmarks in Vai’s life."

rows.original:
When you enter Zo’s grove, you see her just beginning to emerge from her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|shack], with Vai in her arms, coming out after doing what looks like some washing for her own outfit, based on how clean it is on her body. Vai rests on his back, snuggled up against her chest and resting on her right arm; when Zo sees you, she smiles and waves to you, beckoning you towards her.

    You step up to her and greet her with a kiss that only lasts a second; passionate, but not in a hurry. Your left hand goes to her back to embrace her, your arm going down diagonally across her back and your hand stopping at her hip. You lean in to Vai, pressing your nose against his to say hello; when you make contact, his nose sniffles and flexes left and right, as if he’s about to sneeze, but it never comes.
    
    However, you notice something else: the very slight twinkle of white sclera underneath his closed eyelids. You squint your eyes to see it; when you point it out to Zo, she leans in to inspect what it is you’re looking at, and she sees it, too. Is this it? Is Vai about to open his eyes?
    
    You and Zo watch with rapt attention, patiently waiting to see what happens next. Vai fusses, his hands going to his face, his fingers scratching at his eyes like you would if you had something caught in them. After he pulls his hands away, his eyelids slowly creak open, blinking shut again and again, unused to the light flooding in against them. It takes him the better part of a few minutes, but, eventually, he manages to get them open.
    
    His eyes are dark green, taking [var0
        |more 
    ]after his mother, but it’s difficult to really get a good look at his irises because his pupils are so dilated that they press the colors of his eyes razor-thin. Both of his eyes are also covered in a thin film of mucus; it reminds you of that morning fog you need to blink or wipe away when you wake up. Vai looks at both you and Zo, but it’s unlikely that he can make out either of your shapes, or even tell you apart, at least for the time being.
    
    After his eyes wander anywhere between you and Zo and the rest of the outside world for a moment, he whines, rubs at his eyes again, and retreats into the comfortable, warm darkness of Zo’s breast.
    
    You look up at Zo, and the smile plastered all over her face is absolutely infectious. You were here for Vai opening his eyes – a major accomplishment for your son. The first of many for him, you’re certain.
rows.translation:
当你走进佐的树林时，你会看到她刚刚从那里走出来。 [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|小屋|简陋的小屋]抱着Vai，看起来像是刚刚洗了自己的衣服，因为她的衣服非常干净。Vai仰面躺着，依偎在她的胸前，搭在她的右臂上；当Zo看到你时，她微笑着向你招手部，示意你朝她走去。

    你走到她面前，用一个持续仅一秒钟的吻来问候她；这个吻充满热情，但并不急促。你的左手部伸到她的背后将她拥入怀中，手部臂斜斜地搭在她的背上，手部则落在她的臀部。你靠近瓦伊，将鼻子贴在他的鼻子上打招呼；当你们的鼻子接触在一起时，他的鼻子开始抽动，左右摇晃，仿佛快要打喷嚏了，但最终并没有喷出来。
    
    然而，你注意到了另一处细节：在他紧闭的眼皮下，那微微闪动的白色巩膜。你眯起眼睛仔细观察；当你把这一发现告诉佐时，她也凑过来查看，果然也看到了。难道就是这个吗？难道瓦伊即将睁开眼睛了吗？
    
    你和佐全神贯注地注视着，耐心地等待着接下来会发生什么。瓦伊不停地揉搓着自己的脸，手部指不停地抓挠着眼睛，就像你的眼睛里进了什么东西一样。当他把手部拿开后，他的眼睑缓缓地睁开了，却又一次又一次地闭上，因为他的眼睛还不适应突如其来的强轻型。过了好几分钟，他终于成功地睁开了眼睛。
    
    他的眼睛是深绿色的。 [var0
        |更多 
    ]他的眼睛颜色随他母亲一样，但由于瞳孔极度放大，眼睛的颜色几乎看不清楚了——那些颜色被瞳孔完全遮住了。他的两只眼睛上还覆盖着一层薄薄的黏液，这让人联想到早上醒来时那种需要眨眼或擦掉的眼雾。 瓦伊看着你和佐，但至少目前来说，他似乎无法分辨出你们的外形，甚至无法将你们区分开来。

他的目轻型在你们和佐，以及外面的世界之间游移了一会儿，然后他发出呜咽声，再次揉了揉眼睛，随后便躲进了佐温暖而舒适的怀抱之中。
    
    你抬头看着佐，她脸上洋溢着的笑容实在令人感染。你来这里，就是为了见证瓦伊睁开眼睛的那一刻——这对你的儿子来说无疑是一项重大的成就。你相信，这只是他未来众多成就中的第一个而已。

rows.original:
When you enter Zo’s grove, you see her and Vai out in front of her cabin, next to the door and facing the wall. Vai is tucked securely into her right arm; in her left hand is a stick with a long, thin, whip-like tip, and at her feet are several buckets filled with some form of liquid. You can’t tell from your angle, but you know it’s not water.

    Zo dips the whip-like end of the stick into one of the buckets, and then draws it across the wooden wall beside the door, leaving a streak of green dye across it. Then, she lowers it and swirls it around one of the other buckets, before dipping it into a different one and giving the other end to Vai, who repeats the action, leaving a streak of blue across the wall.
    
    Zo’s ears perk up when she hears your footsteps approaching. She turns to see you, and when she realizes it’s you, her already giggly, wide smile turns wider, lifting her cheeks to press up against the mask around her eyes. She’s covered in a number of different dyes, all across her fur and her outfit – Vai has multiple different canvases, from the looks of things.
    
    She hefts Vai in her arms once to get his attention; he coos once, wagging the stick around and splashing blue dye everywhere it goes, including onto yourself. Once you have his attention, he waves his free hand towards you, his fingers flexing; you reach out with your own, letting his tiny fingers grip onto yours – and then he slaps the still-wet stick across your [pc.skinFurScales], leaving a wet, blue splotch where it landed.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Zo does that awkward heaving through her nose that she does when she wants to laugh – and even you can’t help but crack a bit of a smile.
        |You and Zo both laugh – hers coming out as that awkward nasal breathing that she does. It’s good to know that Vai’s a bit of an artist!
    ]
rows.translation:
当你走进佐的树林时，你会看到她和瓦伊站在她的小屋前，靠近门的位置，背对着墙壁。瓦伊紧紧地依偎在她的右臂上；她的左手中拿着一根末端细长如鞭子的棍子，而她的足部边放着几个装满某种液体的桶。从你的视角来看，你无法分辨那些液体究竟是什么，但你可以肯定那不是水。

    佐将棍子那根像鞭子一样的末端浸入其中一个桶里，然后将其在门旁的木墙上划过，留下了一条绿色的染料痕迹。接着，她把棍子放下，在另一个桶里转了几圈，然后再将其浸入另一个桶中，然后将棍子的另一端交给瓦伊，瓦伊也重复了这个动作，从而在墙上留下了一条蓝色的痕迹。
    
    当听到你的足部步声靠近时，佐的耳朵立刻竖了起来。她转过身来，看到是你后，原本就带着笑意的脸庞笑得更加灿烂了，她的脸颊因为笑意而变得更加红润，几乎要把眼睛周围的口罩都撑破了。她的毛发和衣服上涂满了各种各样的颜料——从这些痕迹来看，瓦伊应该准备了好几种不同的颜料来为她上色。
    
    她把瓦伊抱在怀里，想引起他的注意；他发出一声轻哼，同时挥动手中的棍子，蓝色的颜料溅得到处都是，甚至也溅到了他自己身上。一旦引起了他的注意，他就会用空着的那只手朝你挥动，手指微微弯曲；你伸出自己的手，让他那小小的手指握住你的手——然后，他会用那根还沾着颜料的棍子拍打你的…… [pc.skinFurScales]落在那里后，留下了一块湿漉漉的蓝色痕迹。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |佐做出了那种她想要笑时才会有的、有点尴尬的抽动鼻子的动作——就连你也会忍不住露出微笑。
        |你和佐都笑了——她的笑声听起来就是那种尴尬的鼻音。知道瓦伊还挺有艺术细胞的，真是太好了！
    ]

rows.original:
When you enter Zo’s grove, you see her at her flower garden, resting on her knees and tending to the flowers, currently out-of-season. You expected her to be practicing tapping into her inner energies to guide the flowers to bloom, but she’s instead focusing on only one flower at a time, cupping its bulb with both her hands and bringing her nose in to take a sniff.

    Frolicking – or, perhaps just crawling – through the stems of the flowers is Vai, worming his way between the long stems of the flowers and making them sway as he moves. His brown fur contrasts starkly with the greens of the flower stems, but it blends with the dark brown dirt that they’re plotted in. He likes to move between them, making them sway whenever he brushes against them with his arms or legs.
    
    Zo’s attention lifts towards you when she hears your footsteps approach her grove, and she smiles and beckons you toward her with her left hand. You take a spot next to her, sitting on the ground beside her with your knees pointed outwards rather than folded underneath yourself like she has hers. Zo gently bites into her lower lip with her top teeth, and a quick, nearly-silent ‘fweet!’ slips from between them; Vai coos once, then turns around and starts crawling towards Zo... and then changes course again once he sees you.
    
    Vai crawls onto your ankles first, but has a hard time getting any higher. You lift him from underneath his armpits and tuck your arm underneath his rump for support, holding your son close to your chest and bringing him up to your eyes. He mumbles some unintelligible baby-talk at you while his hands, still dirty from crawling around in the garden, drag all across your cheeks and around your forehead.
    
    Zo sighs contentedly through her nose at the sight of you and your son bonding together in front of her flowers. She leans forward to take another sniff, and you do the same, using your free hand to cup the closed bulb of one and pressing your nose into the barely-open tip. The smell is fairly muted compared to what you were ready for, but it’s about what you were expecting – they aren’t in season, after all.
    
    When you lean forward to smell one flower, Vai reaches forward, grasping onto one of the nearest unoccupied flowers, and he, mimicking his parents, brings his whole face into the bulb to get a smell. A moment later, he sneezes, lurching backward and letting the flower go, causing it to bob underneath its own weight.
    
    You and Zo laugh with Vai and his silly antics, and it distracts you from the fact that the flower Vai was just holding is a bit more open than it was before....
rows.translation:
当你走进佐的花园时，你会看到她正坐在花丛中，双膝跪地，照料那些此时本应处于休眠期的花朵。你原本以为她正在努力调动内在的能量，促使这些花朵绽放，但实际上，她一次只专注于一朵花，用双手部捧住它的花球，仔细地闻着它的香气。

    在花朵的茎秆间穿梭嬉戏——或者，也许只是缓慢爬行——的，是瓦伊。它用身体在那些长长的花茎间穿行，移动时还会让它们轻轻摇晃。它棕色的毛皮与花茎的绿色形成了鲜明的对比，但与周围深棕色的泥土却融为了一体。它喜欢在花茎间移动，每当用四肢触碰到它们时，就会引发那些花茎的摇晃。
    
    当佐听到你的脚步声靠近她的树林时，她将注意力转向了你，然后微笑着用左手部向你招手部。你在她旁边坐下，像她那样将膝盖朝外伸开，而不是像她那样将膝盖弯曲放在身下。 佐用上牙轻轻咬住下唇，一个短促而几乎无声的“嗯”声从她唇间逸出；瓦伊轻声哼了一声，然后转身开始朝佐爬去……但当他看到你时，又改变了方向。
    
    瓦伊首先爬到你的脚踝处，但很难再往上爬。你把他从腋下抱起来，然后将手部臂伸到他的臀部下方进行支撑，把儿子紧紧抱在胸前，让他能够与你的眼睛平视。他用那些还不太能听懂的婴儿语对你说着什么，而他的小手部因为在花园里爬来爬去而还沾满了泥土，那些小手部在你的脸颊和额头上划来划去。
    
    看到你和你的儿子在她的花丛前亲密互动，佐满意地哼了一声。她向前倾了倾身子，又深吸了一口，你也跟着做了同样的动作——用空着的那只手部托住那朵花闭合的花朵部分，然后将鼻子凑到那微微张开的花瓣上。这种香味其实比你预想的要淡一些，但也在你的预期范围内——毕竟现在还不是这些花的盛花期。
    
    当你向前倾斜去闻一朵花的时候，瓦伊也会伸出手部，抓住附近那朵没人采摘的花，然后模仿父母的样子，把整个脸凑到花蕊上闻味道。过了一会儿，他会打喷嚏，身体向后一仰，松开了手部，那朵花在自身重量的作用下开始晃动。
    
    你和佐一起，被瓦伊那些滑稽的举动逗得哈哈大笑，也因此忽略了一个事实——瓦伊手部中拿的那朵花，现在开放得比之前更大了……

rows.original: At the entrance to Zo’s [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack] are Zo and Vai; he’s sitting in the washtub she normally uses to clean her clothes, with the water reaching up to the crest of his stomach, and she’s sitting with her legs spread on either side of the tub with her sleeves rolled up to her shoulders. She looks up when she hears your feet on the gravel path leading into the grove, and she waves at you – and as soon as her hands let go of Vai, he starts laughing and splashing around, kicking his arms and legs and causing the water to fling every which way. She smiles and does that nasally laugh of hers, lifting her hand to try and protect her face from some of the splash water, before reaching down to get him back under control so she can scrub at his fur. Heck, bath time is always a fun time. You step up to them both and put yourself down on the opposite side of the tub, your own hands reaching in to help get Vai clean. She doesn’t have much in the way of soap and instead uses her hands and fingers to try and work all the dirt and grime out of his fur – although you notice more than a few flower petals and pine needles floating around in the water. Maybe to give it some deodorizing scents? Vai, it turns out, loves being in the water; every time Zo cups her hands underneath the water’s surface, he holds still with anticipation, and when she lifts her hands and lets it waterfall onto his head, he starts laughing and kicking and shaking his body to let it get everywhere he can. You and her work as a team: one of you distracts Vai by splashing the water around him, while the other uses the opportunity to clean underneath his downy fur, trying to get all the way down to his skin. Eventually, he’s as clean as you two are going to get him, and the water is starting to get murky and cold. Typical of a toddler, though, he starts fussing and pulling once you pull him out of the water and attempt to dry him, trying to get back into the water, and, from the sounds of him, he’s on the verge of crying until he gets it. But Zo, apparently knowing exactly what to do, cradles him in both of her arms; she shuts her eyes; the ends of her braided hair begin to shimmy and lift slightly into the air; and, almost as soon as it all starts, Vai starts to settle until he’s calm once again. Of course, now that Vai is all cleaned, that still leaves the matter of what he’s going to do for the rest of the day. And him being a curious, locomotive baby that likes to crawl anywhere he goes, he’s just going to get dirty again in a few minutes. But it’s the thought that counts.

rows.raw: " At the entrance to Zo’s [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack] are Zo and Vai; he’s sitting in the washtub she normally uses to clean her clothes, with the water reaching up to the crest of his stomach, and she’s sitting with her legs spread on either side of the tub with her sleeves rolled up to her shoulders. She looks up when she hears your feet on the gravel path leading into the grove, and she waves at you – and as soon as her hands let go of Vai, he starts laughing and splashing around, kicking his arms and legs and causing the water to fling every which way. She smiles and does that nasally laugh of hers, lifting her hand to try and protect her face from some of the splash water, before reaching down to get him back under control so she can scrub at his fur. Heck, bath time is always a fun time. You step up to them both and put yourself down on the opposite side of the tub, your own hands reaching in to help get Vai clean. She doesn’t have much in the way of soap and instead uses her hands and fingers to try and work all the dirt and grime out of his fur – although you notice more than a few flower petals and pine needles floating around in the water. Maybe to give it some deodorizing scents? Vai, it turns out, loves being in the water; every time Zo cups her hands underneath the water’s surface, he holds still with anticipation, and when she lifts her hands and lets it waterfall onto his head, he starts laughing and kicking and shaking his body to let it get everywhere he can. You and her work as a team: one of you distracts Vai by splashing the water around him, while the other uses the opportunity to clean underneath his downy fur, trying to get all the way down to his skin. Eventually, he’s as clean as you two are going to get him, and the water is starting to get murky and cold. Typical of a toddler, though, he starts fussing and pulling once you pull him out of the water and attempt to dry him, trying to get back into the water, and, from the sounds of him, he’s on the verge of crying until he gets it. But Zo, apparently knowing exactly what to do, cradles him in both of her arms; she shuts her eyes; the ends of her braided hair begin to shimmy and lift slightly into the air; and, almost as soon as it all starts, Vai starts to settle until he’s calm once again. Of course, now that Vai is all cleaned, that still leaves the matter of what he’s going to do for the rest of the day. And him being a curious, locomotive baby that likes to crawl anywhere he goes, he’s just going to get dirty again in a few minutes. But it’s the thought that counts."

rows.original:
You say to Zo that you’d like to spend some time with her and Vai, and you ask her if she has any ideas on what you three could do to spend the time together. She, naturally, has just the idea.

        Zo reaches for Vai, picking him up by the armpits and sitting him on her lap as she herself sits on the ground in front of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack]. Vai fusses and squirms a little bit at first, his arms reaching for something off in the distance that apparently he finds fascinating, but she folds her arms in an X overtop of him to keep him still and close to her. Then, she lowers her head and closes her eyes, and her braided hair slowly starts to lift into the air behind herself, floating on nothing – and, shortly after she starts, Vai follows suit, his eyes shutting and his head bowing, as if he had gone to sleep.
        
        She and Vai both sit totally still, absorbed in their own world – although that may be giving it too little credit. Whatever it is they’re doing (aside from sleeping), you can’t piece it together with your eyes alone.
        
        So, you do what Zo’s trained you to do: you sit in front of both of them and you shut your own eyes, focusing on your inner energy and attempting to reach out to them both. It’s a familiar training exercise that you’ve done numerous times before by now, but rather than practicing on a tree or some flowers, you’re reaching out to Zo and Vai. The subject may be different, but the methods are the same.
        
        In the darkness of your vision, you see, or rather, you sense, both Zo and Vai: Zo, like usual, is as overwhelming and total as the sun in the darkness, totally overpowering any other energy you might be able to reach out to. But you know to search for Vai’s aura as well, and it doesn’t take much searching: you ‘see’ it, even eclipsed by Zo’s own aura as it is, and yet it’s as obvious as a lump of coal in a snowy field.
        
        Zo’s aura and Vai’s intermingle in a way that feel almost like some form of dance; like Zo’s is trying to get Vai’s to move and interact with it in a certain way, and Vai’s aura is having trouble keeping up. When you reach out to them and you feel your own energies intermingle with Zo’s, hers feels like it’s suddenly pulling you in, like it’s snatching you up; but, rather than trying to overpower you, it instead tries to bring you in alignment with Vai, using your aura to help her surround his. It reminds you of being pulled into a dance by an energetic and outgoing dance partner, except, well, there’s also baby between you.
        
        Eventually, however, Vai’s aura stops moving altogether. You know better than to think the worst – it just means that he’s resting. You open your eyes first, and Zo’s opens hers second, her irises still shimmering silver; with a hard blink, they turn back to green, and her hair slowly falls back to the bed. But Vai’s eyes don’t open: he’s sound asleep.
        
        Frankly, as much as you love Vai, you know that having a fussy, excited baby in your care can be a little overbearing and exhausting sometimes, and you know better than to take this temporary gift for granted. And you of all people know that, sometimes, a nap is just what the doctor ordered.
rows.translation:
你告诉Zo，你想和她以及Vai一起度过一些时间，于是询问她是否有什么建议，能让你们三个人一起做些什么来度过这些时光。而她，自然而然地，就想到了一个主意。

Zo伸手抱起Vai，把他提起来放在自己的腿上，而她自己则坐在地面上。 [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|家|简陋的小屋]起初，Vai会扭动身体、挣扎着，他的手臂试图去抓远处的某个东西，显然那个东西让他非常着迷。但她将双臂交叉抱在胸前，压在他身上，让他保持静止、靠近自己。然后，她低下头，闭上眼睛，她那编好的头发开始缓缓升向空中，在没有任何支撑的情况下漂浮着。不久之后，Vai也跟着做了同样的动作，他闭上了眼睛，低下了头，仿佛已经睡着了一样。
        
        她和瓦伊都静静地坐着，完全沉浸在自己的世界里——不过这么说可能有点轻描淡写了。无论他们在做什么（除了睡觉之外），单凭肉眼是根本无法看清楚的。
        
        于是，你按照佐训练你的方式去做：你坐在他们两人面前，闭上眼睛，集中自己的内在能量，试图与他们建立起联系。这是你之前已经练习过很多次的熟悉训练方法，只不过这一次，你并不是在练习如何与树木或花朵交流，而是在尝试与佐和瓦伊建立联系。 主题可能有所不同，但方法都是相同的。
        
        在视野的黑暗中，你看到了——或者更确切地说，你感知到了——佐和瓦伊的存在：佐如同往常一样，如同黑暗中的太阳般强大而耀眼，其能量完全压倒了你可能试图接触到的任何其他力量。但你也知道，还需要寻找瓦伊的气息，而这一寻找并不困难：你“看到了”它，尽管它的存在被佐的气息所掩盖，但它依然像雪原中的一块煤块一样清晰可见。
        
        佐的光环与瓦伊的光环相互交织，这种交织仿佛是一种舞蹈；仿佛佐在试图引导瓦伊以某种特定的方式与她的光环产生互动，而瓦伊的光环则有些难以跟上这种节奏。当你试图与它们接触，让自己的能量与佐的光环融合在一起时，会感觉到她的光环突然将你拉了进去，仿佛在将你紧紧抓住；然而，它并没有试图压制你，而是试图让你与瓦伊的光环保持协调，利用你的光环来帮助她包围住瓦伊的光环。 这让人感觉就像被一个充满活力、热情外向的舞伴拉进了舞蹈中，只不过，嗯，你们中间还怀有一个宝宝。
        
        然而，最终，瓦伊的光环完全停止了移动。你很清楚，最好不要往最坏的方向想——这仅仅意味着他正在休息。你先睁开了眼睛，接着佐也睁开了眼睛，她的虹膜依然闪烁着银色光芒；随着她用力眨了眨眼，虹膜又恢复了绿色，她的头发也慢慢垂回到了床上。但是瓦伊的眼睛却一直没有睁开：他正在熟睡之中。
        
        坦白说，尽管你非常喜欢Vai，但你也知道，照顾一个任性又充满活力的小宝宝有时候确实会让人感到压力很大、精疲力竭。你更清楚，不应该把这份暂时的“礼物”视为理所当然。而你，更是最明白这一点的人——有时候，小睡一会儿其实就是医生建议的做法。

rows.original:
You hook your hands underneath Vai’s armpits and heft him upward, lifting him into your [pc.chest] and resting him against your arm. At first, he’s a bit fussy, but once he recognizes that it’s warm and comfortable inside your grip like this, he calms down and starts to snuggle in.

        You press your nose against his, rubbing them back and forth a bit. He doesn’t respond to that at all – until, suddenly, he sneezes.
        
        You bring Vai to Zo and you sit down next to her, with her to your right. Vai makes the typical baby coos and his hands aimlessly wander anywhere from your [pc.skinFurScales] to waving in the air between you and her; with your free arm, you lift your left hand to his, extending your index finger for him to grab onto, and once your finger presses into his palm, his digits curl around yours, almost instinctively. Your son’s already got a little bit of a grip on him with how hard he’s squeezing down.
        
        It’s too early for Vai to be speaking – much less for him to recognize you and Zo as his parents – but nonetheless, there’s never a ‘wrong’ time to speak with your kid. And maybe you should look into getting a book or two so you can read it to him young. You say a handful of silly, pedantic-but-engaging-for-a-child nothings, such as his name, and that you’re his [pc.mf
            |daddy
            |mommy
        ], and that Zo is his [pc.mf
            |mommy
            |other mommy
        ], and that he’s your son.
        
        As expected, Vai doesn’t engage with anything you say, but at least his eyes stay firmly on yours while you speak. It’s good to know that you can keep his attention. His free hand reaches up and squeezes at your nose when you don’t say anything for a few seconds.
        
        Zo laughs with that awkward heaving that she does before she scoots her rump around to your front, so that you two are facing each other more directly. With both hands, she motions for you to stay still; then, her right hand goes to your head, her fingers mapping out specific spots on your skull to press against. Her left hand does the same with Vai, but, as expected, he’s a bit harder to get a good handle on; he’s not upset or fussy when she tries, but his attention span is too short for his head to stay still longer than a few seconds at a time.
        
        Still, she manages to get her fingers into a comfortable position on Vai’s head. She shuts her eyes and takes a deep breath, in through her nose, and she holds it there; her hair begins to shudder and lift into the air slightly as she does that thing with her bodily energy. Given that she has one hand on you and the other on Vai, whatever you’re about to experience isn’t likely to be as intense as the other events.
        
        Her eyes don’t open, but, instead, you feel a particular warmth in your chest. It’s a sudden bloom within you that slowly sinks to your stomach first, then radiates out to your limbs. But more than the warmth, it feels... like something else. Comforting. Cozy is a good word. Maybe ‘nostalgic’ would be a better one? It sort of reminds you of the early summer days when you were a kid and the only care you had in the world was what was for dinner.
        
        A moment passes, and you realize that Vai’s stopped fussing in your arms; his eyes have drooped slightly, and his lips are pressed into a thin, wide smile. A snot bubble inflates from the edge of his right nostril, in and out with his breathing. Honestly, [silly
            |that’s a vibe if you’ve ever seen one
            |how he feels is sort of like how you feel right now
        ].
        
        Zo removes her fingers from both of your faces, and the feeling... doesn’t disappear, not immediately. It lingers for a moment, fluttering in your chest and your stomach, before eventually evaporating over time – and replaced with something different, but just as good.
        
        After all, you’re here with your son and your lover. What more could you need?
rows.translation:
你将双手部放在Vai的腋下，把他向上抬，将他抱到了你的怀里。 [pc.chest] 将它靠在你的手部臂上。起初，它会有些不适应，但一旦它感觉到这样被你抱着既温暖又舒适，就会安静下来，开始依偎在你身边。

你把鼻子凑到它的鼻子旁，轻轻地来回摩擦着。起初它没有任何反应——直到，突然间，它打了个喷嚏。

你把Vai带到Zo身边，然后坐在她旁边，让她坐在你的右边。Vai发出了婴儿特有的咿呀声，而它的双手部则漫无目的地在你身上游走…… [pc.skinFurScales] 在你和她之间挥动；用你的空闲手部，抬起你的左手部去握住他的手部，伸出食指让他抓住，而一旦你的手部指触碰到他的手部掌，他的手部指就会几乎本能地缠绕在你的手部指上。 你的儿子已经开始能够通过自己用力挤压的动作来控制它了。

对于Vai来说，现在还太早，它还不会说话——更不用说能够认出你和Zo是它的父母了——但无论如何，与孩子交谈从来都没有“错误”的时机。 也许你应该找一两本书来，等孩子还小的时候读给他听。你可以讲一些简单、有点迂腐但对孩子来说很有趣的小故事，比如他的名字，然后告诉他们你是他的…… [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |妈妈
        ]而且佐就是他的…… [pc.mf
            |妈妈
            |其他妈妈们
        ]而且，他是你的儿子。”

正如预期的那样，瓦伊并没有对你说的任何话做出反应，但至少在你说话的时候，他的目光始终紧紧地盯着你。知道你能吸引他的注意力，这让人感到欣慰。当你几秒钟没有说话时，他那只空着的手部会伸过来，捏捏你的鼻子。
        
        佐用那种特有的笨拙动作笑了笑，然后挪动身体来到你的面前，让你们俩能够更直接地对视。她用双手部示意你保持静止，接着用右手部触碰你的头部，手部指轻轻按压着你头骨上的某些特定部位。 她的左手部在操作Vai时也是一样的，但正如预期的那样，要让他稳定地掌握这个控制器确实有点困难。当她尝试操作时，他并没有表现出不满或烦躁，不过他的注意力持续时间太短了，无法让头部保持静止状态超过几秒钟。
        
        尽管如此，她还是设法将自己的手部指调整到在Vai头上最为舒适的位置。她闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，空气通过鼻腔进入体内后她屏住呼吸；与此同时，她的身体开始微微颤抖，头发也轻轻飘了起来——这一切都是因为她正在运用自身的能量。由于她一只手部按在你身上，另一只手部则放在Vai头上，所以你接下来将会体验到的感觉，应该不会像之前那些经历那样强烈吧。
        
        她的双眼并没有睁开，但你会感到胸口有一股特别的温暖。这种温暖突然在体内涌现，先是缓缓蔓延到腹部，然后又扩散到四肢。不过，这种温暖带来的感觉……似乎还不止于此。它给人一种安慰，让人感到舒适。用“温馨”这个词来形容再合适不过了。或许“怀旧”这个词会更加贴切？这种感觉会让人想起小时候的初夏时光，那时你满心关心的只有晚餐吃什么。
        
        过了一会儿，你才发现，Vai已经不再在你怀里闹腾了；他的眼睛微微下垂，嘴唇呈现出一种淡淡的、宽大的微笑。他的右鼻孔边缘不断有鼻水泡出来，随着他的呼吸一起一伏。说实话…… [silly
            |那可真是绝妙的氛围，如果你见过的话，就会明白我的意思。
            |他的感受，有点像你现在的这种感觉。
        ]佐将她的手部指从你的脸上移开，那种感觉……并没有立刻消失。它还在你的胸腔和胃部萦绕片刻，随后才逐渐消散，取而代之的，是另一种同样美妙的感觉。

毕竟，你现在和你的儿子以及你的爱人在一起，你还需要什么呢？

Your son’s already got a little bit of a grip on him with how hard he’s squeezing down.
        
        It’s too early for Vai to be speaking – much less for him to recognize you and Zo as his parents – but nonetheless, there’s never a ‘wrong’ time to speak with your kid. And maybe you should look into getting a book or two so you can read it to him young. You say a handful of silly, pedantic-but-engaging-for-a-child nothings, such as his name, and that you’re his [pc.mf
            |daddy
            |mommy
        ], and that Zo is his [pc.mf
            |mommy
            |other mommy
        ], and that he’s your son.
        
        As expected, Vai doesn’t engage with anything you say, but at least his eyes stay firmly on yours while you speak. It’s good to know that you can keep his attention. His free hand reaches up and squeezes at your nose when you don’t say anything for a few seconds.
        
        Zo laughs with that awkward heaving that she does before she scoots her rump around to your front, so that you two are facing each other more directly. With both hands, she motions for you to stay still; then, her right hand goes to your head, her fingers mapping out specific spots on your skull to press against. Her left hand does the same with Vai, but, as expected, he’s a bit harder to get a good handle on; he’s not upset or fussy when she tries, but his attention span is too short for his head to stay still longer than a few seconds at a time.
        
        Still, she manages to get her fingers into a comfortable position on Vai’s head. She shuts her eyes and takes a deep breath, in through her nose, and she holds it there; her hair begins to shudder and lift into the air slightly as she does that thing with her bodily energy. Given that she has one hand on you and the other on Vai, whatever you’re about to experience isn’t likely to be as intense as the other events.
        
        Her eyes don’t open, but, instead, you feel a particular warmth in your chest. It’s a sudden bloom within you that slowly sinks to your stomach first, then radiates out to your limbs. But more than the warmth, it feels... like something else. Comforting. Cozy is a good word. Maybe ‘nostalgic’ would be a better one? It sort of reminds you of the early summer days when you were a kid and the only care you had in the world was what was for dinner.
        
        A moment passes, and you realize that Vai’s stopped fussing in your arms; his eyes have drooped slightly, and his lips are pressed into a thin, wide smile. A snot bubble inflates from the edge of his right nostril, in and out with his breathing. Honestly, [silly
            |that’s a vibe if you’ve ever seen one
            |how he feels is sort of like how you feel right now
        ].
        
        Zo removes her fingers from both of your faces, and the feeling... doesn’t disappear, not immediately. It lingers for a moment, fluttering in your chest and your stomach, before eventually evaporating over time – and replaced with something different, but just as good.
        
        After all, you’re here with your son and your lover. What more could you need?"

rows.original:
Zo has Vai sitting on her lap, her hands gently pinched onto his wrists and doing a tuneless, rhythmless dance by shuffling them back and forth. It’s good exercise for the baby; it gets the limbs moving and the blood circulating. He doesn’t have the motor skills to do that himself yet.

        You help her out by putting yourself down in front of them and gripping onto his ankles by pinching each of them between your thumb and index fingers. Your range of motion isn’t nearly as wide as Zo has with his arms, but you can lift and kick and bend his legs; that’s all you really need access to.
        
        There’s a popular children’s rhyme that you remember from when you were a kid; the lyrics were about a kid ‘prancing’ their way to a well in a forest to fetch some water, and the song loops into itself so that the kid returns home with the water and heads back out right away. As an adult, the song gets pretty insufferable in a hurry, but as a child, well, it rhymes; it has an upbeat, swinging rhythm to it; and it’s keeping Vai engaged with you and Zo, so, you couldn’t ask for a better distraction.
        
        Zo seems to recognize the song as well, because her movements with Vai’s arms is keeping the beat with your movements with his legs. Pretty soon, Vai’s mouth breaks into a big, wide grin. His laughter comes to you like a complimentary soprano tune to go with your quiet singing.
        
        Eventually, you get bored of the song (well before he does, naturally), so you decide to switch it up: his legs are probably getting a little tired from all the exercise, so, you let go of them and bring your hands up to your eyes instead. Your fingertips go to just beneath your eyeballs, and once you’re sure you have Vai’s attention, you hide your eyes behind them for a moment – before pulling them down and saying "peekaboo!"
        
        Vai, at first, seems confused. His brow furrows and his eyes flit between yours over and over. Of course, him being a baby, that could mean anything. So you try it again; you hide behind your hands, then, after a moment, you flip your hands open and say "peekaboo!" again.
        
        After the second time, the smile comes back to Vai’s face, and he laughs and giggles and bounces on Zo’s lap in delight at the game. She tries to get him in on it, too: with her fingers still gently pinched around his tiny wrists, she brings his hands to his eyes (his fingers errantly flexing at nothing) to hide behind; then, after a moment, she flings them apart so that you can look him in the eyes again. Zo isn’t about to say ‘peekaboo’ for him, so you do it instead.
        
        Vai thinks it’s the funniest thing in the world; his arms flap up and down and his laughter comes out in short, rapid chirps. It’s safe to say that he’s found a new favorite game to play.
rows.translation:
佐让瓦伊坐在自己的腿上，双手部轻轻握住他的手部腕，通过前后移动他的手部腕来让他跳一种没有节奏、没有旋律的舞蹈。这对婴儿来说是一种很好的锻炼方式——能够活动四肢，促进血液循环。而瓦伊目前还还没有足够的运动能力来自己做这样的动作。

        你通过让自己站在他们面前，然后用拇指和食指捏住他的脚踝来帮助她。虽然你的活动范围远不如佐用他的手部臂那么宽广，但你可以抬高、踢动或弯曲他的腿——这些就是你真正需要能够做到的动作。
        
        有一首广为流传的儿童童谣，你肯定在小时候听过；它的歌词讲述的是一个孩子蹦蹦跳跳地跑到森林里的井边去取水，然后这首歌会循环播放，直到孩子带着水回到家，又立刻再次出发。成年后，这种反复播放的旋律可能会让人感到有些烦躁，但对孩子来说，它的韵律优美，节奏轻快活泼，而且能让你和Zo保持注意力集中，因此，再完美的消遣方式也不过如此了。
        
        佐似乎也认出了这首歌，因为她随着韦伊手部臂的动作，自己的动作也在与你用腿配合着节奏。不久之后，韦伊的脸上露出了灿烂的笑容，他的笑声就像一首优美的女高音曲调，与你轻声哼唱的旋律相得益彰。
        
        最终，你开始对这首歌感到厌烦了（当然，在他之前你早就厌倦了），于是你决定改变一下玩法：他的双腿肯定因为一直在运动而变得有些疲劳，于是你松开了他的腿，而是将双手部举到眼前。你的指尖轻轻触碰到眼球的下方，确认他已经注意到了你之后，你就立刻用双手部遮住眼睛，过了一会儿再把手部拿开，然后说道：“躲猫猫！
        
        一开始，Vai看起来有些困惑。他的眉头紧锁，目光一直在你的眼睛和你的手部之间来回移动。当然，由于他还只是个婴儿，他的这种反应可能意味着很多事情。于是你又试了一次：你把手部藏在身后，过了一会儿，再把手部伸开，再次说道：“躲猫猫！
        
        第二次之后，瓦伊的脸上又露出了笑容，他开心地笑着、咯咯地笑，还在佐的腿上蹦来蹦去。佐也试图让他参与到这个游戏中来：她仍然轻轻握着他的小手部腕，把他的手部放到自己的眼睛前面（他的手部指不由自主地动来动去），让他可以“躲”起来；过了一会儿，她又把他的手部拉开，让他能够再次看到自己的眼睛。既然佐并不打算跟他玩“躲猫猫”，那就由你来代替她吧。
        
        瓦伊觉得这是世界上最有趣的事情了；他的双臂上下挥动，笑声伴随着一连串短促而急促的叫声传出。可以肯定的是，他找到了自己最喜欢玩的新游戏了。

rows.original:
You stand up straight, eyeing the area that Zo’s turned into a home. She has a house; a grassy field; a flower garden; a single apple tree; and a tiny farm with a handful of different crops for her to make enough food to support herself, Vai, and probably you if you asked. It’s not a bad living space, especially for one woman that manages it all by herself.

        You scoop Vai up into your arms, resting him against your right arm and leaning him against your chest, and you reach for Zo with your left, your hand outstretched for her to take. It’s a small thing, but you’d like to go for a walk with them. Just around the grove for a little bit. There’s nothing new or exciting to see, but that’s hardly the point.
        
        Zo smiles, her head tilting to one side and her eyes narrowing in delight as she places her right hand in yours. You’re currently in front of her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|home|shack]; the first stop in your trip would be directly ahead, to the grassy field where you learned how to balance a fine, delicate sword between your fingers – and then you and Zo made a game out of throwing rocks at each other.
        
        The walk is quiet; your only ambience is your combined footfalls on the grass; the occasional coo from Vai as he squirms in your arm; and the ambient sound of the wind in the trees and the songs of whatever birds happen to be nearby. You knew from the start that Zo wasn’t going to be much of a conversationalist, but it’s not the ‘entertainment’ that you’re here for – you’re here for your lover and your son.
        
        The grassy field beside Zo’s house is maybe forty paces deep and ninety paces wide; you travel it counterclockwise with your family, which next brings you to Zo’s tiny farm, with the apple tree and the tilled land. You look up at the tree as you pass underneath it and remember the training you had gone through in order to reach those apples, and the thought of Vai going through the same training – but at a younger age, and he’d probably be better than you at it – crossed your mind. Zo’s hand squeezes yours when she notices that you’re looking at the tree somewhat wistfully.
        
        The last two stops on your trip around the grove are Zo’s flower garden (always out-of-season, it seems) and that training dummy she had set up across from her [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|cabin|shack] to practice exerting herself against. Vai takes a particular interest in it: his right hand extends towards it as if he were trying to grasp it. You head towards the dummy for him, and his tiny hand brushes against the surface of the broken metal put that it uses for a helmet, inspecting it for himself, before just as quickly losing interest and retreating back into the warmth of your chest.
        
        By the time you finish your walk, Vai’s eyes start to get a little heavy, and he doesn’t fidget in your grip nearly as much as when you first picked him up. Perhaps it’s soon time for a nap.
rows.translation:
你挺直身子，注视着佐将这片地方变成了家。她有一栋房子、一片长满草的田野、一个花坛、一棵苹果树，还有一个小农场，里面种着各种各样的作物。这些作物足以让她自己、瓦伊，甚至如果你提出要求的话，也能有足够的食物来维持生活。 这个居住环境还算不错，尤其是对于一个独自打理一切的女性来说。

你把Vai抱在怀里，让他靠在你的右臂上，身体则紧贴着你的胸膛，而你的左手则伸向Zo，等待她来接住。 这虽然是一件小事，但你还是想和他们一起去散散步吧。就绕着小树林走一会儿而已。那里并没有什么新鲜或有趣的东西值得看，但这也正是散步的意义所在啊。

佐微笑着，把头偏向一边，眼睛眯成了一条缝，显得非常开心，然后她把右手放在了你的手上。 你现在就在她面前。 [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|家|简陋的小屋]你旅程中的第一站就在前方不远处，那个长满草的场地——在那里，你学会了如何用手指巧妙地操控那把纤细的剑保持平衡；后来，你和佐还一起玩起了互相扔石头的游戏。
        
        这段路程十分宁静，你唯一能听到的声音，就是自己脚步踩在草地上发出的声响；偶尔，当你抱着Vai时，他会发出轻柔的咕咕声；此外，还有风在树林中吹拂的声音，以及附近鸟儿传来的歌声。 你从一开始就明白，佐并不是一个很爱聊天的人，但你来这里的目的本来就不是为了寻求“娱乐”——你是为了你的爱人和儿子才来到这里的。
        
        佐家旁边的那片草场大概有四十步深、九十步宽；你会和家人一起逆时针方向穿过它，然后就会来到佐家的小农场——那里有苹果树和耕种过的土地。当你从苹果树下走过时，你会抬头望向那棵树，回想起自己为了摘到那些苹果所经历的训练；同时，你也会想到瓦伊也在经历同样的训练——只不过他年纪更小，而且他很可能做得比你更好。 当佐注意到你正若有所思地望着那棵树时，她轻轻地握住了你的手。
        
        你在林间游览的最后两个景点是佐的花园（似乎总是处于非开花季节），以及她放在那边的那个训练假人。 [flags.ZO_UPGRADE 3|小屋|简陋的小屋] 练习如何用力对抗……Vai对这件事表现出了特别的兴趣：他的右手伸向那个物体，仿佛想要抓住它。你把他带到那个假人面前，他的小手轻轻触碰着那个被用作头盔的破碎金属片，自己仔细检查了一下，然后很快又失去了兴趣，重新回到了你温暖的怀抱中。
        
        当你走完这段路后，Vai的眼睛开始变得有些重型，它在你手中的样子，也远没有你刚把它抱起来时那么活跃了。也许，它已经该小睡一会儿了。

rows.original:
Some time has passed, and as much as you’d like to spend more time with your family, there are still tasks and missions that you need to complete in the greater world. It’s a bit tough to pull yourself away from Zo and Vai, but it needs to be done.

        At the very least, Zo and Vai see you off from the entrance to her grove; Zo carries him in her arms and she has a wide, closed-mouth smile on her face, while Vai clings to her outfit with both hands – until he extends one towards you, his fingers clenching at the air a few times, before turning back to his mom and burying himself in her fur.
        
        After that, you’re back in the Harvest Valley.
rows.translation:
一段时间过去了，尽管你非常想多陪陪家人，但在现实世界中，仍然有许多任务和目标需要你去完成。离开Zo和Vai确实有点困难，但这是必须做的。

        至少，佐和瓦伊会陪你走到她树林的入口处；佐把他抱在怀里，脸上挂着灿烂而沉默的微笑，而瓦伊则用双手部紧紧抓住她的衣服——直到他伸出其中一只手部，手部指在半空中挥动了几下，随后又把手部缩了回来，重新依偎在妈妈的怀里。
        
        之后，你就会回到丰收谷了。
