Anna clicks her tongue a few times, considering the farmhand duties available today. Apparently she settles on one, clapping you gently on the shoulder. "Grab a bucket and mop, it’s barn cleaning time." 

            It’s not quite what you expect when she leads you to the barn where the cowgirls live, leaves the bucket and mop there, and escorts you back outside again. She snickers softly at your confusion before pointing at the other barn. "Sorry Hero, we’ve gotta muck out the sheepies first. Pitchforks are already in there though." 

            Damn. Not nearly so fun as mopping and flirting with the a-moo-zons.

            At least the sheep themselves are out in their pens idly grazing. The smell is hardly anything to write home about, but the actual process of forking out the grime isn’t the worst thing you’ve ever done. Still, you’re hardly going to pay too much attention to the sights and smells[silly| nor would you want the writer of this scene to describe shifting sheep shit in excruciating detail]. It’s best just to focus on turning over hay and getting it out of the barn. 

            The both of you move the less-than-pleasant remains outside and push it into a ditch, which she casts some fresh soil over. "Once this is all the way filled up it’s turned over and eventually used for fertilizer. Not exactly the prettiest job but we have the absolute best crop yield around... admittedly we have the only crop yield around. Did you know the minotaurs buy shit tons of our beer?"

            You grimace a little at her use of the phrase 'shit tons', which only breaks her into a series of snorts and giggles before she masters herself. "Ah-hem. Anyway. Clean up your arms and hands in the house, and make sure you aren’t tracking any dirt!"

            At last. There are some soapy brush-looking things on the floor outside the pupper household that you make sure to run your feet through. Scrubbing yourself clean after that feels heavenly and you don’t stop until your skin is all but tingling. Anna looks you over and gives you a sniff afterwards, apparently satisfied judging by the way she loops an arm through yours. "Perfect. A clean hero’s a good hero."

            It’s not any kind of saying you’re familiar with, but whatever. She’s not wrong. Anna squishes your arm into her tits and grins at you on the journey back to your first destination; the moo barn. Gloria and Lucia are sat inside, dozing off lazily on their beds. The smell of sex and milk is strong in the air, and Anna pouts with her tail tucking in. "I should’ve known Morwen would’ve snuck in some milking time while we were up to our knees in gross."

            Oh well, nothing for it but to get to work. You each take a mop and begin the process of getting these wooden barn floors shining. At the same time Anna explains that they make their own cleaning solution out of boiled citrus fruit oils and soap, and it does a wonderful job of polishing up afterwards on treated planks. Handy; she should probably sell a bunch to a certain lupine man’s bar.

            After mopping — now feeling lemon-y fresh — you both dust all the tables and neaten up the furniture. At some point during your work the two titanic moo’s awaken from their post fucking/milking slumber and join in to help out, which certainly helps as far as lifting furniture out of the way is concerned. "As you might expect," Anna explains, smirking and holding up some underwear. "With our hands-on approach to milking the girls, we need to stay on top of keeping everything clean almost daily. Otherwise it’d get pretty ripe around here."

            Eventually your work is finished, even though there’s a cramping from the effort in your biceps, thighs, and lower back. Anna herself looks relatively unbothered, but then those muscle groups are probably pretty used to this workout. She smiles and tail-wags when she notices you looking, flexing a toned arm.

            ...And then she starts undressing.

            Before you can ask why, she’s folded her overalls and tossed them into a laundry basket. She looks magnificent in the barn’s half-light, glistening and lithe. There’s a tiny blush on her face when she looks over her shoulder at you, puppy-pecker starting to grow hard. "Y’know Hero. After a hard day’s work, nothing goes down quite so nicely as a relaxing bath... would you like to join me?"

rows.original: Morwen gently blows out the lights, beginning to hum a surprisingly sweet and musical tune while she walks around doing so. She makes sure the cupboards are closed the shutters are shut, but while you’re busy watching Anna grabs you and pulls you down into the bed. The bedding is wonderfully comfortable, and smells fresh and clean. Just how they manage that is an astounding show of their willingness to do laundry every single time some fun is had. Your head sinks into the pillows, and Anna’s body is warm against your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. It’s probably telling of how long her day was that she’s not immediately poking you in the abdomen with a hard a cock. Before your mind allows itself to slip into a place any more 'dick-centric' Morwen slides under the covers and pushes herself up against your back, tail similarly wagging. When you take a deep breath it’s of cleanliness, and wolf girl fluff. With the darkness for company, and your eyes gently closed you can hear the soft wagging of tails, and the gentle whistle of wind in the distance. Somewhere in the barns are the occasional loud snore or plaintive 'baa', and you can hear those sounds set the girls' ears to twitching against the pillow. Anna and Morwen both let out soothing sighs in unison, snuggling in close enough for you to feel heartbeats against your chest and back. As sleep begins to take the girls before you, the sound of their wagging tails comes to a halt. There’s a little fidgeting and they tuck their fluffy waggers in and practically wrap them around you. Anna buries her face into your chest, letting out another sigh that you can feel bleeds the tension right out of her shoulders. Your arms don’t really have anywhere to go, but you can place your right hand on her head and gently scritch her. Drowsiness creeps up on you all the same. The soothing sounds of gently breathing puppers, the warmth of breasts pressed against you and legs entwined with your own... It’s nice, it’s just nice. Trying to put fancier words to it doesn’t feel right; as you are right now it feels really nice to be going to sleep. Just as your consciousness winks out however, you hear a soft whisper from Anna, accompanied by a little smooch on your collarbone. "Hey... I know you’re asleep. But I kinda really love you, Hero." And maybe — just maybe — you can feel Morwen’s lips curl up into a smile against your back.

There’s a definite extra chill to the air as you walk alongside the fence to Pupperidge Farms. Even the impressive figures of Gloria and Lucia — each wielding a large grain-sack and chatting — are dressed up in colorful, fluffy woolen sweaters. They catch sight of [party.som|you|you and [companion.name]|you and your companions], breaking into bright smiles and waving you over. Lucia’s all but bouncing on her heels — which does incredible things for her plush milky tits — while Gloria scoops up the sack she’s left behind. "Hiiiii [pc.name]! You know, you came by at the perfect time!" Lucia announces.

    "Shhh, not so loud!" Gloria sighs, gesturing you closer with an upnod. "Lucia’s not wrong though, you’re just in time cutie. We were getting ourselves all nice and ready for a delicious holiday meal... would you like to join us? I’m sure the girls would be delighted to have you!"

    "Yeah! Do you know how hard it is to try and get a hold of you? I bet seeing [party.som|you|you two|you guys] would make their days. How about it?" Lucia asks, clasping her hands together.

“嘘，别这么大声！”格洛丽亚轻声说道，同时点头示意你靠近一些。“不过露西娅说得对，你确实来得正好，亲爱的。我们正在准备一顿美味的节日大餐呢……你想加入我们吗？我相信其他女孩们也会很高兴有你来的！”

Pastry in the oven, soft bread, meat, vegetables, gravy... the assortment sets your mouth to watering, all the while a red-headed wolf-girl hums a happy tune with a wagging tail as she attends the stove. It looks like both Anna and Morwen, and Lucia and Gloria are enjoying the surprise on your face, and after taking another mouthful you realize that the sweetness is hiding... maybe a lot of booze judging by the way that heat doesn’t seem to fade. Well, you guess that works just fine for poetry.|"Thank you, it smells incredible." you insist with a smile, [pc.hasTail|tail wagging|hips wriggling].]
    
        Anna smiles brightly, a little blush on her face as the feast is laid out in full. First is a great big meat pie full of gravy, and stuffing, and little sliced baby potatoes, next is the tray of roasted vegetables and mashed roots, all lightly grilled afterwards so that it’s contained in a sweet shell of crispy bits, along with a bowl of roasted potatoes that are just about crunchy at the edges and glistening with fresh oily goodness. The ginger pup begins to serve you all fat slices of pie, a shovelled helping of mixed vegetables, and a bevy of roasted potatoes before pouring out a healthy dose of fresh hot, thick gravy. Alongside that is a little bowl of spiced berry jam for the meat...
        
        You might have perished and moved onto some kind of beautiful afterlife, in a great warm home full of smiling (horny) faces and delicious food. Much to your credit, you manage to wait until the chef of the hour takes her seat before digging hungrily in. There are all manner of words to describe the combinations of flavors, but the most stand out part is being in what feels like a nice big family meal. Everyone around you is quiet; the only thing you can hear is the sound of chewing and swallowing, happy sighs, and the occasional muffled request for gravy or seconds.
        
        By the time you’ve all finished, there are — staggeringly — still some leftovers of the veg and potatoes... Anna insists she can bake those up into a second pie for tomorrow’s meal before any of you can overstuff yourself with guilt, gently rubbing her tummy. "Mmm... tempted to nap now."
        
        You yawn a little, stretching yourself out in the chair while Gloria and Lucia [party.som|lean in to give you a kiss each. They depart not long after, intending to go get in a nice long nap themselves.|wrap an arm each around [companion.name]. The trio depart not long after, intending to go get in a nice long nap... or a lusty fuck. It doesn’t much matter.|each steal one of your companions. They slip away not a moment later, intending to see their own beds are well accompanied.]

"You make me very happy when you’re around, and it’s so nice to make dinner for you!" It’s about as close to a face-to-face confession of her feelings that you’re likely to get from the wolf girl, but she doesn’t miss a beat when it comes to dipping in for a kiss. rows.original:
"Your house is very interesting," you note. "Not to mention the locale."
    
    Kalysea chuckles. "I am somewhat of a hermit. Not exactly a wicked witch of the woods, but I'd forgive you for misunderstanding. My home was graciously provided by nature, so I do my best to take care of it."
    
    "Do you live alone?" you say.
    
    "I wouldn't say alone – I am a druid, after all, and I'm surrounded by nature," Kalysea says. "I'm in constant communion with the forest."
    
    "I can see your point," you say. "Even just walking here was an interesting trip."
    
    She nods. "That's right. It's true, though, that we're the only people here." She smiles. "I like the seclusion. Civilization and I don't get along very well, though I do have sparse contact with the other centaurs in the village, and occasionally the marefolk. Funnily enough, I think the latter understand me a little better than the former, wanting to be out here on my own."
    
    "The marefolk are traditionally very nomadic," you say, nodding. "I can see why."
    
    "Exactly," Kalysea says. "Still, everyone's very amiable and they don't intrude on my way of life. Just how I like it. Well, except the demons."

"Can you really talk to animals?" you ask.

        Kalysea nods. "I can. Though it's not really talking, as such. More like... a transfer of feelings. If there is something the animal particularly desires, I might be able to pick that out. Say I'm holding a tangerine and an inquisitive deer is interested."

        "No. Not directly, anyway. Depending on how immediate the danger is, I might be able to intuit it myself," Kalysea says. "Herbivores tend to be anxious a lot of the time, but if it's the only thing they're feeling it's usually a giveaway."
        
        "Do you help the animals that come to you?" you say.
        
        "I reassure them," she says. "If they're worried about food or shelter, I can lead them somewhere. If they're being hunted by another animal, I don't interfere. It might seem harsh, but providing comfort to an animal in danger might dull their senses and inadvertently cause them harm. I wouldn't want to interfere in the cycle."
        
        "What about hunters?" you say, thinking of the bowmen you've seen.
        
        Kalysea smiles. "Well, nature needs all the help she can get on that front. I won't harm the hunter but if a deer or rabbit approaches me for help, I'll direct it away. Not every animal they're looking for is going to find me, after all."
        
        "Are hunters part of the cycle, then?" you say.
        
        Kalysea's smile fades a bit. "I don't know, truthfully. It's hard to think so when you see people chopping down forests to build walls and houses but then there are those who revere and in turn worship nature... my own feelings on the matter aside, I think we are meant to take the good with the bad." She grins. "Though I imagine adherents of the old gods didn't necessarily agree. There were those with very staunch views against civilization.
